jobs.title: RQ08750 - UX Designer - Senior
jobs.excerpt: GeneralThere are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.
jobs.description:
General

There are four (4) distinct delivery phases in which user experience designers (task based I&IT consultants) produce deliverables following Ontario Digital Service Design playbook, which outlines the standard process for user experience design.

Delivery Phase 1) Discovery:

Before building a solution, a project team needs to find out whether users need it and whether other solutions exist. The UX Designers responsibilities during this phase are to build an understanding of the problem space/statement, the long and short-term business goals, and the user and business needs.

Deliverables:

  1. Facilitate the Kick-off meeting with the project team to produce such outputs as:
  • Business Model Canvas
  • 5 Whys
  • User Personas
  • Stakeholder Mapping
  • Strategy Map
  • Short- and Long-Term Goals
  • Fears and Challenges
  • Problem Statement
  1. Facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic Maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User Interview Scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Inception (Science Fair Day):
  • Showcases the work and key findings from this stage to stakeholders outside of the core project team
  • Aligns entire team (business, technical) on what the next steps will be
  • Planning activities for next phase (Alpha)
  1. Other deliverables typically delivered in this phase include:
  • User Storyboard to communicate a story through images displayed in a sequence of panels that chronologically maps the storys main events.
  • Technical Service Blueprint, a diagram that displays the entire process of service delivery including support systems by listing all the activities that happen at each stage, performed by the different roles involved
  • Defined business Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery Phase 2) Alpha:

Alpha is about testing hypotheses and experimentation. The purpose of Alpha is to determine how to meet the user needs that were identified in discovery. This phase is an opportunity to quickly test different approaches with users before building a service.

Deliverables:

  1. Optionally conduct Google Ventures five (5) Day Design Sprint (or variation). This sprint is a five (5) day process for answering critical business questions through design, prototyping, and testing ideas with customers
  2. Produce clickable prototypes of multiple possible solutions
  3. Validate "clickable prototypes with users through usability testing sessions and produce research findings report
  4. Iterate (improve) on clickable prototypes with insights garnered from research findings report
  5. Identify and document existing processes or policies that will need to change to support the new product or service
  6. Produce a business proposal to justify funding for the next phase (Beta)
  7. Define a clear vision for the solution that will be built in Beta
  8. Create a plan and prioritized list of features to be completed in the Beta phase
  9. Define user solution, and delivery of KPIs

Delivery Phase 3) Beta:

The goal of Beta is to build a real service that works well for a larger group of people. The prototypes that were developed and tested during Alpha are used to build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) for deployment in a live, user-facing environment. Executed within the context of Scrum methodology, the UX Designer performs the following Agile ceremonies: Stand-up meetings, Sprint Planning, Backlog grooming, Reporting, Acceptance, and Retrospective.

The designers are at the spearhead of this methodology, creating and validating user stories for the developers (typical) one iteration ahead.

Deliverables:

  1. User story creation and validation:
    1. Participates in deciding which priority to tackle
    2. Sketching workshop to create visual representation of ideas or user flows
    3. Create designs
    4. Enhancements made to designs
    5. User Interviews (for validation)
    6. Synthesizing individual and overall interview findings
    7. Enhancements to designs made from synthesis
    8. Get product owner sign off and input story into backlog for future iteration planning
    9. Rinse and repeat for each feature, function within a given iteration
  2. Conduct accessibility compliance testing of the solution within each iteration.
  3. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the MVP built as part of the Beta phase.

Delivery Phase 4) Live:

Live begins when the service has reached a point of maturity and all of the main features in the backlog have been built. While most people understand the purpose of live, its not always given the attention and resources it deserves.

Continuous improvement is one of the core principles of service design and thats what live is all about. The goal is to continuously monitor, research, test and iterate for as long as the service is active.

Deliverables:

  1. Continue to facilitate user research activities to produce such outputs as:
  • User interview topic maps, a summary of interrelated topics for the user interview
  • User interview scripts to plan and guide user discussion
  • User interview synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
  • User research findings report
  1. Conduct regular accessibility compliance testing of the live build as improvements are released.
  2. Conduct regular usability testing sessions on the live build.
  3. Analyze usage analytics and user behaviour patterns to track and measure key performance indicators.

SkillsExperience and Skill Set Requirements

Sr. User Experience Designer Evaluation Criteria

User Experience Design 40%

  • Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design.
  • Ability to iterate your designs and solutions efficiently and intelligently.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in participating in complex projects (products) of different sizes, ensuring alignment to plans, best practices and incorporating user-centred design processes and agile (scrum) methodologies.
  • Degree or diploma in graphic design; degree or certification in usability, human-computer interaction, and technical writing a plus
  • Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing. Accessibility compliance testing is a plus.
  • Experience in facilitate User Research and Usability testing activities to produce such outputs as:
    • User Interview Topic Maps
    • User Interview Scripts
    • User Interview Synthesis (collection, aggregation and analysis) of written observations recorded during each interview
    • User Research Findings Report

Relationship Management - 20%

  • Demonstrated experience in communication and mediation skills with business teams and core team members to ensure Client projects (products) are progressing according to schedule
  • Experience with strategies and actions to overcome resistance to change and capitalize on forces in support of change during all stages of projects Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live or similar delivery methodologies
  • Ability to deliver on a (project) product with a balanced team (product owner, user experience designers, developers) by participating in Agile (SCRUM) delivery methodologies

Technical Skills - 30%

  • Expertise in UX software such as JustInMind, InVision, Sketch, Adobe Creative Cloud, Axure, Figma, and Zeplin. HTML5, CSS3, and JS skills (React, Angular, NodeJS), are a plus.

Soft skills - 10%

  • Ability to clearly and effectively communicate design processes, ideas, and solutions to teams and clients.
  • Be excited about collaborating and communicating closely with teams and other stakeholders via a distributed model to regularly deliver design solutions for approval.
  • Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Strong presentation, verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills


Must haves:

Extensive experience in using UX design best practices to design solutions, and a deep understanding of mobile-first and responsive design

jobs.description:
Manager Agentic AI


Location: Prague (Hybrid); Czech Republic (Remote); UK (Remote); Ghent (Hybrid)
Function: Software Engineering
Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence


About the role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences.


This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko.


You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable.

What you will do:

  • Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership.
  • Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform.
  • Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community.
  • Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks.
  • Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams.
  • Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production.
  • Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes.
  • Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement.

What we are looking for

  • Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership.
  • Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities.
  • Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks.
  • A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities.
  • Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict.

  • Central relationships: Established relationships with decision makers at HCSC, CareSource, Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan, Priority Health, Medica, HealthPartners, or comparable Central regional payers and IDNs strongly preferred

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment
  • Solid understanding of the Payer sector, including knowledge of Medical/Pharmacy Benefit Designs, current legislation, and Medicaid (Managed/FFS)
  • Excellent analytical skills and the ability to develop sound strategies in response to the current healthcare marketplace
  • Superior communication (oral and written) and teamwork skills to effectively contribute across cross-functional teams
  • Experience coordinating corporate payer strategy across parent and affiliate relationships, with clear ownership and regional execution responsibilities
  • Ability to understand and present complex clinical data for approved indications

The right candidate will have a strong sales mentality, excellent phone presence, sharp objection-handling skills, and a track record of exceeding quota in a fast-paced, highly transactional sales environment. Headquartered in Dallas, TX, Real Geeks is owned by Fidelity National Financial (NYSE: FNF), alongside other industry‑leading real estate technology companies.

Lead projects end-to-end

Deliver rigorous quantitative research

  • Manage Quant AI (BoltQ) projects end-to-end: questionnaire design, logic setup, automated analysis, and report storytelling.

  • Ensure all quant outputs are accurate, clearly structured, and meet client expectations for rigour and insight depth.

Craft strong research narratives

  • Produce output decks that combine analytical clarity with compelling storytelling — findings that clients can act on, not just read.

  • Translate complex quantitative outputs into clear strategic implications for non-technical audiences.

Drive innovation and process improvement

  • Contribute to the development of BoltChatAI and BoltQ by gathering client feedback and identifying improvement opportunities.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to enhance AI-driven research capabilities.

  • Develop and refine internal workflows to improve research efficiency and quality across the team.

Develop the team

  • Mentor and train junior researchers in both traditional and AI-assisted methodologies.

  • Foster a culture of learning, collaboration, and professional growth within the research team.

  • Provide input on team expansion and recruitment where needed.

What We're Looking For

Strong quantitative foundation — You've independently delivered complex quant projects — MaxDiff, conjoint, regression, factor analysis, segmentation — and you're comfortable with SPSS and advanced Excel. This isn't a nice to have; it's the core of the role.

End-to-end project ownership — You take full responsibility for delivery, from brief to debrief, and you don't need to be chased to keep things moving.

Client-facing confidence — You're comfortable leading client calls and building relationships. You listen carefully, communicate clearly, and know when to push back constructively.

Storytelling through data — You can turn a MaxDiff output or a regression model into a clear, compelling narrative that actually influences decisions.

AI research curiosity — You're open to — ideally already experienced with — AI-powered research tools. You understand their value and their limits.

Team player and mentor — You enjoy bringing junior colleagues on, sharing what you know, and building team capability over time.

A note on quantitative depth

We'll explore your quant experience directly in the interview process — not to catch you out, but because it matters for this role. We're looking for someone who has genuinely delivered advanced techniques (MaxDiff, conjoint, segmentation) independently, not just observed them. If there are areas where you'd benefit from development, be upfront — we invest in our people and we'd rather know where we can help than find gaps later.

  • Employee referral bonus – You get the chance to shape our team and be rewarded for bringing great people onboard.

  • Virtual or local team gatherings – Whether online or in person, we love to connect and celebrate our successes together.

  • In-house recognition awards – We celebrate our ‘lightning bolts’ (those who go above and beyond) and show our appreciation for hard work!

  • Annual Bonus System – If the company meets its targets, you’ll receive a bonus payment of up to two months’ salary! We win together.

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.excerpt: ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIESRequirements Engineering• Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
jobs.description:
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Requirements Engineering

  • Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
  • Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
  • Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
  • Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
  • Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

Domain coverage

You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:

  • Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
  • Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
  • Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
  • Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
  • Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
  • PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

Agentic AI specifics

  • Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
  • Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
  • Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
  • Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
  • Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance

  • Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:
    • 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
    • GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
    • GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
    • Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
    • Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
    • Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.

Position: Business Intelligence & Analytics Manager

Supervisors: Business Intelligence & Analytics Director and the

Job Type: Full-time

Job Description:

Under the direction of the Business Intelligence & Analytics Director, the Business Intelligence & Analytics Manager is responsible for supporting and executing the agency’s reporting, dashboarding, and analytics initiatives. This role partners cross-functionally with Client Services, Operations, and Field Leadership to ensure accurate reporting, actionable insights, and consistent KPI tracking.

This position is highly hands-on and focused on dashboard development, reporting optimization, data aggregation, data integrity, and analytics support to help drive operational and client success. The Business Intelligence & Analytics Manager will support the ongoing enhancement of reporting tools, data processes, and analytics workflows.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Client Services, Operations, and Field Leadership to support reporting and analytics initiatives
  • Serve as a key contributor to reporting, dashboard, and performance insight discussions across internal and client-facing teams
  • Support the development, maintenance, and optimization of reporting platforms used by field and internal teams
  • Create and manage Power BI dashboards, including client-facing reporting experiences and other assigned programs
  • Assist with dashboard enhancements, reporting scalability, and ongoing data cleanup
  • Aggregate, validate, and analyze data from multiple systems and data sources
  • Define and maintain reporting logic, KPI alignment, and reporting consistency across tool stacks
  • Support data quality assurance (QA), audits, documentation, and validation processes to ensure reporting accuracy and integrity
  • Manage raw data files, reporting inputs, integrations, and internal reporting systems
  • Assist with survey reporting, operational reporting, and performance tracking initiatives
  • Support KPI tracking, bonus reporting, and operational performance metrics as needed
  • Ensure reporting visuals, dashboard formatting, and usability remain clear, consistent, and user-friendly
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify reporting needs and opportunities for process improvements
  • Support ongoing analytics projects and additional responsibilities as assigned.

Skills/Knowledge:

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and operational reports
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and reporting deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Collaborative communication skills across cross-functional teams
  • Experience supporting KPI tracking, reporting initiatives, and operational analytics
  • Comfortable working with evolving reporting infrastructures and business processes
  • Strong understanding of dashboard usability, reporting presentation, and data visualization best practices
  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities for operational improvement through data analysis
  • Support a data-driven culture through collaboration, reporting consistency, and process improvement initiatives
  • Lead special projects and additional responsibilities as assigned

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 3–5+ years of experience in data analytics, BI/reporting, analytics operations, or related reporting functions
  • Experience aggregating and validating data across multiple systems and reporting sources
  • Understanding of KPI tracking, reporting cadence management, and operational reporting workflows
  • Ability to translate reporting requirements into scalable dashboards and actionable business insights
  • Experience working in fast-paced, multi-client, or evolving operational environments preferred
  • Strong organizational, communication, and project coordination skills
  • Experience supporting reporting tool implementations, optimizations, or enhancements preferred

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift 25 pounds at times.

Technology:

  • Experience working with Power BI, including dashboard creation, reporting maintenance, workspace management, and data visualization best practices
  • Experience with Tableau, SQL, and Python/R preferred

Work Schedule

  • Flexible scheduling
  • Must be available evenings & weekends.

Job Description:

PRINCIPAL AI AUTONOMY SYSTEMS INTEGRATOR (UAS / SWARMING / C2 / EDGE AI)

Hands‑On Engineering • Autonomous System Integration • Mission‑Thread Enablement

Itegrate autonomy software with real assets, validate behaviors in simulation and field environments, and ensure that autonomous agents act over trusted data, in real time, under real mission pressures.


MISSION & IMPACT

Autonomy Integration & System Engineering

  • Integrate autonomy stacks onto UAS, multi‑vehicle swarms, and robotic platforms, including navigation, perception, cooperative behaviors, and distributed decision-making.
  • Implement real‑time autonomy pipelines that incorporate sensing, fusion, planning, and control across diverse air/ground systems.
  • Adapt and optimize autonomy algorithms for constrained edge environments (embedded systems, GPUs/VPUs, tactical compute nodes).

Data‑ and Knowledge‑Aligned Autonomy

  • Build data pipelines and semantic alignment layers so autonomous systems operate against trusted, structured, and meaning‑preserving data representations.
  • Integrate autonomy with ontology-driven or schema-governed data models to ensure consistent entity tracking, mission-state representation, and decision context.
  • Enable retrieval‑grounded behaviors where autonomous agents act based on authoritative, updated, and fused situational information.

Edge Deployment Across Contested Environments

  • Deploy AI/ML models and autonomy services to edge compute environments (K3s/RKE2, containers, bare metal).
  • Harden autonomy behaviors for degraded communications, GPS denial, EW threats, sensor loss, and variable latency.
  • Implement resilient synchronization patterns between edge devices and enterprise/tactical nodes.

Simulation, Experimentation, and Field Testing

  • Conduct structured field experiments with unmanned vehicles, swarms, multi‑agent behaviors, and C2 workflows.
  • Validate mission‑thread performance across detection, tasking, coordination, and operator-in-the-loop behaviors.

Agentic Workflow Integration

  • Integrate agent frameworks enabling autonomy agents to plan, coordinate, task, and interact with mission tools and human operators.
  • Define safety gates, oversight mechanisms, and deterministic tool‑use patterns that support “human‑on‑the‑loop” operations.
  • Support multi‑agent cooperation through standard APIs and interoperable messaging patterns.

C2, Networks, and Cross‑Domain Integration

  • Integrate autonomous systems with tactical C2 platforms, data links, secure communications, and multi‑domain operational workflows.
  • Implement open standards (MOSA, SOSA, CMOSS, open messaging protocols) for plug‑and‑play component integration.
  • Enable interoperability across joint, partner‑nation, and coalition environments with appropriate policy controls.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build full autonomy pipelines end‑to‑end, from sensing through action execution.
  • Deploy CV, tracking, SLAM, pattern‑learning, anomaly detection, and cooperative‑agent models on real unmanned systems.
  • Integrate heterogeneous sensors, radios, and payloads with autonomy decision loops.
  • Conduct troubleshooting and rapid problem resolution across autonomy software, embedded systems, edge clusters, and C2 interfaces.
  • Translate mission problems into executable autonomy behaviors and scenario‑specific workflows.
  • Train teams and mission personnel on system configuration, safety, deployment, and best practices.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Core Background

  • Education: BA/BS or equivalent
  • Experience: 10+ years in unmanned systems, autonomy engineering, robotics integration, or embedded AI/ML deployment.
  • Direct experience integrating autonomy into UAS, drones, swarms, robotic vehicles, or similar platforms.
  • Strong proficiency in C++, Python, and real‑time/embedded software patterns.

Technical Expertise

  • Autonomy functions: motion planning, cooperative behaviors, obstacle avoidance, distributed coordination, sensor fusion, and real‑time decision-making.
  • Robotics frameworks: ROS/ROS2, PX4/ArduPilot, MAVLink, simulation tools (Gazebo, AirSim, custom environments).
  • AI/ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, JAX.
  • Edge compute: NVIDIA Jetson, VPUs, ruggedized x86 nodes, tactical accelerators.
  • Containerization and DevSecOps: Docker, Kubernetes (K3s/RKE2), GitLab CI, ArgoCD.
  • Interoperability standards: open architectures, modular interfaces, secure API design.

Domain Understanding

  • Experience supporting C2 integration, tactical networks, and degraded-communication workflows.
  • Understanding of multi‑domain mission threads such as ISR, counter‑UAS, logistics autonomy, multi-agent coordination, and decision-support.
  • Experience designing resilient behavior under environmental, adversarial, and operational stressors.

Security Requirements

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Top Secret/SCI Required to start

DESIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with distributed track fusion, detection/classification pipelines, or multi-sensor correlation.
  • Familiarity with mission‑partner interoperability and cross‑domain data release patterns.
  • Experience implementing provenance, auditability, and safety‑bounded autonomy behaviors.
  • Background in private 5G, tactical mesh networking, or mobile operations centers.

WHY THIS ROLE IS UNIQUE

This Principal-level role is tailored for someone who:

  • Builds autonomy that works in real field conditions, not just in demos.
  • Bridges AI models, mission data, and real unmanned systems.
  • Ensures autonomous behaviors are grounded in trusted, structured information.
  • Understands both the engineering and the operational realities of deploying autonomy at scale.
  • Can integrate across sensors, payloads, compute, C2, and enterprise systems.

You are the person who makes autonomous systems reliable, interoperable, safe, and mission-ready.


GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your sense of ownership and pride in the meaningful work we do.

jobs.description:
Our Story:
Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.
As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our product portfolio and go-to-market approach, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Product Marketing to build CPI's Product Marketing capability and help translate customer, market, and product insight into clearer positioning, stronger commercialization, and better go-to-market decisions.
This is a builder-doer role. You'll help shape how Product Marketing works at CPI, but you'll also personally do much of the work: developing positioning and messaging, working through portfolio and packaging questions, building commercialization plans, translating customer research into recommendations, and creating the tools teams need to bring our offerings to market.
You'll work closely with Product and Marketing leadership and lead a team spanning Industry Marketing and Customer Insights. We're looking for someone who moves quickly, learns fast, asks good questions, and is excited to build alongside the team rather than inherit an established Product Marketing function.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute Product Marketing
  • Develop positioning, messaging, value propositions, buyer stories, and commercialization strategies for CPI's priority products and audiences.
  • Personally create early Product Marketing deliverables and frameworks while establishing repeatable approaches the broader team can use over time.
  • Partner with Product and revenue leadership to evaluate and develop recommendations across the commercial mix, including product and portfolio structure, pricing and packaging, routes to market and buying experience, and how offerings are positioned and promoted.
  • Execute priority pricing and packaging work, bringing together customer value, competitive context, market insight, business economics, and buying behavior to develop and pressure-test recommendations.
  • Translate product capabilities and roadmap investments into clear customer value, market opportunities, and go-to-market recommendations.
Turn Customer & Market Insight into Action
  • Direct the Senior Manager, Customer Insights to identify the customer, buyer, market, and competitive questions CPI needs to answer and ensure research informs commercial decisions.
  • Synthesize customer, market, competitive, and commercial information into useful recommendations for segmentation, positioning, product strategy, commercialization, and go-to-market priorities.
  • Lead CPI's industry marketing approach across healthcare and education, working with Industry Marketing Managers to translate market dynamics, buyer needs, industry trends, and product strategy into differentiated industry positioning and go-to-market priorities.
  • Develop the team's ability to become true industry experts, connecting ongoing market learning, customer insight, Sales feedback, and external trends to the work CPI brings to market.
  • Develop evidence-based understanding of priority segments, buyers, needs, use cases, buying dynamics, and competitive alternatives and translate it into practical tools for Product, Marketing, and Sales.
Bring Products & Offerings to Market
  • Develop and execute commercialization plans for priority launches, product changes, and market opportunities in close partnership with Product, Demand Generation, Sales, and other teams.
  • Build and put into practice a repeatable commercialization and launch process, including launch tiering and readiness criteria, that helps CPI determine the appropriate level of go-to-market support based on customer impact, commercial opportunity, and organizational readiness.
  • Create the positioning, messaging, buyer insights, competitive context, sales stories, and core enablement materials customer-facing teams need to effectively bring offerings to market.
  • Work with Industry Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, Program Management, and other teams to bring priority offerings to market and use results and feedback to improve future launches.
Build the Capability While Doing the Work
  • Lead and develop Industry Marketing and Customer Insights, working alongside the team to establish what strong Product Marketing and market-led decision-making look like.
  • Help clarify roles, processes, and ways of working across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success as CPI builds a more disciplined commercialization model.
  • Take on priority commercial problems alongside Product and Marketing leadership, quickly moving from ambiguity to analysis, recommendation, and execution.
  • Use AI, external expertise, and new ways of working to move quickly, increase the team's capabilities, and solve unfamiliar problems.
You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience across Product Marketing, Product Management, Customer/Market Insights, Go-to-Market Strategy, Commercialization, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience, including experience building teams, functions, or new organizational capabilities.
  • Demonstrated success building or transforming Product Marketing capabilities in an organization where product architecture, segmentation, positioning, commercialization, or go-to-market disciplines were evolving.
  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, segmentation, go-to-market plans, commercialization materials, and pricing or packaging recommendations for complex B2B products or service.
  • Comfortable getting into the work, learning what you don’t know, and developing recommendations rather than handing the problem to someone else.
  • Ability to quickly learn an unfamiliar market or product, synthesize customer, competitive, product, and business information, and turn it into clear recommendations or deliverables.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving Product Marketing capabilities and working alongside a team while creating greater structure, discipline, and clarity.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment where roles and processes are still evolving.
We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and launching and commercializing complex B2B products, services, or solutions.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Sales.
  • Experience working across pricing and packaging, portfolio strategy, customer or market research, sales enablement, or AI-enabled ways of working.
What We Offer:
  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule
  • Paid Parental Leave

Stellen Sie sich eine Rolle vor, in der Ihre SAP SD Expertise nicht im Tagesgeschäft versickert, sondern spürbar Wirkung entfaltet. Ein Umfeld, in dem Sie Beschaffungsprozesse so gestalten können, dass sie in einer Organisation mit hunderten Märkten jeden Tag messbaren Unterschied machen.

Genau dort sucht unser Mandant – ein führendes, bekanntes deutsches Handelsunternehmen – Verstärkung in seinem internen Team als


SAP SD / Retail Inhouse (Senior) Berater (m/w/d)
wahlweise im Rheinland oder deutschlandweit aufgrund einer sehr arbeitnehmerfreundlichen Home-Office Regelung.
Warum diese Rolle gerade für erfahrene SD ExpertInnen interessant ist:

Sie landen nicht in einer endlosen Transformations-PowerPoint-Welt, sondern in einem kleinen, seniorigen Team, das seit Jahren gewachsen ist und pragmatisch arbeitet. Entscheidungen entstehen aus fachlicher Notwendigkeit, nicht aus politischer Dynamik. Es gibt kein Micromanagement, keine Silos, keine künstliche Hektik.

Sie arbeiten eigenständig, mit kurzen Wegen und realem Einfluss. Das Ganze auf Wunsch auch vertraglich zugesichert überwiegend remote. Etwa zwölf Präsenztage im Jahr reichen aus, um Workshops, Abstimmungen und Teamtermine sinnvoll zu begleiten.


Die Aufgabe: was Sie prägt

Sie bewegen sich fachlich klar im SAP-SD-Umfeld mit Fokus auf Kundenauftrags- und Vertriebsprozesse. Gleichzeitig gestalten Sie die Benutzer- und Rollenstrukturen, über die diese Prozesse im Alltag genutzt werden.

Konkret bedeutet das:
  • Sie beraten Fachbereiche, Entwickler und Product Owner und übersetzen fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige SD-Lösungen.
  • Sie verantworten Aufbau, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der SAP Build Work Zone, insbesondere Spaces, Pages, Rollen, Kataloge und Target Mappings über den SAP Content Manager bzw. das Fiori Launchpad.
  • Sie stellen sicher, dass Anwender genau die Anwendungen sehen, die sie für ihre Arbeit benötigen.
  • Sie begleiten Tests, Rollouts und Dokumentation in einem agilen Umfeld und sorgen für saubere Übergänge in den Betrieb.
  • Sie wirken aktiv an der S/4HANA-Transformation mit, ohne den Blick für den produktiven Alltag zu verlieren.

Sie sind dabei weder reiner Konzepter noch klassischer Ticketsachbearbeiter. Sie verbinden Prozessverständnis, Systemkenntnis und Nutzerperspektive. Und sehen unmittelbar, wie Ihre Arbeit im Alltag wirkt.


Was Sie mitbringen sollten

  • Starkes Fundament in SAP-Prozessen rund um Kundenauftragsprozesse und SAP SD
  • Erfahrung mit Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepten, idealerweise im Kontext von Fiori sowie Spaces & Pages
  • Freude an strukturierter Prozessarbeit und daran, Komplexität beherrschbar zu machen
  • Erfahrung in agilen Projekt- oder Produktumfeldern ist hilfreich
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher (mind. C1 Level)

Branchenkenntnisse aus dem Handel oder im Rahmen einer S/4HANA-Transformation sind vorteilhaft, aber keine harte Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist Ihre fachliche Tiefe und Ihr Anspruch an Qualität.


Warum sich ein Wechsel lohnen kann

  • Echte Remote-Freiheit:Arbeiten Sie von überall, solange Sie für ca. 12 Tage/Jahr präsent sein können.
  • Stabile Organisation mit klarer Modernisierungsstrategie, ohne Transformations-Dauerstress
  • Ein kleines, senioriges Team: Kein politisches Labyrinth, kein Silodenken.
  • Arbeitszeit, die zu Ihrem Leben passt:37,5-h-Woche, flexible Zeiten, 30 Urlaubstage.
  • Unbefristet, langfristig, realistisch: Keine Luftschlösser – nur ein Umfeld, das Verlässlichkeit schätzt.

Der vielleicht wichtigste Punkt: Sie arbeiten in einem Umfeld, das nicht überladen ist. Verantwortung ist klar verteilt, Unterstützung selbstverständlich und fachliche Qualität wichtiger als Lautstärke.

​

Wenn Sie SAP SD nicht nur betreiben, sondern Prozesse und Benutzererlebnisse aktiv gestalten möchten, dann sollten wir sprechen. Gerne völlig unverbindlich im ersten Schritt.

Position Summary

The Director, Client Services, is a professional services leader responsible for the successful delivery of assigned accounts, programs, and projects across Red Clay's Delivery Practice. This role ensures engagements are completed on time, within budget, and to a standard of quality that drives client satisfaction and reference-ability. Serving as an Engagement Partner for identified client accounts, the Director partners with peer leaders and domain experts to sustain and expand long-term client relationships. In coordination with Executive Leadership, this role supports profitable, scalable growth through consistent delivery excellence and may contribute to business development efforts in support of net new client pursuits.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

The following duties are representative of the work performed in this role. Other duties may be assigned as business needs to evolve.

Account/Project Performance and Operational Excellence

  • Own and deliver assigned projects to successful completion, ensuring adherence to the approved baseline, budget, schedule, scope, as sold margin, and all defined project KPIs

  • Supports the evolution, standardization, adoption, and efficiencies across the PMO organization

  • Knowledgeable of other methodology and implementation options in the industry, and able to support clients on the selection and implementation of those

  • Responsible for the Statements of Work, P&L, Change orders, project reporting, accuracy of KPIs, and invoice collections across assigned projects

  • Clear understanding of company financial models, pricing sheets, revenue, and margin goals

  • Enforce operating standards, methodologies, and best practices for delivery

  • Proactively monitor performance of assigned engagements and take action to protect project profit margins, outcomes, and client relationships

  • Inform and collaborate with the Delivery Executive for assigned engagements to ensure escalation, key decisions, and risks are communicated and handled appropriately

  • Improve project profit margins through standardization, documentation, creation of new collateral, reuse of assets, and operational discipline

  • Adopt Reddy AI agents and other proprietary tools to enhance service quality and delivery efficiency as applicable to assigned projects

  • Collaborate with the PMO to facilitate continuous improvement opportunities and standardization across the management of Advisory and Implementation projects

  • Presents and participates at industry events to showcase Red Clay's brand of Delivery excellence

Business Development – Sales Support

  • Participate in key sales pursuits, oral demonstrations, and executive presentations as assigned

Business Development – Account Expansion

  • Serve as an Account Owner/Engagement Partner for identified client accounts, driving account expansion by growing sold revenue (“bookings”) and realizing that revenue at or above agreed-upon targets

  • Interact with clients at the executive level and carry the perception of a leader across all levels of the client's organization

  • Understand the needs, roadmaps, challenges, and success opportunities for identified client accounts and position Red Clay as the preferred provider by connecting client needs to Red Clay's service offerings across practices and domains

  • Identify, qualify, and secure account expansion opportunities utilizing tools such as CRM and Kantata, as well as established Account Owner processes

  • Design and lead the contracting and negotiation process in a manner favorable to Red Clay's intended outcomes with the support of Practice leadership

  • Ensure all account expansion opportunities are aligned with capabilities, capacity, project profit margin targets, and corporate objectives by partnering and confirming with Practice Leadership

  • Maintain relationships with senior client executives within identified accounts to support long-term, multi-domain growth

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or related field; equivalent professional experience considered

  • 8+ years of professional services or consulting experience, including program/project management and client account ownership

  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-workstream engagements on time and on budget with measurable client outcomes

  • Strong command of project financial management including P&L, margin analysis, SOW development, and change order management

  • Proven ability to build executive-level client relationships and drive account expansion, including identifying, qualifying, and closing growth opportunities

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent project/program management certification

  • Experience in a Director or equivalent leadership role within a consulting or advisory firm

  • Familiarity with PSA/project management tools such as Kantata and CRM platforms; experience with AI-enabled delivery tools a plus

Core Competencies

  • Ability to lead complex Program/Project engagements with on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes

  • Command of project financial management paired with experience supporting sales and driving account expansion

  • Ability to build and maintain executive-level client relationships that drive satisfaction and account expansion

  • Ability to partner effectively across practices, functions, and leadership levels

  • Clear, confident communication with the ability to influence stakeholders and present to clients

  • Oracle Energy & Water Program implementation experience

  • Business Development background & Sales methodology experience

Success Characteristics

Client Relationship Mastery

A successful Director, Client Services builds and sustains trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders. They anticipate client needs before they are voiced, navigate complex organizational dynamics with ease, and consistently deliver commitments in ways that deepen loyalty and expand engagement.

Strategic Business Development Mindset

Success means identifying whitespace opportunities, connecting client challenges to practice capabilities, and actively contributing to pipeline development and proposal efforts. They think like a business owner, not just a service manager.

Delivery Excellence & Accountability

They hold themselves and their teams to high delivery standards. A successful director ensures engagements are scoped clearly, staffed appropriately, and executed with quality and efficiency. They course-correct proactively when engagements drift and protect both client outcomes and firm margins.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

They work fluidly across practice areas, operations, and leadership. They break down silos, connect dots between teams, and rally internal resources in service of client success — without needing formal authority to get things done.

Operational & Commercial Acumen

They understand the business of consulting utilization, margins, SOW management, and revenue recognition. They use tools like Kantata and CRM platforms fluently to keep delivery and business development data clean, current, and actionable.

Adaptive Communication

They flex their communication style for the audience, executive briefings, client workshops, internal stakeholders, or at-risk conversations. They are clear, credible, and composed, even in high-stakes situations.

Outcomes Orientation

They define success in terms of measurable client impact, not just activity. They set clear KPIs, track progress rigorously, and hold the line on scope in ways that protect value for both the client and the firm.

Resilience & Composure Under Pressure

Consulting engagements rarely go exactly to plan. A successful director stays steady when things get complicated, resourceful, solution-focused, and calm in moments that would unsettle a less seasoned leader.

Integrity & Professional Credibility

They show up consistently, follow through, and tell clients the truth.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This role operates primarily in a professional remote environment. The position requires the ability to work at a computer for extended periods and may involve travel to client sites, industry events, and Red Clay office locations as needed. Some evening or weekend availability may be required during critical project phases or business development activities.

jobs.description:
Our Story:

Crisis Prevention Institute, Inc. (CPI) is the worldwide leader in evidence‑based de‑escalation and crisis prevention training and dementia care services. Our programs teach professionals the skills to recognize, prevent, and respond to crises in the workplace. Since 1980, we’ve helped train more than 17 million people across service‑oriented industries including education, health care, behavioral health, long‑term care, human services, security, corporate, and retail.
At CPI, we are dedicated to changing behaviors and reducing conflict for the Care, Welfare, Safety, and Security of everyone. We believe empathy, meaningful connections, personal safety, and security are the antidotes to fear and anxiety. This philosophy is central to everything we do and traces back to our beginning.

As a member of the team, you can expect to:
  • Make a difference through your work — You’ll be proud to tell your family and friends what you do.
  • Gain significant career experience within a fast‑growing organization — From entry‑level roles to executive leadership.
  • Feel fulfilled and have fun — We work hard but make time to build meaningful relationships and celebrate wins.
The Role:
As we evolve our marketing organization, we're looking for a hands-on Director of Demand Generation to build a more modern, integrated approach to creating and converting demand.

This is a builder-doer role. You'll set the direction for CPI's demand generation function, but you'll also be deeply involved in doing the work: developing campaigns, building ABM programs, designing audience journeys, digging into performance, partnering with Sales, and showing the team what great demand generation looks like. Many of the capabilities required for a mature demand engine, including segmentation, data, technology, lifecycle infrastructure, and measurement, are being built in parallel, so you'll need to make meaningful progress with what exists today while helping define what comes next.

Over time, the role will evolve as our capabilities, team, data, and technology mature. Initially, we're looking for someone who is excited to build while doing, not someone expecting to lead an already-established demand generation engine.

What You Get to Do Every Day:

Build & Execute CPI’s Demand Strategy
  • Develop and execute demand plans across priority markets, audiences, accounts, and revenue opportunities, connecting integrated campaigns, always-on programs, ABM, lifecycle marketing, events, paid media, content, and organic channels.
  • Personally build early programs alongside the team, from audience and journey development through briefs, activation, testing, measurement, and optimization.
  • Make recommendations about where CPI should invest, test, scale, change, or stop based on business opportunity and performance.
  • Establish the planning processes, channel frameworks and operating rhythms that allow the function to become increasingly sophisticated over time.
Build Toward Account-Based & Audience-Led Demand
  • Build CPI toward a scalable ABM capability, partnering with Sales, Product Marketing, Industry Marketing, and Marketing Operations to establish the audiences, account strategies, processes, and infrastructure required over time.
  • Develop and execute practical early account-based plays using the capabilities and data available today, while identifying what needs to be built to enable more sophisticated ABM.
  • As CPI’s segmentation, ICPs, buyer insights, account data, and technology mature, translate them into increasingly sophisticated audience, buying-group, journey, and activation strategies.
  • Build strong day-to-day alignment with Sales around priority accounts and opportunities, account engagement, demand quality, follow-up, and what Marketing is learning.
Build Integrated Campaigns & Audience Journeys
  • Personally lead the development of integrated campaign plans. Own the integrated campaign architecture and customer journey, bringing together the market, audience, message, content, channel, conversion, and measurement inputs required to create and convert demand.
  • Connect content, paid media, organic social, sponsored programs, events, email, web, sales activation, and other touchpoints into a cohesive journey rather than a collection of channel tactics.
  • Work alongside the team on early campaigns to establish strong briefs, content and journey plans, channel roles, measurement, and ways of working that can become repeatable over time.
Measure, Learn & Build the Team
  • Dig into program and audience performance to understand what's working, what isn't, and what CPI should do differently, even while our measurement capabilities are still evolving.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to build toward stronger visibility into qualified demand, account engagement, opportunities, pipeline, revenue, and marketing efficiency.
  • Lead and develop a team spanning performance marketing, content, design, and events, working alongside them to establish what good looks like and build their capabilities.
  • Determine where AI, agencies, technology, and external specialists can increase the team's capabilities, quality, and speed.

You Need to Have:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Product Management, or related field
  • 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in demand generation, growth marketing, integrated marketing, or revenue marketing.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
  • Experience building and executing integrated demand programs across multiple channels and knowledge how to move from audience and business opportunity through activation, conversion, measurement, and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience building account-based programs and working with Sales around target accounts, buying groups, engagement, and pipeline.
  • Experience with complex, multi-stakeholder B2B purchases rather than primarily transactional lead generation.
  • Experience building or significantly evolving a demand generation capability in an imperfect environment.
  • Experience creating structure where it doesn’t exist, developing people while working alongside them, and making progress without pristine data, technology, processes, or attribution.

We’d Love to See:
  • Experience leading a team and managing meaningful marketing investment, agencies, and external partners.
  • Strong analytical judgement and cross-functional leadership.
  • Familiarity with lifecycle marketing, conversion optimization, and modern AI-enabled marketing practices.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation package
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401k
  • PTO
  • Health & Wellness Days
  • Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Continuing education and training
  • Hybrid / Remote work schedule

jobs.description:
Vericast is investing in the next generation of Advanced Analytics, Experimentation, and Measurement, and we're looking for a Principal Data Scientist to help lead the way. This is a highly visible opportunity for a data science leader who thrives at the intersection of experimentation, causal inference, machine learning, and Generative AI.

In this role, you'll shape our analytics discipline from the ground up, partnering with executive leaders and cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges with data. You'll design rigorous experimentation frameworks, build and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions, and transform complex insights into clear recommendations that drive growth and measurable business impact.

This is a senior individual contributor role that offers the opportunity to influence strategy, establish best practices, mentor other data scientists, and leave a lasting mark on how Vericast leverages data to make decisions.

What You'll Do

Lead Experimentation & Measurement Strategy (40%)

  • Own the end-to-end design, execution, and analysis of marketing and product experiments, including A/B, multivariate, geo, and holdout testing.
  • Define and manage the experimentation roadmap, including hypothesis development, prioritization, power analysis, and success metrics.
  • Develop and refine methodologies for lift measurement, incrementality testing, and causal inference.
  • Establish standards, governance, and best practices that ensure statistical rigor and actionable insights across the organization.
  • Partner with stakeholders to build a culture of experimentation and data-driven decision making.

Drive Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning & GenAI Innovation (40%)

  • Design, build, validate, and deploy machine learning and Generative AI solutions using large-scale structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop predictive, prescriptive, attribution, market mix, and uplift models that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Lead hands-on model development, coding, testing, and production deployment while establishing technical standards for the broader team.
  • Create and maintain robust data pipelines to ensure data quality, integrity, and scalability.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and analytical approaches to improve performance and business value.

Influence the Business Through Strategic Partnership (20%)

  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, and Compliance teams to identify, prioritize, and solve high-value business opportunities.
  • Translate complex business challenges into testable hypotheses and analytical solutions.
  • Present findings and recommendations to both technical and executive audiences in a clear and compelling way.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on experimentation, analytics, AI, and machine learning.
  • Mentor and elevate fellow data scientists through coaching, technical guidance, and best-practice sharing.

Education

  • Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field required.

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning roles with significant hands-on experience working with large-scale data environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders and partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver data-driven insights and recommendations.

What Will Make You Successful

Experimentation, Measurement & Statistical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in marketing experimentation, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, experimental design, metric development, and lift/incrementality measurement.
  • Strong background in causal inference methodologies, hypothesis testing, statistical modeling, and power analysis.
  • Proven ability to design, execute, validate, and scale experimentation programs that enable confident business decision-making.
  • Experience establishing governance, best practices, and standards for experimentation across an organization.

Machine Learning, GenAI & Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying Market Mix Models (MMM), Attribution Models, and Uplift Models.
  • Strong experience working with Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI solutions, and emerging agent-based frameworks such as LangChain, LangSmith, or similar technologies.
  • Expertise in machine learning techniques including clustering, classification, regression, neural networks, anomaly detection, recommendation engines, and predictive modeling.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python, Spark/PySpark, and SQL.
  • Experience working with modern cloud-based data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar data lake environments.
  • Experience building and deploying solutions within AWS and Azure cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with containerization and development tools including Kubernetes, Docker, and Git.
  • Experience with data visualization and business intelligence tools, with Tableau preferred.
  • Familiarity with data science platforms such as Dataiku is a plus.

Leadership & Communication

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments while driving clarity, prioritization, and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into practical, executive-level recommendations.
  • Experience mentoring and providing technical leadership to data scientists and analytics professionals.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven success collaborating across Product, Marketing, Sales, IT, Risk, Compliance, and other business functions.
  • Passion for fostering a data-driven culture built on rigorous experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Salary Range: $170,000 - $200,000

Position is eligible for an annual bonus incentive program

We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, a heritage of innovation and a focus on workplace flexibility.

Description

We are hiring a Senior DFT Engineer in Europe to own Design-for-Test on customer SoCs end-to-end: DFT architecture, scan/ATPG, memory BIST, boundary scan, pattern validation and production test hand-off.

  • Formal equivalence checking.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced-node experience (7nm and below).
  • Python for flow automation.
