jobs.description:
CONTROLLER

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP)

Remote | Full-Time | Exempt

Travel: Approximately 20% National Travel
Compensation: $170,000–$200,000 Base Salary DOE + Performance Bonus

ABOUT ALLIED ROOFING PARTNERS

Allied Roofing Partners (ARP) is one of the fastest-growing residential exterior services platforms in the United States. We partner with established roofing and exterior home improvement companies and provide the financial, operational, technology, HR, and strategic resources needed to help them continue to grow.

ARP operates a growing multi-brand, multi-entity, multi-state organization that includes residential roofing, insurance restoration, siding, gutters, and other exterior home services.

Our continued growth is driven by a combination of organic expansion and strategic acquisitions. As new companies join the ARP portfolio, our Corporate Accounting team plays a critical role in integrating those businesses, standardizing financial processes, strengthening controls, and providing leadership with accurate and timely financial information.

We are seeking an experienced Controller who can help lead that effort.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

POSITION SUMMARY

The Controller will oversee core accounting and financial reporting across the Allied Roofing Partners portfolio while playing a significant role in acquisition integration, multi-entity consolidation, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, financial controls, forecasting, and team development.

This is not a Controller position focused on maintaining a single company's accounting function.CFO, Accounting Manager, Senior Accountants, M&A and integration teams, operating company leadership, and executive management.

The successful candidate must be comfortable operating within a growing multi-brand environment, integrating newly acquired businesses, consolidating financial results across multiple entities, and creating consistent accounting standards and processes across the organization.

This individual will work closely with the

The Controller will also provide leadership and development to an accounting organization that includes an Accounting Manager and multiple Senior Accountants supporting ARP's operating brands.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUST-HAVE EXPERIENCE

Candidates should have direct, hands-on experience in ALL or the majority of the following areas:

Acquisition Integration

  • Direct experience integrating newly acquired companies into an existing accounting and financial reporting structure
  • Experience assessing acquired-company accounting processes and identifying gaps
  • Ability to implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, controls, and reporting expectations following an acquisition
  • Experience working with local accounting teams during post-acquisition integration

Multi-Entity Accounting & Consolidations

  • Experience managing accounting across multiple companies, brands, subsidiaries, or operating entities
  • Hands-on experience preparing and/or reviewing consolidated financial statements
  • Experience standardizing financial reporting across multiple entities
  • Ability to manage multiple close processes and reporting deadlines simultaneously

Percentage-of-Completion Accounting & Job Costing

  • Strong understanding and practical experience with percentage-of-completion accounting
  • Hands-on experience with job costing and WIP reporting
  • Ability to review job-level profitability, estimated costs, margins, and revenue recognition
  • Experience identifying job-costing discrepancies and working with Operations to resolve them

QuickBooks

  • Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online
  • Ability to work across multiple QuickBooks entities
  • Experience improving accounting processes and reporting within QuickBooks environments

Month-End Close & GAAP

  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP
  • Experience owning and leading the monthly and year-end close process
  • Strong balance sheet reconciliation and general ledger experience
  • Ability to establish close calendars, deadlines, review processes, and accountability across an accounting team
  • Experience preparing and reviewing accurate monthly financial statements

External Audit Leadership

  • Experience leading an external financial statement audit
  • Ability to coordinate audit requests, supporting schedules, documentation, and communication with external auditors
  • Experience ensuring accounting records and supporting documentation are audit-ready

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Experience developing and managing annual budgets and financial forecasts
  • Ability to analyze actual results against budget and forecast
  • Experience identifying financial trends and communicating meaningful variances to leadership
  • Strong understanding of cash forecasting and financial planning

Team Leadership & Development

  • Proven experience managing, mentoring, and developing accounting professionals
  • Ability to review the work of Senior Accountants and other accounting team members
  • Experience providing coaching, feedback, training, and accountability
  • Ability to build stronger accounting capabilities as the organization grows

Internal Controls

  • Experience developing, implementing, and improving internal controls
  • Ability to identify control weaknesses and implement appropriate solutions
  • Experience developing accounting policies, procedures, and SOPs
  • Strong understanding of financial risk and segregation of duties

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee general ledger and accounting operations across multiple ARP brands and entities
  • Lead accurate and timely monthly and year-end close processes
  • Prepare and review monthly financial statements and consolidated management reporting
  • Ensure accounting practices comply with GAAP and established ARP accounting policies
  • Review balance sheet reconciliations and ensure appropriate resolution of outstanding items
  • Oversee AP, AR, cash management, and other core accounting functions
  • Monitor cash balances and support short- and long-term cash forecasting
  • Oversee commission accounting and processing
  • Prepare monthly Financial Reporting Packages and support Monthly Operating Reviews
  • Improve reporting processes and identify opportunities for automation

Multi-Entity Consolidation

  • Oversee financial reporting across ARP's growing portfolio of operating companies
  • Review individual entity financial results and consolidated reporting
  • Ensure consistent accounting methodology across operating companies
  • Identify and resolve intercompany and consolidation issues
  • Establish scalable reporting processes as additional companies join ARP

Percentage-of-Completion & Job Costing

  • Provide oversight of percentage-of-completion accounting across applicable ARP brands
  • Review job costing, WIP schedules, percent-complete calculations, and revenue recognition
  • Analyze job margins and identify significant variances or unusual trends
  • Partner with Operations and accounting teams to improve job-cost accuracy
  • Help standardize job-costing and POC processes across the organization

M&A & Acquisition Integration

  • Partner with the CFO and M&A/integration teams during acquisitions
  • Assist with financial due diligence and pre-close accounting assessments
  • Help transition newly acquired companies into ARP's financial reporting structure
  • Implement standardized accounting policies, procedures, SOPs, and internal controls
  • Support migration and standardization within QuickBooks Online and other financial systems
  • Establish appropriate close processes and reporting expectations for newly acquired companies
  • Work directly with local accounting teams during the integration process
  • Provide training and ongoing support following acquisition

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead and support annual budgeting and forecasting processes
  • Analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts
  • Review KPIs, margins, job costing, backlog, cash flow, and operating performance
  • Identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Translate financial results into actionable information for operating and executive leadership
  • Support financial dashboards and management reporting

Internal Controls & Process Improvement

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve internal controls
  • Establish standardized accounting policies and procedures across ARP brands
  • Identify gaps in existing accounting processes and implement solutions
  • Improve financial reporting accuracy and efficiency
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes
  • Help build a scalable accounting infrastructure capable of supporting continued acquisition growth

Accounting Team Leadership

  • Provide leadership and financial oversight to an Accounting Manager and multiple Senior Accountants supporting ARP's operating brands
  • Review financial schedules and accounting work for accuracy and completeness
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability around close and reporting deadlines
  • Coach and develop accounting team members
  • Identify development opportunities and help team members expand their capabilities
  • Build a strong, scalable Corporate Accounting organization capable of supporting ARP's continued growth

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • Previous Controller, Assistant Controller, Accounting Manager, or comparable senior accounting leadership experience
  • Acquisition integration experience
  • Multi-entity/multi-brand accounting experience
  • Financial consolidation experience
  • Percentage-of-completion accounting experience
  • Strong job-costing experience
  • QuickBooks Online experience
  • Strong knowledge of GAAP and month-end close
  • Experience leading an external financial statement audit
  • Experience with budgeting and forecasting
  • Experience managing and developing accounting professionals
  • Experience developing and implementing internal controls
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote, multi-company environment
  • Ability to travel nationally approximately 20% as needed

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Accounting leadership experience within construction, roofing, exterior home improvement, restoration, or another project/job-cost-based industry
  • Roofing industry experience is especially valuable
  • Experience working within a private equity-backed organization
  • Experience in a high-growth, acquisition-focused environment
  • Experience integrating multiple acquisitions
  • Experience building scalable accounting processes within a rapidly growing organization
  • Experience working with CRM, ERP, reporting, and business intelligence platforms

Private equity-backed experience is preferred but is NOT required.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

The successful Controller will be someone who can move comfortably between high-level financial leadership and hands-on accounting execution.

You should be able to review consolidated financial results with executive leadership, lead an external audit, coach a Senior Accountant, troubleshoot a job-costing issue, improve a month-end close process, and help integrate the accounting function of a newly acquired business.

You will be joining an organization that is continuing to grow, which means processes and systems will continue to evolve.

We are looking for someone who can build structure rather than simply operate within an existing structure.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base Salary: $170,000–$200,000 DOE

Additional Compensation: Performance Bonus

ARP offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid company holidays
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHY JOIN ALLIED ROOFING PARTNERS?

This is an opportunity to take on a highly visible financial leadership position within a rapidly growing organization.

As ARP continues to acquire and integrate successful roofing and exterior home improvement companies, the Controller will have a direct impact on how we integrate businesses, develop accounting teams, strengthen internal controls, improve reporting, standardize processes, and build a scalable financial infrastructure.

You will work directly with executive leadership while helping shape the accounting organization needed to support ARP's next stage of growth.

If you have experience with acquisition integration, multi-entity accounting and consolidations, percentage-of-completion accounting, job costing, QuickBooks, GAAP financial reporting, external audits, forecasting, and building strong accounting teams, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today to join Allied Roofing Partners.

Salary: 170k-200k

jobs.title: YouTube-Skriptautor & Social Media Manager – Krypto, Trading & Storytelling
jobs.excerpt: Über Yunicorn und TrademaniaYunicorn ist ein Company Builder, der profitable Geschäftsmodelle baut und skaliert.
jobs.description:
Über Yunicorn und Trademania

Yunicorn ist ein Company Builder, der profitable Geschäftsmodelle baut und skaliert. Wir arbeiten mit Gründern und Unternehmen zusammen, um sie durch operative Expertise und gezielte Investments zu Marktführern zu machen. Für eines der Unternehmen (Trademania) verstärken wir jetzt das Content-Team:

Schwerpunkt: Trading-News & Krypto, Erklärvideos und investigative Geschichten – mit starkem Storytelling und Fokus auf Zuschauerbindung.

Du findest starke Geschichten, verstehst Krypto und Trading und kannst aktuelle Nachrichten verständlich einordnen. Du recherchierst gründlich und entwickelst daraus YouTube-Skripte mit einem klaren Spannungsbogen, starken Einstiegen und überzeugenden Auflösungen.

Wir suchen eine Person, die kreative Themenentwicklung, Skripte und Social Media zusammenbringt. Unsere Inhalte reichen von kontroversen, investigativen Geschichten über aktuelle Krypto- und Markt-News bis zu Trading- und Erklärvideos. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Recherche, Dramaturgie und Zuschauerbindung.

Deine Aufgaben

Ideation: Uns gehen nie die Themen aus

  • ⁠ ⁠Du findest regelmäßig Themen, die gerade relevant sind und die Menschen sehen wollen, und baust dabei auch ungewöhnliche Brücken zu Bitcoin und den Finanzmärkten, zum Beispiel von Popkultur, Politik oder Tech.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du bereitest jede Idee mit passenden Titelvorschlägen und Referenz-Thumbnails auf, damit wir die stärksten Themen auswählen können.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du reagierst schnell auf aktuelle Ereignisse, damit News-Videos zeitnah online gehen.
  • ⁠ Du recherchierst Reel-Ideen, die bei ähnlichen Creatorn funktionieren, für Instagram.“

Audience Retention: Skripte, die bis zum Ende tragen

  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst vollständige, retention-optimierte Skripte für YouTube-Langformate, vom Intro bis zum letzten Kapitel, so dass sie direkt vom Teleprompter gelesen werden können.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du entwickelst Hook und Value Proposition, die klar machen, was das Video liefert und warum es sich lohnt, bis zum Payoff dranzubleiben.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du baust jedes Video in drei bis vier Kapiteln mit steigender Spannung auf, so dass das Stärkste am Ende kommt und das Thema Substanz hat.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst gelegentlich Trading-Videos zu Strategien und Grundlagen, zum Beispiel „Wenn ich als Trader heute neu starten müsste".

User Retention: Zuschauer, die wiederkommen

  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst Short-Form-Inhalte und Posts für X (Twitter), die die Community zwischen den Videos aktiv halten.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du sorgst dafür, dass die Personal Brand über alle Formate wiedererkennbar klingt und Vertrauen aufbaut

Retention-optimiertes Copywriting im Alltag

  • ⁠ ⁠Du übersetzt komplexe Krypto- und Trading-Themen in klare, verständliche Sprache, ohne Gewinnversprechen und unseriöse Übertreibungen.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du unterstützt bei Bedarf die morgendliche Recherche für Markt-Updates: News, X und On-Chain-Daten kurz zusammengefasst.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du hilfst dabei, dem Editing- und Motion-Team zu erklären, welche Charts, Screenshots und Animationen ein Video braucht.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du nutzt KI-Tools für Recherche und Tempo, überarbeitest den Output aber immer selbst. Ein Skript übernimmst du nie eins zu eins.

Was du mitbringst

  • ⁠ ⁠YouTube-Skripte: Du hast bereits Skripte für längere YouTube-Videos geschrieben und kannst zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben zeigen. Du kannst erklären, welchen Teil du selbst übernommen hast und warum du das Video so aufgebaut hast.
  • ⁠ ⁠Dramaturgie und Zuschauerbindung: Du weißt, wie ein starker Einstieg funktioniert, welche Fragen eine Geschichte vorantreiben und wann eine Information ihre größte Wirkung entfaltet. Du erkennst Längen und kannst ein Skript gezielt verbessern.
  • ⁠ Recherche: Du arbeitest dich selbstständig in komplexe Themen ein, prüfst Quellen und trennst bei investigativen Geschichten belegte Fakten, Vorwürfe und eigene Einordnung sauber voneinander.
  • ⁠ ⁠Krypto, Trading und News: Du kennst die Grundlagen von Krypto und Finanzmärkten, verfolgst aktuelle Entwicklungen und kannst relevante Nachrichten schnell einordnen. Profi-Trader musst du nicht sein.
  • ⁠ ⁠Ideenreichtum: Du findest eigenständig Themen und ungewöhnliche Blickwinkel – für aktuelle News, verständliche Erklärvideos und investigative Geschichten. Du erkennst, welche Ideen genug Substanz für ein längeres Video haben.
  • ⁠ ⁠Schreiben: Du schreibst fehlerfreies Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Deine Texte klingen gesprochen natürlich und machen auch schwierige Zusammenhänge verständlich.
  • ⁠ ⁠Social Media: Du verstehst, wie Inhalte für YouTube, Shorts und X aufbereitet werden, und kannst ihre Planung und Veröffentlichung zuverlässig koordinieren.
  • ⁠ ⁠Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, nimmst Feedback konstruktiv auf und hältst Absprachen ein. Für gelegentliche Abstimmungen bist du auch abends nach deutscher Zeit erreichbar.

Nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn:

  • ⁠ Trading und Finanzmärkte für dich Neuland sind und du dir die Grundlagen erst erarbeiten müsstest.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du bisher ausschließlich für Lifestyle-, Beauty- oder E-Commerce-Marken geschrieben hast und Finanzthemen dich nicht wirklich interessieren.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du schreibst, ohne danach auf Watchtime und Retention zu schauen.
  • ⁠ ⁠Du klare Vorgaben und enge Abstimmung brauchst, um ins Arbeiten zu kommen.

Benefits

  • ⁠ ⁠Verantwortung für die Skripte eines wachsenden YouTube-Kanals, mit dem Ziel, von einem auf zwei Videos pro Woche zu gehen
  • ⁠ ⁠Zusammenarbeit mit einem Berater, der Erfahrung mit YouTube-Videos im sechs- bis siebenstelligen Aufrufbereich hat
  • ⁠ ⁠Ein Team aus Top-Performern und Gründern, das gemeinsam auf Wachstum hinarbeitet
  • ⁠ ⁠Eine Kultur, in der Verantwortung, Leistung und Ehrlichkeit zählen und Ergebnisse mehr wiegen als Worte
  • ⁠ ⁠Arbeiten von überall: Wir sind zu 100 % remote und arbeiten in deutscher Zeitzone
  • ⁠ ⁠Workations sind fester Bestandteil unserer Kultur
  • ⁠ ⁠Raum für Experimente, Lernen und persönliche Weiterentwicklung

jobs.description:
Category: Technology

Location:


The ServiceNowIRM Architect leads the design and delivery of scalable ServiceNow IntegratedRisk Management solutions for enterprise clients. The Architect translatescomplex business, risk, regulatory, and technical requirements into solutionarchitectures, implementation strategies, workflows, integrations, reporting,and automation aligned with Templar Shield standards and ServiceNow leadingpractices.

The Architectworks directly with stakeholders across risk, compliance, internal audit,cybersecurity, privacy, legal, technology, finance, and operations. This roleprovides architectural direction throughout discovery, design, configuration,testing, deployment, stabilization, and adoption while helping clientsestablish and mature sustainable governance, risk, compliance, audit, andresilience programs.

This is asenior, technical, client-facing consulting role that provides designauthority, leads Engineers, and works with Managers to ensure successfuldelivery. The Architect also helps clients evaluate and implement AI-enabledIRM capabilities using ServiceNow Otto, AI Control Tower, intelligentautomation, and agentic workflows. These capabilities must be designed withappropriate security, privacy, governance, explainability, human oversight, andresponsible-use controls.


Requirements

Primary Responsibilities:

ClientConsulting and Solution Leadership

  • Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, maturity assessments, design sessions, and solution reviews with business, technical, and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop a clear understanding of each client’s business objectives, risk and compliance obligations, governance structure, operating model, technology environment, program maturity, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate complex business, risk, regulatory, operational, and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures, implementation strategies, roadmaps, and future-state operating models.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor by explaining architectural options, technical dependencies, implementation risks, design tradeoffs, and recommended approaches to client stakeholders.
  • Maintain alignment among client stakeholders, Managers, Engineers, product teams, and third-party vendors throughout solution design and delivery.

ServiceNow IRM Architecture andDelivery

  • Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of ServiceNow IRM solutions across Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, Regulatory Change Management, Issues Management, and related capabilities.
  • Define solution architecture across IRM applications, including data models, security, risk taxonomies, control structures, assessment methodologies, issues, indicators, approvals, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
  • Determine the appropriate use of out-of-the-box functionality, configuration, integration, automation, or custom development based on client requirements and ServiceNow leading practices.
  • Provide architectural oversight and targeted hands-on support across ServiceNow IRM applications while guiding Engineers responsible for configuration, development, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Advise clients on governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, internal controls, policy management, audit, third-party risk, business continuity, operational resilience, and sustainable IRM program management.

Integration, Data, Reporting, andAutomation

  • Design integrations between ServiceNow IRM and enterprise platforms, data repositories, regulatory-content providers, risk and compliance tools, security technologies, financial systems, and other business applications.
  • Define integration patterns, APIs, data mappings, transformation rules, reconciliation logic, synchronization schedules, error handling, monitoring, and support requirements.
  • Develop data architecture and governance strategies that support accurate risk, control, policy, audit, issue, assessment, indicator, entity, and regulatory information across IRM applications.
  • Define reporting and analytics strategies, including key performance indicators, key risk indicators, dashboards, data sources, audience-specific views, Performance Analytics, and executive reporting.
  • Evaluate ServiceNow Otto, AI Control Tower, automation, and agentic workflow capabilities for IRM use cases while ensuring appropriate security, privacy, governance, explainability, human oversight, and responsible use.

TechnicalLeadership and Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain solution architecture documents, integration designs, data models, process flows, functional specifications, architectural decisions, implementation guidance, and supporting technical documentation.
  • Establish technical standards and review configurations, workflows, integrations, data models, automation, and reporting for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and upgrade compatibility.
  • Provide technical direction to Engineers and consultants, assign design and configuration activities, resolve complex technical issues, and validate completed work.
  • Define solution acceptance criteria and oversee system, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, deployment readiness, production transition, and post-deployment stabilization.
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt, assumptions, dependencies, and complex design issues and work with Managers and client stakeholders to develop mitigation plans and guide clients away from unnecessary customization.

Practice and Sales Support:

TheServiceNow IRM Architect supports Templar Shield’s business development andpractice growth by providing solution leadership and subject-matter expertisethroughout the sales process.

  • Support Practice Leads in identifying, qualifying, shaping, and expanding ServiceNow IRM opportunities within new and existing client accounts.
  • Participate in pre-sales discovery sessions, solution demonstrations, technical workshops, capability presentations, and executive discussions.
  • Lead solution scoping and contribute to architecture approaches, staffing models, delivery plans, effort estimates, pricing inputs, proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
  • Develop solution approaches that clearly define scope, assumptions, dependencies, integration requirements, risks, staffing needs, and delivery estimates.
  • Help develop reusable service offerings, implementation methodologies, reference architectures, integration patterns, demonstrations, accelerators, templates, and training materials.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

Candidates must demonstratestrong solution architecture, platform, and IRM knowledge, including:

  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow IRM applications, data models, workflows, workspaces, and related platform capabilities.
  • Experience designing solutions across Risk Management, Policy and Compliance Management, Audit Management, Third-Party Risk Management, Business Continuity Management, Operational Resilience, Regulatory Change Management, Issues Management, or related applications.
  • Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture, application scope, data models, security, access controls, reporting, dashboards, and platform governance.
  • Ability to evaluate requirements and determine the appropriate use of out-of-the-box functionality, configuration, integration, automation, or custom development.
  • Experience designing IRM workflows, assessments, risk and control processes, policies, audits, issues, indicators, approvals, taxonomies, attestations, and related automation.
  • Experience defining enterprise integration strategies using REST and SOAP web services, APIs, Integration Hub, MID Server, import sets, transform maps, and established ServiceNow integration patterns.
  • Ability to develop reporting and analytics strategies, including key performance indicators, key risk indicators, dashboards, executive reporting, Performance Analytics, and supporting data sources.
  • Experience reviewing solution designs, configurations, integrations, automation, and data models for security, scalability, performance, maintainability, and upgrade compatibility.
  • Familiarity with data migration, Automated Test Framework, source control, application deployment, update management, release management, and ServiceNow upgrade practices.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, business rules, and other ServiceNow scripting and automation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow Otto, AI Control Tower, and AI-enabled or agentic workflow capabilities, including the governance, security, privacy, explainability, human oversight, and responsible-use considerations associated with their implementation.

Qualifications

  • Five or more years of ServiceNow platform experience, including experience in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or comparable architecture role, with at least three years focused on ServiceNow Integrated Risk Management.
  • Experience leading enterprise ServiceNow implementations through discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, stabilization, and adoption.
  • Experience leading stakeholder interviews, requirements workshops, design sessions, solution reviews, and executive-level presentations.
  • Strong understanding of governance, risk management, compliance, internal controls, policy management, audit, assessments, third-party risk, and related business processes.
  • Experience coordinating multiple technical and functional workstreams and managing competing priorities and deliverables in a consulting environment.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and resolve complex architectural issues.

jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

As a Analyst – Intelligence & Advisory, you will work alongside AHEAD’s consultants and practice teams at the intersection of technology, AI and business - turning ambiguous business questions from consulting teams into structured, hypothesis-led research and clear, actionable recommendations. You will independently own deliverables end-to-end, act as a credible thought partner to onsite consulting and pursuit teams, and help raise the quality bar by guiding junior analysts. Your work will directly shape how AHEAD’s consulting teams understand markets, position against competitors, plan for accounts, and win complex enterprise technology deals — and how sharply those insights are communicated to CXO audiences.

You will scope and prioritize requests, clarify objectives, and select the right insights on clients, markets, offerings and competition to address them. You will conduct data-driven analyses and turn the results into accurate, client-ready documents, models and charts, and join team problem-solving discussions so that recommendations are actionable and strategically relevant. Beyond individual requests, you will help build and maintain AHEAD’s knowledge assets, databases and proposal and use-case material, using scripts and automation to prepare and validate data, while continuing to grow with the industry.

Being part of this exciting team, you will get long term opportunities to lead client discussions with global IT leaders, identify and creatively solve complex problems using both qualitative and quantitative research methods. You will design and build written research, graphics, and tools/frameworks to support clients in critical processes, and help organizations transform the way they operate.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

    Problem Solving & Advisory Support

  • Translate pursuit, account and client questions into structured problem statements, hypotheses, issue trees and research plans; clarify scope, success criteria and timelines with stakeholders up front.
  • Apply consulting frameworks and structured thinking (e.g., MECE issue trees, hypothesis-driven analysis, value-chain and maturity assessments, 2x2 prioritization) to break down complex problems, test hypotheses and arrive at defensible answers.
  • Exercise sound judgement when data is incomplete — triangulate across sources, state assumptions, size the opportunity and flag confidence levels — and always answer the “so what” with a recommendation, not just data.
  • Apply sound judgement to prioritize what matters: separate signal from noise, assess the reliability of sources and data, challenge assumptions, and clearly call out risks, trade-offs and confidence levels in every recommendation.
  • Advisory Engagements: Support pursuit and advisory engagements by delivering market insights, competitive benchmarking and strategic guidance that shape deal strategy and client conversations.

    • Research Delivery & Insights

  • Own end-to-end delivery of assigned items from AHEAD's research product stack — Market Size & Outlook, Industry/Technology POVs, Account Intelligence Packs, Competitive Profiles & Battlecards, Buying Behaviour Analysis, market trend summaries/briefs, Capability Heatmaps, Benchmark Reports and other custom research products where required
  • Synthesize intelligence from primary research and secondary sources — tier-1 analyst platforms (e.g., Gartner, Everest Group, Forrester, Nelson Hall, IDC, Avasant), business databases (e.g., Hoovers, AlphaSense ,ZoomInfo) and proprietary sources — into crisp, executive-ready insight narratives.
  • Track competitor strategies, partnerships, offerings and deal signals, and translate them into actionable pursuit positioning.
  • Analyze market dynamics across AHEAD-relevant technology areas—including Applications, cloud and infrastructure, application modernization, data and AI, cybersecurity, digital workplace, platform engineering, automation, and emerging technologies—to assess business needs and technology linkages.
  • Build account-level intelligence to support strategic account planning, C-suite engagement and opportunity identification.
  • Know how in helping service providers make informed pricing and solutioning decisions — e.g., peer price benchmarking, delivery-improvement and competitive analysis to improve win-rates (Good to have or is a plus)
  • Validate sources for currency, credibility and relevance; maintain high standards of accuracy and referencing across all deliverables.

    • Reporting, Dashboards & AI-Enabled Research

  • Design, build and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI and lightweight HTML dashboards (e.g., competitor trackers, account, and market views, CoE performance reporting) that let stakeholders self-serve insights.
  • Clean, model and visualize data from multiple sources (Excel, databases, analyst-platform exports); ensure accuracy, clear metric definitions and version control.
  • Use AI tools and agents to automate and accelerate research workflows — source scanning, competitor monitoring, summarization and first-draft creation — with human validation of every output.
  • Verify AI-generated content for accuracy, bias and source traceability; build reusable prompts and agent workflows and share good practices with the team.

    • Storytelling & Visual Communication

  • Convert research findings into answer-first storylines, proposal narratives and CXO-level communications that persuade rather than merely present.
  • Build polished, consulting-grade decks and data visualizations using AHEAD’s brand-compliant templates; partner with visual communication specialists for high-impact pursuit and proposal material.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior internal stakeholders and handle questions and pushback with confidence.

    • Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as a day-to-day research partner with consulting, sales, practice and deal teams to translate business needs into hypothesis-led research and concise, insight-rich narratives aligned with AHEAD’s solutions.
  • Manage multiple concurrent requests, balancing standard reports with bespoke, high-urgency support while keeping quality and timelines on track.
  • Anticipate intelligence needs across the pursuit lifecycle-from opportunity identification and qualification to proposal development and win/loss review — and incorporate stakeholder feedback into future work.
  • Collaborate with subject-matter experts across AHEAD’s practices to understand intelligence requirements and deliver research aligned to account goals.
  • Present findings through concise, insight-rich narratives that connect business strategy with AHEAD solutions.

    • Team Contribution, Tools & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to reusable assets — research templates, source libraries, capability heatmaps, frameworks and maturity models — that extend research output into AHEAD IP.
  • Help shape the CoE’s research agenda — identify priority topics, data gaps and new content ideas based on industry and stakeholder needs — and recommend process and tooling improvements to Intelligence & Advisory stakeholders
  • Track and report on your own delivery metrics — turnaround time, quality and stakeholder satisfaction — and contribute to win/loss learnings on research-supported pursuits.
  • Mentor, guide and review the work of junior analysts; share domain knowledge, research methods and quality standards to raise the team’s overall capability.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 3-5 years of progressive experience in research, market/competitive intelligence, deal advisory and strategy/management consulting – in large leading IT services /Consulting firms OR leading research & advisory firms (Candidates from BPO industry /BPO Services companies need not apply)
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree is a must; and/or master’s degree in management from a reputed institution is preferred.
  • Domain Expertise – Technology and Vertical Domain (atleast one domain) : Good understanding of the IT services and enterprise technology landscape — Enterprise Applications, cloud, infrastructure, digital transformation, data & AI, GenAI, cybersecurity coupled with one or two domains (Verticals)
  • Exceptional Problem Solving & Structured Thinking: Proven ability to break down ambiguous, open-ended questions into structured problems, form and test hypotheses, perform root-cause analysis and reach clear conclusions with minimal supervision.
  • Consulting Skills: Consulting-style approach to scoping, framing and answering stakeholder questions — including storyline development, “so what” thinking, handling feedback and pushback, and making recommendations rather than simply reporting data.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (e.g. Word, Excel and PowerPoint); software tools working knowledge (e.g. Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, Knime, Qualtrics etc ) is a plus
  • AI & Agents: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools and AI agents in research or analysis workflows (prompting, automation, validation of outputs), with a responsible-use mindset and enthusiasm for adopting new ways of working.
  • Judgment & Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market trends, vendor strategies and enterprise needs, combining qualitative and quantitative inputs (market sizing, benchmarking, comparative analysis) into actionable insights; sound judgement in prioritizing, weighing evidence, evaluating source credibility and making a call when data is imperfect.
  • Reporting & Dashboarding: Working proficiency in Power BI (data modelling, DAX/Power Query basics) and advanced Excel; ability to build clear, interactive dashboards, including HTML-based dashboards, that turn data into decision-ready views.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication; able to produce executive summaries, research notes and presentations that are clear, concise and ready for senior audiences.
  • Presentation Skills: Strong working proficiency in PowerPoint — able to turn analysis into polished, consulting-grade slides, charts and visual narratives.
  • Research Proficiency: Hands-on experience with secondary research using tier-1 analyst platforms and business intelligence databases, across areas such as competitive intelligence, account intelligence, market sizing, market trend synthesis, technology benchmarking and converting research evidence into structured findings is preferred.
  • Curiosity & Ownership: Intellectual curiosity, comfort with ambiguity and the drive to push beyond surface-level data to uncover insight that changes how decisions are made.
  • Organizational Rigour: Ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables with competing priorities and tight timelines while maintaining quality.
  • Collaboration: Collaborative, consultative mindset; builds trusted relationships with global, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to RFP support, proposal intelligence or pursuit enablement within a consulting or technology firm.

Why AHEAD:

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.
We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents
Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy
Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance
Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling
Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being
Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations
Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

jobs.description:
ABOUT TRAVEL HACK

Travel Hack is a membership-based online travel platform. Our members join a closed user group and unlock private rates on millions of hotels and vacation rentals: pricing the open market does not show. We are a Delaware corporation with a small senior team of operators, engineers, and commercial leads, and we are in launch phase right now. The systems you help build in your first months will run the company for years.

This is not a big-company ops seat with a playbook handed to you. You will help write the playbook.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • Vendor research and comparison memos. Scope options, compare vendors, recommend one, and show your work.
  • Vendor and partner coordination. Follow-ups, applications, and verification requirements across our booking-engine vendor, payment providers, phone system, and support partners. You keep every thread warm and every loop closing.
  • Domain and DNS coordination. Records, verifications, and handovers between our registrar and the dev team.
  • App store administration. Developer account setup, business registrations, and verification requirements for the two major app stores.
  • Email marketing operations. Flow structure and segmentation inside our email platform (welcome, abandoned-cart, and price-drop journeys). Copy and design stay with the marketing lane; the plumbing is yours.
  • Contract and hiring admin. Engagement paperwork, hiring support, and brand asset management.
  • Quality assurance passes on member-facing builds and site testing support.
  • A daily written end-of-day report. Fixed structure, bullets only, every claim backed by a link or screenshot. This is how leadership sees your work, so treat it as a first-class deliverable.

YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

  • Days 1 to 30: Your daily report lands on time, every working day, and reads clean. You have mapped our vendor landscape and taken over active follow-up threads without dropping one.
  • Days 31 to 60: You have shipped at least two vendor comparison memos that led to a decision. Domain, app store, and email-platform admin run through you. Nothing in your lane surprises your manager.
  • Days 61 to 90: You spot gaps before they are pointed out, and your recommendations get approved with fewer edits. You are trusted with more, because you showed evidence for everything you claimed.

HOW WE WORK

  • Spot gaps, then bring a move. We want people who notice the missing owner, the missing deadline, the missing escalation path, and flag it with a recommended fix attached. Raising a problem without a proposed next step is half a job.
  • Proactive by default. If a task completes and the next step is obvious, start it. Ask first when the action is irreversible, expensive, or externally visible.
  • Evidence over claims. Nothing is reported as delivered without confirmation from the outside world. This rule does not bend.
  • Draft, then approve. Anything a vendor, partner, or member could see goes to your manager first. Your deliverable is a recommendation ready for review.
  • Written by default, sync on Thursdays. Work lives in Asana with clear owners and due dates. You send a structured written report at the end of every working day, and once a week we hold an operations huddle, camera on.
  • Absorb load, do not route it up. Escalate what genuinely needs leadership. Everything else, you handle and report.
  • No weekends. We do not work Saturdays or Sundays and we do not ask you to. Deadlines that fall on a weekend move.
  • Direct communication. Feedback here is sharp, specific, and aimed at the work. If you want a manager who tells you exactly where the bar is, you will like it here.

HOW TO APPLY

Apply with the following. Applications that skip these instructions are not reviewed.

  1. Begin your cover letter application with the word "Tailwind" as the very first word of your cover note. This is how we know you read the post.
  2. Your CV (PDF preferred).
  3. A two-minute video. One take, no script, no edits, camera on. A phone is fine. We are not assessing production quality, and a polished edit counts against you rather than for you. Two minutes is a hard ceiling. Cover three things: (1) Who you are, in about twenty seconds. Not your career history, we have your CV. What you are actually like to work with. (2) A time someone told you your work was wrong, or not good enough. What they said, what you did next, and what you would do differently now. (3) One question you would ask in your first week that would tell you the most about how this business really runs. We watch these in full. It is the fastest way to see how you think out loud, and this role spends real time on live vendor calls and a weekly camera-on huddle.

On verification: shortlisted candidates sign an NDA before deep-dive interviews, and the final candidate completes identity verification before onboarding. This role carries access to sensitive systems, and we hire accordingly.

Requirements

MUST-HAVES

  • 4+ years in operations, project coordination, or executive operations at a startup or lean company.
  • Excellent written English. Most of your output is written: memos, reports, vendor emails. Your writing is your interface.
  • Full availability Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 Central European Time (one-hour lunch). Check what this window means where you live before applying: roughly 12:30 to 21:30 in India and 15:00 to 24:00 in the Philippines during European summer, an hour later in winter.
  • Written-first discipline. Work lives in a task manager (we use Asana), decisions get written down, and you make progress without waiting for a meeting.
  • Evidence habit. Done means shown: a link, a screenshot, a confirmation. A draft is a draft.
  • Loop-closing instinct. You track open items until they are externally confirmed, and you never let a thread silently die.
  • Discretion. You will see vendor terms, pricing logic, and pre-launch plans. You keep them inside the building, and you can point to a track record of doing exactly that.

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • Travel industry or online travel agency experience.
  • Hands-on time with an email marketing platform (flows, segments, deliverability basics).
  • DNS and domain management basics.
  • App store developer account administration (either major platform).
  • Experience taking a product through launch.

TOOLS & SKILLS

Vendor Management · Written English · Asana · Email Marketing Ops · DNS & Domains · App Store Admin · QA & Testing · Research Memos

Benefits

COMPENSATION & TERMS

  • Compensation: USD 850 to 1,000 per month, depending on experience. Fixed monthly retainer, plus discretionary performance bonuses.
  • Engagement: Freelance basis, invoiced monthly. The role itself is full-time and ongoing, not project work.
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00 CET, one-hour lunch. Fully remote.
  • Leave: 20 earned days per year plus 8 national holidays of your country of residence.
  • Probation: First 6 months.
  • Paperwork: Offer letter, engagement contract, and NDA are signed together. Travel Hack Ventures Inc. is a Delaware corporation.

Description

Nebius Academy is an educational platform helping business professionals and operations teams stay ahead of the automation curve. We build specialized courses that teach practitioners how to design, implement, and scale AI-powered workflows using modern automation tools — from no-code platforms to enterprise-grade integrations.

Our programs are built for people who work in the real world: operations managers, business analysts, automation engineers, and digital transformation leads. We help them move beyond manual processes and become confident architects of intelligent workflows.

Our mission is to give professionals the knowledge and hands-on skills to automate smarter — and lead their organizations through the shift.

Who are we looking for?

We are building a talent pool of automation practitioners and business technology experts for ongoing roles as Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts in our AI Automation program.

We are looking for specialists across a range of seniority levels and focus areas:

  • Junior (Instructor / Technical Trainer) — 1–3 years designing or supporting automation workflows. Hands-on experience with tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n. Comfortable walking learners through workflows step-by-step with practical, repeatable examples.
  • Mid (Author / Automation Engineer) — 3–6 years implementing automation across business operations. Experience with API integrations, prompt engineering, and RPA platforms. Able to explain automation concepts clearly and debug issues in real time.
  • Senior (Subject Matter Expert / Automation Architect) — 6+ years in automation solution architecture, complex integrations, and large-scale project delivery. Experienced working with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Strong background in business analysis and digital transformation.

A strong candidate doesn't just know automation tools — they use them daily and can teach others to do the same. We look for practitioners who have replaced real manual processes with working solutions, not just people who have studied the theory.

These are Talent Pool positions — we continuously review applications and build our roster of experts. There may not be an immediate opening at the time you apply, but strong candidates will be added to our talent pool and contacted as relevant opportunities arise.

You can join us on a part-time basis (10–15 hours per week) as an instructor leading live sessions and workshops, as a course author creating learning materials, or as a subject matter expert supporting curriculum development.

Apply now — we review applications on an ongoing basis. Our selection process is fully asynchronous and designed to respect your time:

  1. Application Review — we evaluate your profile against our current needs
  2. Async Video Interview — a short self-recorded interview (10–15 minutes max)
  3. Test Assignment — approximately 1 hour to complete
  4. Talent Pool — finalists are added to our active roster of vetted experts
  5. Hiring Manager & Tech Expert Call — once a relevant position opens, we invite you to a live interview with our team
  6. Offer — we extend an offer for a relevant position upon successful completion of the process

Please submit your resume in English.

What you will do

Available Roles

We are building a talent pool of Instructors, Authors, and Subject Matter Experts for our AI Automation educational programs. We hire on an ongoing basis across the following specializations:

Most in demand: Make, Zapier, n8n, AI-powered workflow automation, API integrations Also relevant: Power Automate, UiPath, RPA platforms, prompt engineering for automation

Depending on your expertise, you may:

  • Deliver live workshops and training sessions
  • Create educational content, assessments, and project-based learning materials
  • Design practical exercises, guides, prompts, and reference resources
  • Help define curriculum structure, learning objectives, and competency frameworks
  • Review content for technical accuracy and industry relevance
  • Share insights on AI tools, workflows, and emerging trends
  • Collaborate with instructional designers and curriculum teams to continuously improve learning outcomes
  • Support program updates based on learner feedback and market needs

Areas of involvement

  • Instructor — leads live sessions, workshops, and learner interactions.
  • Author — creates course content, lessons, assessments, and projects.
  • Subject Matter Expert — shapes curriculum strategy, competency frameworks, and program direction.

⌛ All roles are part-time: 10–15 hours per week.

Requirements

  • Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing automation workflows in business operations environments
  • Hands-on experience with automation platforms such as Make, Zapier, n8n, Power Automate, UiPath, or similar tools
  • Experience with AI-powered automation, API integrations, prompt engineering, RPA platforms, and real-world operational workflows
  • Strong ability to share knowledge through content creation, training, mentoring, or facilitation, making complex automation concepts clear, practical, and engaging for learners
  • Ability to work independently with strong ownership and minimal supervision
  • Availability to collaborate within European time zones
  • Ability to dedicate approximately 10–15 hours per week
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); Russian or Spanish is a strong plus
  • Background in automation consulting, business process improvement, operations leadership, advocacy, mentoring, conference speaking, or technical community engagement is a plus

Nice-to-have

  • Deep expertise in business process automation, workflow design, or digital operations transformation
  • Ability to evaluate real-world automation implementations, tool ecosystems, and AI-augmented workflows
  • Experience creating competency maps, skill frameworks, learning roadmaps, or curriculum structures
  • Ability to review technical learning content and provide structured feedback

What we can offer you

  • The opportunity to teach while maintaining your primary job: Share your expertise without leaving your current role.
  • Competitive hourly rate of $40-$85 USD for flexible part-time collaboration with significant impact and an amazing team!
  • Remote cooperation with a schedule convenient for both you and the team: We don't focus on micromanagement.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team.
jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is seeking experienced Telehealth Mental Health Providers to join our growing team. This is a fully remote, 1099 contractor opportunity offering flexibility, strong patient demand, and a highly supported clinical environment.

At MEDvidi, we provide comprehensive mental health evaluations and treatment for adult patients experiencing conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and mild-to-moderate OCD.

We’re reimagining how care is delivered. Here’s what sets us apart:

  • Full administrative support – no need to hire or manage staff; dedicated assistants handle scheduling, patient communication, and logistics
  • Streamlined technology – proprietary EMR with integrated PDMP and e-prescribing tools
  • Reduced administrative burden – automated workflows and AI-supported documentation tools
  • No software costs – our platform is fully provided at no cost to you
  • Low no-show rates – consistent patient flow and reliable earnings
  • Flexible scheduling – build your own schedule with the ability to increase volume over time

Compensation:

This is a 1099 contractor role with payment per completed appointment:

  • Physicians (MD/DO):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$60 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$40 per visit
  • Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs):
  • Initial evaluations (30 min): ~$45 per visit
  • Follow-ups (15 min): ~$30 per visit

Consistent availability and schedule optimization can significantly increase total earnings.

At MEDvidi, our mission is to make mental health care more accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. We leverage technology, clinical expertise, and operational support to empower providers and improve patient outcomes across the U.S.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations via telehealth
  • Review patient medical history, symptoms, medications, and relevant background
  • Diagnose and treat conditions such as ADHD, anxiety, depression, insomnia, and OCD
  • Develop and implement individualized treatment plans
  • Prescribe medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with clinical and regulatory guidelines
  • Provide patient education on treatment plans, medication usage, and follow-up care
  • Maintain timely and accurate clinical documentation in the EMR
  • Ensure completion of chart notes and prescriptions within required timeframes
  • Collaborate with clinical and operations teams to support patient care and continuity

Requirements

  • Board Certified Physician (MD/DO) or Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)
  • Active and unrestricted medical license (multi-state preferred)
  • Active DEA registration
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical experience in mental health treatment
  • Experience prescribing controlled substances
  • Strong clinical judgment and comfort managing common outpatient psychiatric conditions
  • Ability to work a minimum of ~15 hours per week (preferred for patient continuity)

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionTripleTen is a service that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.
jobs.description:
Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers people, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Data Analytics, Data Science, Web Development, Quality Assurance (QA) Engineering, and UX/UI Design — in an accessible and practical way, supporting them until they successfully thrive in a new career.

🚀 Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

What is our goal? We are continuously looking for experienced AI Automation professionals who want to support and guide our students on their path to becoming professional developers. This is a full-time teaching role with an expectation of 40 hours per week. The schedule can be flexible, but you must be consistently available to support students throughout their learning journey.

How to apply? Apply here. We review applications on a rolling basis, and candidates whose profiles align with the role will be invited to complete a digital interview, and complete a short technical test task.

If a vacancy is available, we will assign it to you right away; otherwise, we will keep your profile and completed task on file for future opportunities.

📌 Please submit your CV in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, addressing a wide range of questions, clarifying complex concepts, and helping students navigate their assignments.
  • Support students in live “Q&A style” sessions, where they can walk in with immediate questions.
  • Host webinars and other group educational events, covering program content, extracurricular skills, and industry knowledge. You may also participate in non-educational sessions such as New Student Orientation.
  • Review and assess student projects in alignment with program standards and best practices, providing clear, constructive feedback.
  • Engage with students on the TripleTen Hub, offering written guidance and supporting ongoing communication.
  • Share your professional expertise and best industry practices to equip students with relevant insights and strategies for their careers.
  • Create and curate educational resources within the TripleTen Hub to enhance student learning and make knowledge more accessible.
  • Foster a collaborative learning community by encouraging student interaction, building a sense of belonging, and cultivating a network of shared knowledge and mutual support.
  • Host Mock Technical Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience identifying opportunities for automation and designing solutions to optimize business processes—ideally within the marketing, tech, or customer success.
  • Solid understanding of business process improvement, with a working knowledge of how AI and automation can streamline workflows and boost efficiency.
  • Comfortable providing constructive and actionable feedback to junior professionals or students.
  • Ideally experienced in presentation coaching, mentoring, or guiding others in their professional development.
  • Clear and confident communicator who can explain technical or complex concepts in a simple and engaging way.

Nice to have:

Experience working directly with stakeholders or clients to identify needs, pitch solutions, and drive adoption of automation tools.

What we can offer you

  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • The opportunity to teach while continuing your main job.
  • The chance to share knowledge and experience with developers within our community.
  • Cross-cultural collaboration experience through mentoring and webinar facilitation.
  • Remote collaboration with a schedule that is convenient for both you and the team. We do not focus on micromanagement.
  • A comfortable digital office environment. We use modern digital tools such as Miro, Notion, Zoom, and others to ensure smooth collaboration.
  • A diverse and close-knit team distributed across the U.S. and Latin America.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThe Associate Director, SEO Specialist owns the day-to-day operations of the SEO Specialist team, acting as the primary point of leadership for the Specialists and Leads who execute technical and tactical SEO work across the department.
jobs.companyName: Accelerated Digital Media - an OuterBox company
jobs.description:
Description

The Associate Director, SEO Specialist owns the day-to-day operations of the SEO Specialist team, acting as the primary point of leadership for the Specialists and Leads who execute technical and tactical SEO work across the department. This role manages the intake and prioritization of day-to-day SEO tasks coming in from other groups, oversees the Specialist responsible for pre-launch SEO on web projects, and runs point on SEO audits, pre-sales support, and delivery of any signed SEO products.

The Associate Director blends operational leadership with hands-on SEO expertise, ensuring the Specialist team runs smoothly, delivers consistent quality, and supports both existing client engagements and new business opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Own the day-to-day management of the SEO Specialist team, including intake, triage, and prioritization of SEO tasks and requests coming in from other groups across the organization.
  • Directly manage the Specialist team — including Lead SEO Specialists and SEO Specialists — overseeing staffing, workload distribution, quality of output, and delivery timelines.
  • Manage and mentor the SEO Specialist responsible for pre-launch SEO on web projects, ensuring pre-launch SEO deliverables (technical setup, migrations checklists, redirect mapping, information architecture review, etc.) are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and quality reviewer for all pre-launch SEO work on web projects, coordinating closely with Web, Dev, UX, and Project Management teams.
  • Run point on SEO audits across the department — scoping, resourcing, overseeing execution, and ensuring final deliverables meet quality and strategic standards.
  • Run point on pre-sales SEO support, including audits, technical scoping, and SEO input for prospective client pitches, RFPs, and proposals.
  • Own the management and delivery of any signed SEO products, ensuring scope, timelines, staffing, and quality expectations are met from kickoff through delivery.
  • Partner with the Director of SEO Operations to plan team capacity, forecast staffing needs, manage escalations, and align department priorities.
  • Set, refine, and enforce SOPs and QA standards across day-to-day Specialist work, pre-launch SEO, audits, and pre-sales engagements.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or high-stakes technical SEO issues arising from Specialist tasks, web project launches, audits, or pre-sales work.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with SEO Strategists, Content, UX, Dev, Sales, and Media teams to ensure Specialist execution and pre-launch SEO support broader campaign and business goals.
  • Provide regular reporting and status updates to the Director of SEO Operations on team capacity, task throughput, pre-launch project status, audit pipeline, pre-sales activity, and signed product delivery.
  • Identify gaps in current processes and workflows, propose solutions, and drive continuous improvement across day-to-day execution, pre-launch SEO, audits, and pre-sales.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and professional development planning for the Specialist team, working with Leads to build a strong bench of talent.
  • Ensure the team's work consistently reflects current search trends, algorithm shifts, LLM/AI search behaviors, and technical SEO best practices.
  • Manage SEO projects. Coordinate with internal team resources and sales to scope short term SEO projects. This includes client communication and project management when needed.
  • Oversee internal Link Building service. Manage team resources and maintain internal partner databases.
  • Additional duties, as assigned

Requirements

  • 5–7+ years of SEO experience, including demonstrated expertise in technical SEO, audits, pre-launch/migration SEO for web projects, and pre-sales support.
  • Proven experience managing a team, including managing other managers/leads. Strong understanding of the full SEO lifecycle — strategy, execution, QA, reporting, and refinement — along with the ability to run day-to-day team operations at scale.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with Sales or New Business teams on pitches, proposals, or scoping.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects, competing priorities, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to represent the SEO team credibly in pre-sales and client-facing settings.
  • High proficiency in tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Botify/DeepCrawl, SEOClarity/BrightEdge, and standard SEO toolsets.
  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, able to create formulas, manipulate data, and perform trend analysis.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and common CMS platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce, etc.). Experience collaborating with Development, UX, and Project Management teams on web launches and migrations.

Benefits

Empowering your journey through every stage of growth—so you can do your best work and live your best life.

Boxer Benefits

Exceptional teams deserve exceptional support. Our employee benefits package includes generous paid time off, healthcare coverage, retirement savings options, professional development opportunities, and additional perks designed to help you stay healthy, productive, and fulfilled both at work and at home.

  • Health Insurance
  • 401(k) & Retirement Savings
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Flexible Scheduling
  • Remote-First Culture
  • Professional Development
  • Employee Referral Program
  • And more!

﻿Salary Description: $85,000 - $105,000

Our Company Values

Great results don’t happen by chance. They come from talented people working together with shared expectations, mutual respect, and a commitment to doing what’s right.

At OuterBox, our values guide how we approach our work, support our teammates, and serve our clients. They influence the decisions we make every day and help create a culture where people can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow throughout their careers.

Growth At OuterBox

We believe growth is oxygen—for our clients, our company, and our people. That’s why we’re committed to helping every teammate reach their next stage of growth.

Every person joins OuterBox with different experiences, ambitions, and career goals. We believe great leaders meet people where they are, providing the support, resources, and opportunities needed to grow professionally, develop new skills, and build a rewarding career.

Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or grow into leadership, you’ll find a team invested in helping you get there.

﻿

﻿Physical Demands

  • Primarily involves sitting at a desk and using a computer for extended periods of time.
  • Light physical activity is also required, such as carrying equipment or setting up for presentations.

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch
  • Schnell, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert

  • Erfahrung in Business Development, Sales oder Key Account Management
  • Erfahrung mit Retail, FMCG, Baby/Kids oder Consumer Brands
  • Kontakte zu Einkäufern oder Distributoren
  • Erfahrung mit Drogerien, Spielwaren-, Kinderfach- oder Apothekenhandel

Benefits

jobs.description:
We are hiring for a major customer and looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join a large-scale data platform modernization initiative in the Google Cloud ecosystem, supporting the migration of enterprise data warehouse workloads from Teradata to BigQuery. In this role, you will discover and manage the central Common Data Model (CDM) hub, support the creation of new data spokes for consuming teams, and build a deep understanding of the data model and business KPIs to ensure they are implemented consistently and used correctly across the platform.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines: Design, develop, and optimize scalable data transformation pipelines in BigQuery using Dataform and SQL, ensuring reliability and performance.

  • Drive data warehouse migration: Support the transition from Teradata to BigQuery by analyzing, translating, and validating existing data models and logic.

  • Own the Common Data Model: Discover, document, and manage the CDM hub, ensuring consistency, governance, and seamless data consumption across teams.

  • Enable data platform adoption: Support the onboarding of new CDM consumers, providing guidance on data model usage and integration best practices.

  • Align data with business goals: Analyze business KPIs and ensure their definitions, calculations, and usage are accurately reflected in the data model.

  • Act as a data model expert: Maintain deep knowledge of data structures, lineage, and semantics, serving as a key reference point for stakeholders.

  • Ensure data quality and trust: Drive testing, validation, and reconciliation activities across Teradata and BigQuery environments to guarantee data accuracy.

  • Optimize platform performance: Improve BigQuery workloads for performance, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability.

  • Promote engineering standards: Contribute to documentation, modeling standards, and best practices that strengthen the overall data platform.

  • Collaborate across teams: Partner with engineers, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver trusted and well-understood data products.

Must Have

  • Professional experience as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or BI Engineer, with a senior level of ownership and autonomy.
  • Strong, hands-on SQL expertise, including complex transformations, analytical queries, and performance optimization.
  • Practical experience with Google Cloud Platform, in particular BigQuery.
  • Hands-on experience with Dataform (or a similar SQL-based transformation framework such as dbt, with the willingness to work with Dataform).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts (dimensional modeling, layered architectures, hub-and-spoke / common data model approaches).
  • Ability to understand business KPIs and translate their definitions and usage into correct, maintainable data model implementations.
  • Experience ensuring data quality through testing, validation, and reconciliation of datasets.
  • Regular use of AI tools to improve productivity, automate or reduce repetitive work, support decision-making, and deliver higher-quality outcomes.
  • Ability to use AI tools responsibly by structuring effective prompts, critically validating outputs, understanding limitations, and taking ownership of the final result.
  • Excellent English communication skills, including the ability to communicate design decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Teradata (Teradata SQL, BTEQ) or with Teradata-to-BigQuery migration projects.
  • Experience with Python for data processing, automation, or tooling.
  • Experience with other GCP data services (Cloud Composer / Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataplex).
  • Familiarity with BI and reporting tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau) and how KPIs are consumed downstream.
  • Exposure to data governance, data cataloging, or lineage practices and tooling.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices applied to data pipelines.
  • Google Cloud certification (e.g., Professional Data Engineer).

We're hiring a Senior Technical Product Marketing Manager to be the technical storyteller for the Couchbase platform.   • Exposure to mobile/edge or real-time analytics workloads.

Visit our website and connect with us on LinkedIn to learn more.

Why Join Us?

Working for VargasAndrews means joining a global workforce of passionate, motivated A-players. We believe in hiring driven individuals and supporting them with direction and resources. We work smart, not just hard.

Scope of Services

Service / Area

Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare and submit monthly invoices to the Client's customers no later than the agreed deadline.

Accounts Payable

Bank Reconciliation

General Accounts

25% Data management and close support — update financial data in databases, assist Senior Accountants in monthly/yearly closings, and assist with other accounting projects.

10% Accounting process improvement tasks in coordination with the Senior Accountant and Fractional Controller.
