OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We're assembling a small founding team to build something genuinely hard: high-throughput services that inspect live traffic, terminate and analyze TLS in the data path, and hold near-zero latency while doing it. This is real systems engineering — streaming, distributed, latency-obsessed — not another CRUD app behind a form.

You won't be starting cold. You inherit real infrastructure and real users, which means what you build reaches production in weeks, not years. The work is high-leverage from day one, and there's nowhere to hide — in the best way.

AI-native. Non-negotiable. You leverage AI to operate as a 10x engineer — demonstrable AI proficiency is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

What You'll Own

You take a capability from a rough idea all the way to production, and then you keep it alive and healthy there — meeting its latency and reliability targets, instrumented well enough to prove it, and hardened to survive real load and real failure. You own the outcome, not the ticket. You'll lead a functional area end to end: set its technical direction, make the calls that matter, and pull other engineers along with you.

Who You Are

  • You see what needs to exist and you go build it — you spot the gap, scope it yourself, and start, instead of waiting for someone to hand you a task or a spec.
  • You lead by taking the hardest, least-defined part of the problem and making it work, and others follow because your judgment and output earn it — not because of a title.
  • You own the entire arc — design, build, ship, operate — and you treat what happens in production as your responsibility, making sure the system behaves exactly within the parameters it's supposed to, not just that it passed in staging.
  • When you hit the edge of what you know — a protocol you've never touched, a failure mode you've never seen — curiosity and sheer grit carry you across it faster than most people expect.
  • "Good enough" makes you uncomfortable; you hold a high bar for yourself and ship work you're genuinely proud to put your name on.

What You Bring

  • Proven, demonstrable proficiency using AI as a force multiplier — you already operate as a 10x engineer, orchestrating AI tools and agents to design, build, and ship far beyond what you could alone, while keeping the judgment to know what "correct" actually looks like.
  • 5–7+ years building and operating production services and front ends, with real experience owning something end to end and carrying the weight of it once it's in front of real users.
  • Hands-on experience with TLS / MITM inspection and the security-sensitive edge cases that come with sitting in the middle of live traffic.
  • A real track record of taming latency in streaming and distributed systems — you've chased down p99 tail latency and know that "fast on my machine" means nothing until it's fast in production, under load, with observability to back it up.
  • Strong command of a modern backend language (Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node) and React/TypeScript on the front end, with a deep working grasp of HTTP, TLS, gRPC/REST, and async/streaming I/O.

The Associate Director, Market Access Strategic Marketing is an instrumental role responsible for the development, implementation, management, and execution of a coordinated, strategic plan and related tactics, deliverables, and customer-specific access activities. This person will align closely with all market access functions and field teams in support of current and future indications for BeOne’s hematology portfolio.

The successful candidate will develop and advance a comprehensive understanding of the market access landscape and customer needs, including value proposition development, pricing and contracting strategy, patient support programs, and healthcare policy trends. This role serves as a strategic partner across Commercial, Marketing, Medical Affairs, HEOR, Pricing, Contracting, Trade, Patient Services, Sales, Regulatory, and Finance to ensure market access priorities are reflected in brand strategy and execution. Success in this position requires a collaborative leadership style, strong cross-functional influence, and the ability to align stakeholders behind a unified access strategy.

  • Lead development of differentiated value propositions and customer-specific access messaging.
  • Translate clinical, economic, and real-world evidence into compelling customer narratives.
  • Develop payer-facing, provider-facing, and organized customer marketing tools and resources.

  • Serve as the market access representative on cross-functional brand teams.

  • Support launch readiness activities and lifecycle management initiatives.
  • Gather customer insights from internal and external stakeholders to inform strategy development.
  • Define success metrics for market access initiatives and evaluate performance.
  • Synthesize market trends, customer feedback, and business analytics into actionable recommendations.
  • Facilitate alignment across stakeholders to deliver integrated market access strategies.

The fine print (but way more exciting):
  • This is a remote role based in the UK with occasional in-person team meetups.
  • You'll be our first dedicated legal hire, so you're building the function and inheriting the old contracts and processes at the same time.

  • Our valuesactually matter here. We hire people who reflect them in how they work, collaborate, and make decisions.

Sales legal (35%)
  • Own commercial contracting end to end: our MSA, DPA, and customer red lines. You're who the Account Executives bring a marked up agreement to, and you're who closes it out

  • Build the playbooks, fallback positions, and templates that let AEs answer the easy questions without you

  • Own regulatory compliance as the landscape shifts: UK and EU GDPR, FCRA, the EU AI Act, and a growing patchwork of US state law
Partnerships, NDAs, and supplier terms (15%)

  • Own NDAs, supplier and vendor terms, and the contract lifecycle from template to signature to renewal
  • Negotiate with suppliers and integration partners so those terms stay robust and commercial
Data protection, governance, and audit readiness (30%)

jobs.excerpt: Notre mission est d’offrir une expérience de financement hypothécaire positive, et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.
jobs.description:
Notre mission est d’offrir une expérience de financement hypothécaire positive, et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin. Notre équipe se compose d'experts en technologie qualifiés, de spécialistes en prêts hypothécaires attentionnés et d'une équipe de marketing diversifiée, travaillant tous ensemble pour mener le changement dans l'industrie hypothécaire.

Chez nesto, nous sommes fiers de

  • Nos clients apprécient notre expérience positive, transparente et simplifiée en matière de financement hypothécaire.
  • Nos avis 4,5 étoiles sur Google parlent d'eux-mêmes !
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023 et 2024, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.
  • Nous sommes une organisation certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement à avoir un impact positif sur notre société et notre planète.
  • Notre équipe hautement qualifiée, diversifiée et collaborative, qui rend tout possible.
  • Notre plateforme Mortgage Cloud qui offre aux institutions financières un accès complet à la technologie exclusive de nesto, améliorant ainsi l’expérience du client, du début à la fin.

À propos du rôle

Nous sommes une équipe interdisciplinaire et dynamique qui travaille simultanément sur de multiples projets technologiques. Notre équipe est diversifiée et travaille sur différents produits, et chez nesto, nous reconnaissons qu'ils sont interconnectés.

Nous recherchons un.e. Développeur.euse en sécurité cloud pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception, l'implémentation et la maintenance de solutions de sécurité cloud pour protéger nos systèmes et applications basés sur le cloud. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de développement et d'opérations pour assurer la sécurité et l'intégrité de notre infrastructure cloud.

Nous valorisons une diversité de perspectives et d'expériences. Nous ne cherchons pas quelqu'un qui coche toutes les cases ; nous recherchons des apprenants passionnés et des personnes qui peuvent nous enrichir par leurs expériences uniques.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des contrôles de sécurité robustes pour protéger notre infrastructure et nos applications cloud.
  • Découvrir, corriger et valider les problèmes de sécurité à travers l'infrastructure cloud.
  • Effectuer des revues d'architecture et de conception sous l'angle de la sécurité et fournir des exigences et des recommandations opportunes et exploitables.
  • Collaborer avec la direction de la sécurité, les équipes de conformité et d'ingénierie pour exécuter les stratégies de sécurité.
  • Construire, déployer et gérer des outils de sécurité tels que WAF, IDS/IPS, protection des charges de travail, GCP Security Command Center, Azure Security Center, etc.
  • Proposer et contribuer aux améliorations de sécurité et de conformité pour les pipelines CI/CD et les processus de déploiement de nesto.
  • Automatiser les processus de provisionnement et de déploiement d'infrastructure en utilisant des outils d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) comme Terraform ou Pulumi.
  • Concevoir et opérer des processus évolutifs pour provisionner l'accès au cloud et maintenir le principe du moindre privilège.
  • Participer et soutenir le processus de détection et de réponse aux incidents en améliorant l'observabilité et les alertes, et en aidant l'équipe de réponse aux incidents.
  • S'auto-organiser et prioriser les activités de manière autonome.
  • Soutenir les audits et les questionnaires de sécurité de première partie.
  • Mener et superviser les évaluations de sécurité et les exercices de modélisation des menaces.
  • Implémenter des contrôles de sécurité au sein de Kubernetes.
  • Construire des outils/intégrations DevSecOps.

Qui nous recherchons

  • 5+ années d'expérience au sein d'une équipe axée sur l'infrastructure et/ou la sécurité.
  • 5+ années d'expérience en développement (idéalement GoLang, TypeScript/JS).
  • Connaissance des vulnérabilités courantes des applications web et du cadre OWASP Top 10.
  • Capacité à analyser et à agir sur les résultats des outils DAST et SAST (ex: Tenable, Snyk).
  • Maîtrise des principes DevSecOps et familiarité avec les pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Azure DevOps) pour effectuer des tests de sécurité automatisés.
  • Expérience dans le déploiement et la personnalisation d'outils de sécurité pour faire face aux menaces et réduire les risques, y compris les scanners de vulnérabilités, les analyseurs statiques, les pare-feu d'applications web (WAF), les systèmes de détection/prévention d'intrusion (IDS/IPS) et la surveillance de la sécurité des terminaux.
  • Une compréhension approfondie de la sécurité cloud et réseau, incluant une connaissance approfondie de Kubernetes.
  • Expérience avec GCP, spécifiquement avec un ou plusieurs des services suivants : Security Command Center, GKE, Cloud IDS, Cloud Armor et Secrets Manager.
  • Expérience avec Azure, spécifiquement avec un ou plusieurs des services suivants : Security Center, Azure PaaS App Services, VMs, Azure SQL, Front Door et Key Vault.
  • Expérience dans l'écriture d'infrastructure-as-code en utilisant des outils tels que Terraform, Pulumi et Helm.
  • Connaissance des cadres et des benchmarks de sécurité courants comme CIS, NIST et MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Une compréhension des principes de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM) et des solutions IAM cloud-natives.
  • Passionné par l'apprentissage continu et le partage des connaissances.
  • Bilingue (anglais et français).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions tohundreds of thousands of businessesand empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Sales Sr. Manager for Twilio.

About the job

This position is needed to lead one of our Strategic Account Executive teams selling into Southern Europe within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South and DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced Strategic relationship builder who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution selling Account Executives disciplined in growing and expanding existing customer relationships.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Build and manage a high performing team of account executives that manage existing customer relationships.
  • Lead a team to identify a focused strategy around existing client expansion selling solutions across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.
  • Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.
  • Work closely with our extended teams including but not limited to Professional Services, Marketing, Technical Specialists, Product & Partner teams to help existing customers achieve success as they launch new use cases onto the platform.
  • Accurately forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management
  • Foster a ‘Growth Mindset’ team of account executives where curiosity, learning and collaboration thrive in a dynamic Twilio environment.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 3+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company. Strong preference for experience with consumption-based revenue models.
  • Experience in building teams, managing all monthly forecasting, owning territory planning and revenue tracking for strategic accounts.
  • Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries.
  • Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business KPIs.
  • Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.
  • A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent required.
  • Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence in English, and an additional language between French, Spanish or Hebrew.
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.

Location

This role will be remote AND based in the United Kingdom, Spain or Ireland.

Travel

We prioritise connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way across the region.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.   • IT ticketek rögzítése, a szükséges új fejlesztésekhez.
  • Folyamatos kapcsolattartás az ügyféllel, visszajelzések bekérése, jóváhagyások kezelése.

  • Elhivatottság, felelősségteljes hozzáállás, precizitás, valamint képesség hatékony távmunka végzésére.

Benefits

  • Távmunka alapú együttműködést kínálunk (Slack, Zoom stb.-t hasznláunk a napi munkához),
  • Rugalmas munkaidő és lokáció: te döntöd el, mikor és honnan dolgozol: otthonról, kávézóból, nyaralóból, vagy akár a tengerpartról.
  • 2400 – 3200 EUR közötti havi díjazás, a tapasztalatod és képességeid alapján.
  • Egy különleges projekt részese leszel, amit naponta több ezer cég használ és robbanásszerűen növekszik világszerte.
  • Egy szuper csapat tagja lehetsz: ambiciózus, barátságos emberek, jó humorérzékkel és közös célokkal.
  • Minden nap tanulhatsz valami újat, első kézből láthatod az e-commerce fejlődését.

InvestX launched in 2014 and is a late-stage venture fund investing out of Fund 5. InvestX is backed by leading financial institutions including Jefferies, Virtu Financial, and Canaccord Genuity and has been featured in CNBC, Forbes, Bloomberg, U.S. News, Business Insider, Reuters, The Globe and Mail, and other leading publications.

About the Role

We are looking for a driven, high-energy Director, RIA Business Development to help expand InvestX's Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) distribution channel across the U.S.

This is a prospecting-first sales role for someone who gets energy from creating opportunities. You will spend a significant portion of your time identifying target RIAs, cold calling, executing outbound outreach, finding the right decision-makers, and turning new conversations into qualified meetings and opportunities.

Working closely with the Head of RIA Business Development, you will help build the top of the sales funnel and expand InvestX's reach within the independent wealth management market.

We're looking for a true hunter mentality. You are persistent, competitive, curious, and resourceful. You're comfortable picking up the phone, hearing "no," following up again, and finding another way into an account. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you—you create them.

Location: United States (Remote) or Hybrid (3 days in office) New York

What You'll Do

Prospect & Generate New Opportunities

  • Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting into RIAs across the U.S.
  • Cold call, email, and leverage LinkedIn and other prospecting tools to initiate new relationships.
  • Research target firms and identify financial advisors, CIOs, investment teams, portfolio managers, and other key decision-makers.
  • Secure qualified introductory meetings and new opportunities for the RIA Business Development team.
  • Consistently build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective RIA relationships.
  • Execute persistent, thoughtful follow-up to move prospects from initial outreach into active conversations.
  • Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts, opportunities, and next steps within Salesforce.
  • Identify creative ways to penetrate firms and reach decision-makers beyond traditional outbound outreach.

Support RIA Business Development

  • Partner closely with the Head of RIA Business Development to prioritize target firms and execute the broader RIA growth strategy.
  • Prepare prospect research, account intelligence, meeting materials, and follow-up.
  • Support opportunities as they progress from initial introduction through due diligence and approval.
  • Coordinate with National Accounts, Compliance, Legal, Operations, Marketing, and Sales to help move opportunities forward.
  • Track outstanding requirements, follow-ups, and next steps to maintain momentum throughout the sales process.
  • Develop an understanding of each firm's investment process, alternative investment requirements, and decision-making structure.

Build Relationships & Market Knowledge

  • Develop relationships with advisors and key stakeholders throughout the RIA ecosystem.
  • Build a strong understanding of the independent wealth management landscape and how RIAs evaluate private market investments.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market developments, and advisor demand.
  • Gather market feedback to help inform InvestX's sales approach, product positioning, and prospecting strategy.
  • Represent InvestX at select industry events, conferences, and advisor meetings.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of sales, business development, wholesaling, lead generation, or distribution experience within wealth management, asset management, financial services, or alternative investments.

Overview

Since 1972, Covenant House has served and advocated for youth and young families experiencing homelessness, human trafficking, and exploitation. Our overarching goal is to end homelessness among youth and young families by helping them achieve housing stability, heal from trauma, tap into their innate resilience, and hone their interests and skills to forge new pathways to independence. This work is carried out across Covenant House sites in 34 cities in the US, Canada, Mexico, Guatemala, and Honduras.

About the Role

The Director of State and Local Advocacy is responsible for strengthening advocacy capability across our domestic sites in the United States to help advance policy solutions that prevent and end youth homelessness, combat human trafficking, and address the social determinants of health that impact young people’s access to a bright, healthy, safe future.

This role is designed for an emerging mid-career policy leader who combines strong cross-cutting legislative and regulatory knowledge with a practical, implementation-oriented approach. The director will serve as a hands-on contributor who develops tools, analyzes policy landscapes, supports advocacy campaigns, builds partnerships, and translates policy opportunities into action; as well as a trusted advisor and coach to site leaders as staff.

The ideal candidate is someone who can independently lead projects, build trust across diverse stakeholders, cultivate strategic partnerships, navigate complex political environments, and help local leaders become more powerful and successful advocates. They are motivated by effectiveness rather than ideology, comfortable working across political perspectives, and committed to building durable bipartisan support for policies that improve outcomes for America’s most vulnerable young people.

In this role, you will report directly to the Senior Vice President of Advocacy and Strategic Partnerships. There are no direct reports to this role at this time. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of youth homelessness advocacy across the United States within an international federation of sites. In this role, you won't just analyze policy. You will help turn it into action, working across state and local systems in partnership with leaders, public officials, community providers, and young people. You'll have the autonomy to lead meaningful projects, the mentorship and visibility that come with partnering directly with senior leadership, and the opportunity to build a national reputation as an emerging public policy leader. If you are energized by solving complex problems, thrive in collaborative environments, enjoy translating strategy into execution, and want your work to have a tangible impact on the lives of vulnerable young people, this role offers a rare blend of mission, influence, growth, and purpose for a policy professional looking to take the next step in their career.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Policy Analysis and Strategy Development (45%)

  • Monitor state and local legislative, regulatory, and administrative developments affecting youth homelessness, housing, child welfare, trafficking, education, workforce development, behavioral health, and related social determinants of health

  • Conduct policy landscape analyses and identify opportunities for systems change in partnership with site leadership, frontline staff, community partners, and young people with lived experience and expertise

  • Produce policy briefs, issue papers, legislative summaries, talking points, fact sheets, and other advocacy materials

  • Translate complex policy developments into actionable guidance for nonprofit leaders, program staff with frontline experience and expertise, and youth with lived experience and expertise

  • Support the development of CHI's broader domestic advocacy agenda in partnership with the SVP of Advocacy & Strategic Partnerships

State and Local Advocacy Capacity Building (25%)

  • Design and implement capacity- and capability building strategies across CHI's sites in the United States

jobs.description:
About Sybilla Technologies
At Sybilla Technologies, we develop advanced Space Domain Awareness (SDA) and Space Situational Awareness (SSA) solutions that help governments, defense organizations, commercial operators and research institutions better understand, monitor and protect the space environment.

Our technologies support mission-critical operations where reliability, precision, and operational excellence are essential. We combine advanced optical observation systems, data analytics, and automation to deliver solutions that contribute to the safety, security, and sustainability of space activities.

Joining Sybilla Technologies means becoming part of a growing deep-tech company where engineering excellence, customer partnership and continuous innovation go hand in hand.

About the role
We are looking for a Junior Sensor Network Operator to join our Sensor Network Operations team and support the day-to-day operation of Sybilla Technologies' Global Sensor Network.
This is a hands-on operational role focused on ensuring that our sensors and robotic observatories operate reliably and that observation campaigns are executed on time and according to established standards.
You will monitor the health and operational status of the sensor network, execute routine and special observation campaigns, support troubleshooting and maintenance activities and assist with sensor deployments and commissioning.
You will also work with observation data and operational systems supporting activities such as launches, fragmentation events, payload separation, station keeping, manoeuvres, collision avoidance, satellite attitude monitoring and catalogue maintenance.

The role combines technical operations, observation execution and problem solving. It requires attention to detail, reliability and the ability to follow procedures while responding effectively when something does not work as expected.

As this is a junior position, you do not need to know everything from day one. You will receive dedicated onboarding and work closely with experienced specialists who will support your development in sensor operations, SSA/SDA and optical observation systems.

What you'll do
  • Monitor the health, availability and operational status of Sybilla Technologies' Global Sensor Network.
  • Execute routine and special observation campaigns according to defined priorities and procedures.
  • Create and support the execution of observing campaigns for different operational and customer requirements.
  • Monitor observation execution, data acquisition status and overall operational performance.
  • Support operational activities related to launches, payload separation, fragmentation events, station keeping, manoeuvres, collision avoidance, catalogue maintenance and attitude monitoring.
  • Monitor the timeliness and quality of observation data and identify potential anomalies or irregularities.
  • Perform first-level troubleshooting and diagnostics of sensors, observatories and related operational systems.
  • Escalate operational incidents according to established procedures.
  • Support preventive and corrective maintenance activities for sensors and robotic observatories.
  • Contact local support teams when basic on-site assistance is required.
  • Support sensor deployment, installation, commissioning and acceptance activities under the supervision of experienced team members.
  • Help ensure the safety, security and operational readiness of robotic observatories.
  • Prepare technical notes and documentation related to observation campaigns and operational activities.
  • Maintain operational logs, incident records, shift handovers and technical documentation.
  • Support testing and validation of new operational tools, procedures and system improvements.
  • Collaborate with engineering, software, data and operational teams to improve scheduling strategies, reporting tools, databases and operational processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational workflows and increase automation.
  • Support research and development activities related to new sensor-network technologies and operational methodologies.
  • Deliver assigned operational tasks within agreed timelines and quality standards.
  • Participate in on-duty operations and incident-response activities.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Sensor Network Operations.
What we're looking for
Required
  • Higher education in engineering, astronomy, physics, computer science or another STEM discipline - bachelor's or master's degree preferred.
  • Basic understanding of the space environment and satellite operations.
  • Interest in Space Situational Awareness (SSA), Space Surveillance and Tracking (SST) or Space Domain Awareness (SDA).
  • Basic understanding of optical telescopes, sensors or observatory operations.
  • Ability to follow technical procedures accurately and consistently.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to notice anomalies, unusual behaviour or unexpected patterns.
  • Ability to execute operational tasks on time and maintain a high standard of quality.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and ownership for assigned tasks.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Very good written and spoken English, including the ability to read and prepare technical documentation.
  • Basic experience with programming or scripting languages such as Python or C#.
  • Good knowledge of MS Office or a similar office suite.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary and international team.
  • Willingness to learn and continuously develop technical and operational expertise.
  • Ability and willingness to work in a shift-based operational environment, including occasional night and weekend shifts.
Nice to have
  • Degree in astrophysics, astronomy, aerospace engineering or a related discipline.
  • Previous experience with telescope operations or astronomical observations.
  • Experience with robotic observatories or distributed sensor networks.
  • Basic understanding of photometry, astrometry or satellite tracking.
  • Previous exposure to Space Situational Awareness, Space Surveillance and Tracking or Space Domain Awareness.
  • Experience working with Linux environments.
  • Basic understanding of databases and SQL.
  • Experience with Python, C#, automation or technical scripting.
  • Previous experience working in an operational or mission-critical technical environment.
  • Knowledge of additional languages.

What we offer
  • Remote-first work model, with occasional in-person meetings at our headquarters in Bydgoszcz.
  • Full-time employment under an employment contract or B2B agreement.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Dedicated onboarding and mentorship.
  • Opportunity to work with domain experts and international partners.
  • Access to conferences and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation based on your experience and skills.

Anticipated compensation
  • The compensation package will reflect your professional experience, qualifications and the anticipated seniority of the role.
  • European Union: EUR 3,000 – 4,000 gross per month (employment contract)
  • Poland: 8,400– 11,400 PLN gross per month (employment contract).
  • Please note that the final compensation package will depend on your professional experience, qualifications and overall fit for the role, and may be adjusted based on local market conditions and cost-of-living factors in each country.

Additional benefits
  • Flexible working hours.

  • Conference and professional development opportunities.
  • Opportunity to work on strategically important projects supporting the safety, security and sustainability of space operations.

  • "Outside-the-Box" Strategy:Act as a GTM pioneer. Research, build business cases, and present theses for targeting net-new opportunities for partnerships.

  • Existing Portfolio Triage:Audit our current roster of channel partners. Implement a strategy to activate dormant relationships, while ruthlessly pruning partnerships that do not yield enterprise-grade pipelines.

  • Forecasting & Analytics:Analyze your channel territories and provide accurate, real-time insights using our Sales CRM to report on Partner Activation Rates and pipeline velocity.


Requirements

To be successful in this role, youMUSTmeet the following core competencies and qualifications:

  • Experience:Minimum of 4 to 6 years of highly successful B2B sales experience, with at least 2 years specifically dedicated to Channel Sales or Strategic Partnerships specifically in the payments space.

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Our Mission


At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for the better. We are a company built on challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.


Your Career

As a Principal Technical Product Engineer within the Cortex organization, you will operate at the highest individual-contributor level, serving as a senior technical leader and strategic customer advocate bridging strategic customers, Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services.


As a Principal TPE, you are a force multiplier. You don't just solve hard problems for our most technically complex customers—you define how they should be solved by identifying patterns across the customer base, mentoring others to raise the bar, and directly influencing Cortex product strategy, technical direction, and roadmap decisions. You operate beyond individual customer engagements, translating complex technical and business challenges into actionable direction that shapes the future of our cloud-native and security operations platforms.


Your Impact


  • Set technical strategy and vision for cross-functional initiatives, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, and customers to drive innovation and ensure secure, scalable adoption of the Cortex platform.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor and primary technical voice to executive leadership (CISOs, security executives, cloud leaders), leading complex technical engagements involving Cortex architecture, deployment, integrations, scalability, and security strategy.

  • Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions by translating customer problems into clear product requirements, challenging and validating product assumptions using data and market intelligence, and prioritizing product gaps based on impact and value.

  • Provide technical leadership across Cortex, developing deep expertise in XSIAM, XDR, XSOAR, Cortex Cloud/CNAPP, detection and response, AI Security, Agentic AI, and MCP.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Support, and Marketing without relying on formal authority to solve high-visibility challenges.

  • Scale organizational knowledge and enablement by developing reusable architectures, playbooks, troubleshooting methodologies, best practices, and technical enablement for the field and partner teams.

  • Mentor and elevate technical professionals, raising the overall technical bar and building a culture of engineering excellence across the organization.

  • Maintain strong market and competitive intelligence, tracking competing products and emerging capabilities to provide actionable insights to leadership and Product Management.

Your Experience


  • Proven ability to inspire and influence teams, colleagues, and executives, paired with a strong track record of independent execution and delivery.

  • Deep cybersecurity and cloud technical expertise, with the ability to set direction rather than simply respond to it.

  • Extensive experience leading cross-functional programs in fast-paced environments, managing multiple high-stakes projects and strategic enterprise customers simultaneously.

  • Exceptional professional presence and confidence advising audiences ranging from practitioners to C-level executives.

  • A collaborative leader who creatively and effectively solves the most complex issues and proactively establishes scalable solutions rather than solving isolated problems repeatedly.

  • Deep affinity for technology and a relentless drive to master product, market, and competitive details, including emerging areas like AI Security and Agentic AI.

  • Strong work ethic, integrity, and organizational discipline.

  • Extensive experience working with strategic enterprise customers and major cloud infrastructure providers.

  • Strong background in security orchestration, automation, and response (SOAR), XSIAM, XDR, or CNAPP technologies.

  • Demonstrated mastery of securing modern cloud platforms and application architectures.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with outstanding executive-level presentation abilities.

MEP BIM / VDC Specialist

At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future.

Building for the long-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way.

About Us:

Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges.

We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more.

Our technical expertise is paired with an exceptional team of business development, human resources, finance and accounting, information technology, and marketing professionals, all of whom play a key role in bringing our commitments to life every day.

Job Summary: You are fascinated with Building Information Modeling and MEP building systems. You’re passionate about helping engineering teams work more efficiently through well-structured Revit models, standards, and content. You love to collaborate with technically proficient teams. And you never stop growing.

Salas O'Brien is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented BIM Specialist to join our team with a primary focus on supporting Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) design teams. This role will provide dedicated BIM expertise to engineers and technical design staff across multiple project types, including commercial office, mission critical/data centers, telecommunications, and industrial facilities.

The BIM Specialist will support project setup, model development at LOD 200, 300, and 350 and model health, coordination, documentation, MEP content and family management. The role will help engineering teams work effectively in Revit and will also support broader BIM and Digital Delivery initiatives through the development and maintenance of BIM content, standards, and workflows.

This position reports to the BIM Manager and works as an integrated member of multidisciplinary project teams, primarily dedicated to MEP efforts.

Responsibilities:

  • Set up, develop, and maintain Revit MEP models and associated project documentation throughout project phases.
  • Support Mechanical and Electrical engineers and production staff with Revit workflows, model setup, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish and maintain model standards including links, coordinates, worksharing, views, sheets, and model health.
  • Develop, maintain, and organize MEP families, content, templates, shared parameters, and related BIM standards.
  • Coordinate MEP models with Architectural, Structural, and other disciplines, including model review and clash detection.
  • Perform BIM quality control to support model accuracy, consistency, and project deliverable requirements.
  • Support AutoCAD-to-Revit and Revit-to-AutoCAD workflows when required by project or client deliverables.
  • Participate in BIM and Digital Delivery process improvement, standards development, and team training initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) building systems, engineering documentation, and BIM workflows.
  • Strong Autodesk Revit MEP skills, including project setup, worksharing, linked models, views/sheets, system modeling, and family/content management.
  • Ability to develop and maintain coordinated MEP BIM models and construction documentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot Revit model, family, visibility, and coordination issues in support of engineering teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a service-oriented approach to project support.
  • Experience with Bluebeam or Adobe Acrobat PDF workflows.
  • Experience working within Autodesk Forma (ACC) and/or BIM 360 environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting Mechanical and/or Electrical engineering teams in a BIM specialist, BIM coordinator, or similar role.
  • Experience with model coordination and clash detection tools and workflows.
  • Experience with Dynamo, pyRevit, or other BIM automation tools.
  • Familiarity with BIM standards, MEP content management, digital delivery processes, and interoperability.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Educational Background: Technical diploma or degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, BIM/VDC, Construction, Architectural Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of MEP drafting/modeling, BIM coordination, or related building systems experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience using Autodesk Revit, preferably Revit MEP, in a professional environment.

Location: Remote

Travel: None

Compensation & Benefits:

Salas O’Brien health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well-being. Your security. Your future. Team members have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Salas O’Brien has both U.S. and Canadian (PTO) plans for full-time salaried, exempt and non-team members, 10 paid holidays, and paid leave programs for military service and new parents. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock.

The base salary range for this position is $75,000 to $95,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Salas O’Brien provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state/provincial, or local laws. Salas O’Brien will accommodate the disability-related needs of applicants as required by law.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, SEO & GEOSearch Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels Push the boundaries of discovery.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Apollo's partner ecosystem already spans thousands of agencies, consultancies, and solution providers who've raised their hand — but most of that potential goes untapped without a dedicated motion to find, qualify, and activate the right ones. As Partner Development Manager (PDM), you'll own that motion end to end: identifying high-potential partners across every segment, driving them through certification and enablement, and pushing each one to their first real activation — a managed customer or a qualified referral.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not stepping into an established program, you're helping build the one that gets to define how Apollo turns partner interest into partner value. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping what this program becomes.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into real partners, activated and growing in whatever way fits their business.

You'll run a structured, self-paced activation pathway across a book of 40–60 partners at a time, and you'll make the call on whether each one is ready to graduate into Apollo's high-touch named-partner program, move into scaled/automated nurture, or step back. This is a builder's role: the acquisition-to-activation playbook is still being defined, and how you run it will shape how Apollo's partner organization scales.

Key Responsibilities

Target and Recruit

  • Source high-potential partners across all segments — inbound applications, customer referrals, ecosystem research, and partner nominations
  • Score and prioritize every candidate against Apollo's Ideal Partner Profile (IPP) before investing further time
  • Build and maintain a live cultivation list of 40–60 active partners

Qualify and Segment

  • Determine each partner's segment (e.g., RevOps, lead-gen, sales training, AI-native/headless GTM, or generalist marketing agency), specialization, ICP, and delivery model
  • Separate partners with a genuine, Apollo-centered motion from generic interest

Certify and Enable

  • Drive partners through Apollo's certification curriculum and onboarding
  • Help each partner package a concrete Apollo offer, referral motion, or delivery service
  • Prepare partners for their first live customer conversation

Create the First Activation

  • Push every partner toward a first measurable activation event: a qualified referral, a registered opportunity, or a managed customer
  • Track progress against a shared, partner-visible activation plan with clear gates and goals

Develop Toward Graduation

  • Run a consistent cadence with each partner across the activation pathway, and keep them accountable to it
  • Recommend next steps for every partner: promotion into Apollo's named-partner (PAM) program, a move to scaled/automated nurture, or deprioritization
  • Partner cross-functionally with Partner Operations on data quality and reporting, and with Partner Marketing on segment-specific enablement and recruitment campaigns

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in partner development, channel sales, business development, or a related partnerships role, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Track record building relationships with agencies, consultancies, or solution-provider partners from first contact through onboarding
  • Comfortable running a structured, multi-stage pipeline across a high-volume book of accounts (40+)
  • Strong qualification instincts — able to separate a partner's real potential from surface-level interest
  • Excellent program-management skills; you'll be building the playbook as you run it, not just following one
  • Clear, confident communicator who can enable and certify both non-technical and technical partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems
  • Experience with partner/channel scoring or qualification frameworks (e.g., an Ideal Partner Profile or lead-scoring model)
  • Familiarity with partner-management or PRM tooling (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)
  • Background operating in a GTM/RevOps ecosystem, or with agencies that build on top of sales-engagement or data platforms
  • Experience designing or running a partner certification/enablement curriculum

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

Colaborarás con una startup fintech que mueve dinero entre Estados Unidos, México y Centroamérica. Su producto es un asistente conversacional que guía al usuario desde la cotización hasta el pago, y hoy evoluciona de chatbot a agente conversacional.

El equipo de data es pequeño y de alto impacto. Mantiene el data warehouse y un servidor MCP conectado a su plataforma de IA corporativa, y ahora crece hacia modelos predictivos (incluido un scoring propio de fraude que debe funcionar en varios países), segmentación de usuarios y agentes que convierten esos resultados en insights accionables.

Buscamos a alguien que combine ciencia de datos con IA aplicada: que construya modelos, los evalúe con rigor y los lleve a producción junto con agentes y LLMs. Es un entorno startup, con prioridades que cambian y picos de trabajo, y con una cultura que cuida el equilibrio entre vida personal y laboral.

  • 4+ años de experiencia en ciencia de datos o ML, con al menos 1 año construyendo soluciones con LLMs que hayas llevado a producción.

  • Experiencia trabajando de forma remota con equipos distribuidos.

Habilidades blandas

  • Comunica resultados técnicos a públicos no técnicos y traduce modelos en decisiones.

Formación y señales deseadas

  • Licenciatura o ingeniería en Ciencias de la Computación, Matemáticas, Estadística o afín.

  • Disponibilidad para colaborar en horario cercano al de Ciudad de México.

Responsabilidades

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of GTM Finance to lead the financial strategy and operating cadence across our go-to-market organization.

This leader will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM Operations to translate company growth objectives into actionable plans across bookings, pipeline, capacity, productivity, retention, investment, and profitability.

This is a highly visible leadership role for someone who combines strong financial judgment with deep SaaS and GTM operating experience. The right candidate will be equally comfortable advising executives, challenging assumptions, building rigorous financial models, and diving into the underlying data and processes when needed.

A critical part of the role is modernizing how GTM Finance operates. We expect this leader to embrace AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve forecast accuracy, accelerate decision-making, strengthen controls, and reduce manual work.

The role will also have meaningful responsibility for sales compensation and commissions, including plan economics, forecasting, governance, administration, and partnership with Accounting and GTM leadership.

What You Will Own

  • Lead Finance partnership for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other GTM functions, providing a clear financial point of view on performance, investments, tradeoffs, and growth opportunities.
  • Own GTM planning and forecasting across bookings, ARR, pipeline, sales capacity, productivity, headcount, operating expenses, retention, and other key business drivers.
  • Develop a deep understanding of GTM performance and proactively identify risks and opportunities before they become visible in reported results.
  • Partner with Sales and GTM Operations on capacity planning, territory and quota assumptions, ramp, productivity, pipeline coverage, conversion, and resource allocation.
  • Partner with Marketing leadership to evaluate demand generation performance, investment efficiency, pipeline creation, attribution, and allocation of resources across programs and channels.
  • Support Customer Success and Renewals leadership with retention, churn, expansion, renewal economics, and capacity planning.
  • Lead the financial strategy and governance for sales compensation plans, including plan design, modeling, quota economics, incentive alignment, and cost forecasting.
  • Oversee commissions forecasting and administration in partnership with Accounting and Sales Compensation, with a strong focus on accuracy, controls, scalability, and clear ownership.
  • Build executive-ready narratives that connect financial results with operational drivers and clearly articulate what happened, why it happened, and what actions should follow.
  • Provide financial leadership on major GTM initiatives, including new products, geographic expansion, pricing and packaging changes, channel investments, productivity programs, and other growth initiatives.
  • Build and continuously improve driver-based financial models that connect pipeline, capacity, productivity, conversion, retention, and investment assumptions to bookings, ARR, revenue, and profitability.
  • Use AI, automation, and advanced analytics to improve forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, scenario planning, and recurring Finance processes.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual workflows and build more scalable processes across planning, reporting, commissions, and business partnership activities.
  • Establish clear metrics, operating cadences, and management reporting that enable GTM and Finance leaders to make faster and better decisions.
  • Lead, develop, and raise the bar for the GTM Finance team, creating clear accountability while building strong relationships across Finance and the business.

What We Are Looking For

  • 12+ years experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related discipline, including leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or recurring revenue business.
  • Deep understanding of SaaS and GTM economics, including ARR, bookings, pipeline, conversion, sales capacity, rep productivity, retention, and customer acquisition.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or materially influencing GTM planning, forecasting, and resource allocation.
  • Strong experience partnering directly with senior Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance executives.
  • Meaningful experience with sales compensation strategy, plan modeling, quota economics, commissions forecasting, or commissions administration.
  • Strong command of operating expense and headcount management, with the ability to connect investments to business outcomes.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to move comfortably between detailed operating analysis and executive-level strategic discussions.
  • Strong financial modeling skills and experience building driver-based forecasts and scenarios in complex, rapidly changing environments.
  • Ability to translate large amounts of financial and operational data into concise insights, recommendations, and actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to improve processes, systems, controls, and operating discipline rather than simply manage existing workflows.
  • Strong interest in AI and automation, with practical experience using modern tools to improve Finance productivity, analysis, or decision support.
  • High ownership mindset. Comfortable personally driving important work while also building a team that can operate independently at scale.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. MBA, CPA, or equivalent advanced experience is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or another complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • Experience with modern planning, BI, CRM, commissions, and data platforms.
  • Experience applying machine learning, data science, or AI techniques to forecasting, pipeline analytics, or financial planning.
  • Experience supporting new product launches, multi product expansion, international expansion, channel strategy, or multi-product GTM models.

This role is expected to contribute across the full technology stack, including user-facing applications, APIs, data models, asynchronous workflows, distributed integrations, messaging infrastructure, and production support. The position requires strong full stack development experience, deep backend engineering instincts, and the ability to make sound technical decisions in message-driven and distributed system environments. The Senior Software Engineer will help shape technical direction, deliver business-critical capabilities, mentor other engineers, and take operational ownership of assigned systems and functional areas. The ideal candidate is curious, adaptable, AI-aware, and eager to learn and responsibly apply emerging tools and practices that improve engineering speed, software quality, and team effectiveness.

  • Action Oriented – Takes on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

At Telespeech Therapy, our mission is to empower children and adults to achieve their highest

communication potential—no matter where they are. We connect students, families, and

educators through innovative teletherapy services that remove geographic barriers to care.

Since our founding, we have built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality speech therapy

Speech-Language Pathologist, we truly understand the work you do and the impact you make

every day.

We are looking for a compassionate and motivated SLP who is excited to use technology to

transform student outcomes while working remotely in a supportive and flexible environment.

  • Flexible engagement models to meet your professional and lifestyle needs:

1099 Independent Contractor Option

  • Fully Remote – Provide services from the comfort of your home
  • Supportive Team Culture – Collaborate with experienced clinicians and educators
