Position Summary

The Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) delivers high-quality remote speech therapy

services to school-aged students. This role focuses on assessing, diagnosing, and treating

speech and language disorders while collaborating with school teams to support student

success. The SLP utilizes teletherapy tools to provide effective, engaging, and individualized

care aligned with each student’s educational goals. The SLP will also mentor/supervise our

SLPAs.

Essential Functions

An individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily with or without

accommodation. The requirements listed below represent, but are not all-inclusive, of the

required knowledge, skills, and/or abilities.

Responsibilities

• Assessment and Evaluation:

◦ Conduct comprehensive virtual assessments using standardized and non-

standardized tools appropriate for telepractice

◦ Interpret evaluation data to determine eligibility for special education services

under IDEA guidelines

◦ Complete initial evaluations, re-evaluations, and screenings within required school

timelines

◦ Prepare clear, compliant evaluation reports for school teams and families

• Treatment Planning:

◦ Develop and implement Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) aligned with

student needs and academic goals

◦ Establish measurable, functional, and standards-based speech and language goals

◦ Adapt therapy plans to accommodate diverse learning styles, cultural backgrounds,

and communication needs

◦ Ensure services align with district, state, and federal special education

requirements

• Therapeutic Services:

◦ Deliver engaging, evidence-based speech therapy sessions via teletherapy

platforms

◦ Utilize digital tools, interactive materials, and strategies to maintain student

engagement in a virtual setting

◦ Provide therapy for articulation, language, pragmatics, fluency, and voice disorders

◦ Manage both individual and small group sessions effectively in an online

environment

◦ Implement behavior management strategies appropriate for virtual sessions

• Collaboration:

◦ Work closely with teachers, special education staff, and school administrators to

support student success

◦ Communicate regularly with parents/caregivers regarding progress, strategies, and

carryover activities

◦ Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including psychologists, occupational

therapists, and counselors

◦ Participate actively in IEP meetings, eligibility meetings, and student support

discussions

◦ Provide consultation to school staff on classroom strategies and accommodations

• Progress Monitoring:

◦ Collect and analyze data on student performance during sessions

◦ Monitor progress toward IEP goals and adjust therapy approaches as needed

◦ Prepare and present progress reports in accordance with school district timelines

◦ Ensure compliance with service minutes and documentation requirements

• Documentation and Compliance:

◦ Maintain accurate, timely, and legally compliant documentation of therapy

sessions, evaluations, and communications

◦ Track service delivery to ensure alignment with IEP mandates

◦ Complete billing, logs, and required district documentation systems

◦ Adhere to FERPA, HIPAA (if applicable), and all confidentiality standards

  • Technology and Telepractice Management:

◦ Utilize teletherapy platforms effectively for scheduling, service delivery, and

documentation

◦ Troubleshoot basic technical issues to minimize disruptions during sessions

◦ Maintain a professional virtual environment conducive to therapy

◦ Ensure secure handling of student data and digital records

• Professional Responsibilities:

◦ Stay current with best practices in teletherapy and school-based speech-language

pathology

◦ Maintain licensure and certifications as required

◦ Participate in professional development and training opportunities

◦ Uphold ethical standards outlined by ASHA and state licensing boards

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • A Master’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology.
  • Valid California State License in Speech-Language Pathology— must be maintained

throughout employment.

• Current ASHA certification (CCC-SLP)

  • Equivalent to two (2) years of experience working with school-aged students in an

educational setting

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities/Talents

  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local regulatory requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of speech, fluency, language, voice, cognitive, hearing, and social

communication disorders, with the ability to accurately evaluate, diagnose, and

provide evidence-based treatment across school-aged populations.

  • Ability to develop and implement individualized, student-centered therapy plans
  • Ability to work effectively within an interdisciplinary team to achieve quality

outcomes, while ensuring precise, timely documentation that meets all professional,

ethical, and regulatory standards.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with remote teams and school personnel

Physical Demands

  • Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, speak, and hear
  • Sufficient hand dexterity to use a computer keyboard and be capable of reading a

computer screen

  • Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds

Report to

• School Services Director

Classification

• Remote position

  • Flexible engagement options: W2 (employee) or 1099 (independent

contractor)

  • Full-time and part-time opportunities available

Salary

Pay: $55.00 - $65.00 per hour

Independent contractor roles must meet applicable state and federal guidelines. Final

classification will be determined based on role requirements and legal criteria.

  • Collaborative: co-creating innovative solutions with key stakeholders in the internal and external ecosystem

Education, Experience and Qualifications:

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

As a Commerce Experience Lead, you will be the primary point of contact for customers of Stord’s Commerce software suite. Your role focuses on ensuring a successful and smooth onboarding experience, activation of the products, and on-going success and valuable outcomes from use of the products. You will be tasked with ensuring product adoption, customer satisfaction, and demonstrable ROI through training, performance monitoring, and strategic account management. You will collaborate with Engineering, Product, Solutions, and where relevant Fulfillment and Implementations teams to ensure successful product implementation, address technical issues, and identify growth opportunities. Through regular business reviews, usage analytics, and customer health monitoring, you will drive software adoption and long-term customer relationships.

In addition to leading day-to-day customer engagement, you will build scalable onboarding programs, develop standardized training and enablement materials, and create repeatable processes that support consistent customer activation. You will also play a critical role in influencing product direction, improving cross-functional workflows, and supporting renewal and expansion strategies. By combining technical fluency, data-driven insights, and strong customer advocacy, you will elevate the overall maturity of Stord’s software customer experience and ensure customers achieve sustained value from the platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers across Stord's Commerce suite and future Commerce product lines

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding experience, guiding customers from kickoff through activation to steady-state usage with a focus on fast, reliable time-to-value

  • Work with Solutions Consulting, CX, and Implementations teams to drive product adoption and growth through customer trainings, onboarding programs, and ongoing education on product capabilities

    • Conduct product configuration and basic troubleshooting in partnership with Product Managers and Engineering Managers

    • Coordinate with Fulfillment and Implementations teams where Commerce products intersect with physical operations, ensuring a unified customer experience across software and fulfillment

    • Develop customer success playbooks specific to Commerce products, including scalable, repeatable onboarding checklists, activation tracking, training materials, and adoption milestones

  • Develop a deep understanding of each account's business model, commerce operations, and growth potential to provide tailored solutions

    • Identify opportunities for new revenue and collaborate with Solutions Consulting on customer growth, renewal, and expansion strategies

    • Monitor and optimize product performance metrics, tracking usage patterns, feature adoption rates, customer value metrics, and customer health scores to ensure customers realize value in alignment with their goals

  • Execute ROI campaigns and value demonstrations, preparing data-driven presentations to support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) in partnership with Product, CX, and Solutions teams

  • Address and resolve client issues while ensuring high customer satisfaction

  • Problem-solve by developing new solutions, methods, and systems that drive customer success

What You’ll Need

  • Proven experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing/Marketing Operations related software, customer success, SaaS account management, or enterprise customer experience roles

    • Experience in Ecommerce, DTC brands, or post-purchase / commerce experience software

    • Familiarity with commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify) and post-purchase / checkout technologies

  • Strong product and technical acumen with the ability to learn complex software platforms quickly and conduct basic configuration and troubleshooting

  • Experience driving software adoption, including developing training programs, tracking usage metrics, and measuring customer health scores

  • Experience owning onboarding and activation, with a track record of reducing time-to-value for new customers

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

The Senior Director, Compliance Monitoring and Surveillance leads a team of compliance professionals responsible for identifying and addressing compliance control gaps, potential operational deficiencies in compliance controls, and potential compliance violations. This leader establishes the strategy and directs ongoing compliance monitoring and surveillance activities across Empower’s front-office functions, including Empower Personal Wealth and Workplace Solutions.


The Sr. Director also leads strategic initiatives supporting Empower’s compliance program and culture through initiation, development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement.


What You Will Do

  • Partner with Empower Compliance leadership to establish strategies, priorities, goals, and procedures for the Compliance Monitoring and Surveillance program across Empower Personal Wealth and Workplace Solutions.
  • Lead the effective and efficient detection of compliance control gaps, deficiencies, and potential violations involving sales practices, marketing, client interactions, electronic communications, and other front-office activities.

  • Experience leveraging surveillance technology, data analytics, reporting, and automation to strengthen compliance monitoring and risk detection
  • Strong knowledge of SEC, FINRA, DOL, and applicable state regulatory requirements relevant to front-office financial services activities
  • Strong knowledge of supervisory control frameworks, sales practice monitoring, surveillance methodologies, and front-office compliance oversight
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and objectively measure regulatory and operational risks, evaluate the effectiveness of compliance controls, and recommend practical, risk-based solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to develop, analyze, and interpret data, metrics, and reporting to identify trends, emerging risks, and opportunities for program enhancement
  • Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex compliance matters and influence senior leaders and diverse stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leadership and business leaders on compliance risks, strategic initiatives, governance activities, and business objectives

About the Project

DataForce by TransPerfect is looking for American Sign Language (ASL) and Black American Sign Language (BASL) signers across the United States to participate in a paid remote research project.

The goal of this project is to help make technology more accessible for everyone and promote greater inclusion of Deaf and signing communities in the development of future technologies.

We believe that projects involving ASL, BASL, and the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities should include meaningful representation from the communities themselves. Our project team includes Deaf and Hard of Hearing professionals who are directly involved in the administration and development of the project.

Their perspectives help us make informed decisions, advocate for the interests of the community, and ensure that accessibility, cultural considerations, and participant experience are represented throughout the project.

What You’ll Do

Participants will record approximately 1,000 short ASL/BASL videos from home, including phrases, numbers, fingerspelling sequences, and conversational prompts.

Each recording is approximately 10 seconds long. Completing the full set is expected to take approximately 10 hours in total.

The project can be completed remotely from home using a compatible Apple device.

This is a project-based opportunity and not a full-time employment position.

  • Be 18 years of age or older

  • Be fluent in American Sign Language (ASL) and/or Black American Sign Language (BASL)

  • Currently reside in the United States, excluding Texas, Illinois, and Washington

  • Be able to understand written English instructions

  • Be comfortable recording yourself on video

  • Have a suitable environment at home for recording

  • Have access to a compatible Apple device:

    • iPhone 12 or newer

    • iPad 9th Generation (2021) or newer

    • MacBook with M1 chip or newer

    • iMac with M1 chip or newer

Why Participate?

Your contribution will help support the development of technologies that better recognize and represent ASL, BASL, and diverse signing communities.

jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Job Summary

The Senior Solutions Architect – Microsoft AI is a revenue-carrying presales leader responsible for driving new business within SHI’s Data & AI professional services practice. This role is the practice’s primary technical authority on Microsoft’s AI and automation capabilities: Copilot for Microsoft 365, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Power Platform.

This individual will own a personal bookings target and operate across the full presales lifecycle—from discovery and technical qualification through solution design, proposal development, proof-of-concept delivery, and executive presentation. A critical aspect of this role is close collaboration with SHI’s specialist Solution Architects in data platform (Fabric & Power BI), data governance (Purview), and security to assemble holistic, integrated solutions for clients. While the specialist SAs bring deep expertise in their respective domains, this role ensures that the AI and agent layer is architected to take full advantage of those foundations—and that client-facing solutions tell a unified story rather than a collection of disconnected workstreams.

A key growth area for this role is AI agent development and multi-agent orchestration. As enterprises move beyond simple chatbots toward autonomous agents that reason, plan, and take action, this SA will be responsible for developing SHI’s capabilities, methodologies, and market positioning in this rapidly emerging space. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building production agents and a clear vision for how multi-agent architectures will reshape enterprise operations.

Role Description

Revenue Ownership & Pipeline Development

  • Own and achieve an annual gross profit target for AI-led professional services engagements

  • Partner with SHI Account Executives and Microsoft co-sell teams toidentify, qualify, and advance AI and Copilot opportunities across the existing customer base

  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline across multiple engagement types: pilot programs, platform foundations, advanced AI acceleration, adoption recovery, and targeted point solutions

  • Develop account-level AI readiness assessments and multi-phase engagement roadmaps that create long-term revenue expansion

  • Contribute to quarterly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and win/loss analysis

AI Agent Development & Market-Making

  • Serve as SHI’s subject matter expert on agentic AI, Copilot Studio agent development, Azure AI Foundry, and multi-agent orchestration patterns

  • Develop and evolve SHI’s service offerings for AI agent design, development, and deployment—from single-purpose task agents through complex multi-agent environments

  • Build reusable reference architectures, demo environments, and proof-of-concept templates thatdemonstratereal-world agent scenarios to prospective clients

  • Track Microsoft’s agent platform roadmap (Copilot Studio, Azure AI Agent Service, Semantic Kernel,AutoGen) and translate emerging capabilities into client-ready service offerings

  • Advise clients on agent governance, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for autonomous systems

Technical Presales & Solution Design

  • Lead discovery workshops and technical assessment sessions to understand client current state, pain points, and strategic AI objectives

  • Architect AI and automation solutions using Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Power Platform, ensuring designs account for the data, governance, and security foundationsrequiredfor production-grade deployment

  • Collaborate closely with SHI’s Fabric/Power BI, Purview, and Security specialist SAs to assemble integrated, multi-discipline solutions—ensuring the AI layer is designed toleveragethe client’s data platform and governance investments

  • Design solutions using SHI’s modular, productized service catalog, assembling engagements from standardized delivery modules to provide clients with fixed-price predictability and rapid time-to-value

  • Translate technical designs into commerciallyviableproposals with clear scope boundaries, assumptions, and risk considerations

Client Engagement & Executive Presentation

  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders from IT directors through C-suite executives on AI strategy and Copilot adoption

  • Deliver compelling executive presentations that articulate why successful AI adoption requires an integrated approach—connecting unified data, robust governance, and organizational readiness as interdependent foundations

  • Lead competitive displacement conversations, positioning SHI’s integrated, end-to-end approach against competitors who offer only data engineering, only governance, or only chatbot development in isolation

  • Build andmaintaindemo environmentsshowcasingreal-world agent scenarios, including multi-agent workflows, Copilot extensibility, and Power Platform automation

Proposal Development & Deal Structuring

  • Author technical content for proposals and SOWs including solution overviews, design rationale, delivery plans, and work breakdown structures

  • Collaborate with delivery leadership and specialist SAs to ensure proposals reflect realistic scope, timelines, and resource requirements across all disciplines involved

  • Structure engagements using SHI’s fixed-price delivery model withappropriate phasegates and risk mitigation

  • Participate in internal proposal reviews and quality assurance processes before client submission

Microsoft Ecosystem & Thought Leadership

  • Maintain deep, currentexpertisein Copilot for M365, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform, and the broader Microsoft AI ecosystem

  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft security capabilities—sufficient to collaborate effectively with specialist SAs and contribute to integrated solution designs

  • Represent SHI at Microsoft events, industry conferences, and client-facing workshops, with particular emphasis on agent development and AI thought leadership

  • Contribute to SHI’s internal knowledge base, proposal templates, and solution accelerators

  • Pursue andmaintainrelevant Microsoft certifications and community recognition (MVP status encouraged)

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Adaptability: Can lead others through change, help teams adapt to new directions, and create a culture open to change.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Teamwork: Can build and lead multiple teams, fostering a cooperative environment and ensuring effective communication between team members.

  • Self-Motivation: Can take ownership of complex personal or professional initiatives, collaborate with others when necessary, and drive results through self-motivation.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Proficiency in overseeing and directing projects to completion, ensuring goals are met, resources are utilized efficiently, and stakeholders are satisfied - Expert

  • Ability to systematically identify, document, and manage the technical needs and specifications of a project by engaging with stakeholders and analyzing business objectives to ensure successful project outcomes - Expert

  • Ability to define, design, build, and maintain robust systems and solutions by leveraging systems and infrastructure effectively - Expert

  • Ability to write, debug, and maintain code in various scripting and programming languages to automate tasks and develop software solutions - Expert

  • Ability to understand and manage various infrastructure components (firewalls, load balancers, hypervisors, storage, monitoring, security) and use orchestration tools to develop comprehensive technical solutions - Expert

  • Ability to develop detailed Statements of Work (SOWs) and drive revenue growth through professional services engagements - Expert

  • Extensive experience working on large scale IT projects related to design, deployment and configuration - Expert

Other Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in solution architecture, presales engineering, or technical consulting within the Microsoft ecosystem

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft AI and automation technologies: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry (or Azure OpenAI Service), Power Platform, or Copilot for M365 extensibility

  • Demonstrated experience designing and building AI agents, conversational AI solutions, or intelligent automation workflows in a production or client-facing context

  • Demonstratedtrack recordof carrying and achieving a personal revenue or bookings target ($3M+ annually preferred)

  • Working familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Purview—sufficient toparticipatein integrated solution design alongside specialist architects

  • Strong executive communication skills with proven ability to present to C-level audiences and lead strategic technology conversations

  • Experience developing proposals, SOWs, and commercial structures for professional services engagements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Preferred Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel,AutoGen,LangGraph, or similar)

  • Microsoft certifications: Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600), Azure AI Engineer (AI-102), Fabric Analytics Engineer (DP-600), or Azure Data Engineer (DP-203)

  • Microsoft MVP designation in any relevant category

  • Experience with RAG architectures, prompt engineering, grounding techniques, and responsible AI/safety considerations for autonomous agents

  • Prior employment at a Microsoft partner, VAR, or consulting firm with a productized services model

  • Experience with competitive displacement against firms such as Slalom, Ahead, WWT, or Big 4 consultancies

  • Understanding of data platform architecture patterns includinglakehouse/medallion architecture and modern data warehousing

  • Background in one or more industry verticals: financial services, healthcare, retail, or gaming/hospitality

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $175,000 - $235,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

jobs.description:
WEG VERWALTER/IN (m/w/d) - Remote oder Berlin Office

Vollzeit/Teilzeit/Freelancer

Gestalte die Zukunft der Hausverwaltung mit Ralph!

Hast du Lust mit einem innovativen Start-Up eine ganz Branche zu revolutionieren? Ralph (www.ralph-hv.de) ist Tech-Start-Up und Berlins modernste Hausverwatung zugleich. Wir denken Hausverwaltung von Grund auf neu, denn einiges muss sich bei Hausverwaltungen ändern! Wir verbinden unsere eigene Software mit der Expertise von erfahrenen Verwalter/-innen und einem starken operativen Team, das dir als Verwalter:in den Rücken frei hält. Ralphs Mission ist es, die Branche endlich ins 21 Jahrhundert zu bringen und alle Services via App anzubieten.

Beschreibung der Rolle

Es handelt sich um eine hybride Vollzeitstelle als WEG Verwalter:in. Als WEG-Verwalter:in bist du für den direkten Kontakt zu den Beiräten verantwortlich und organisierst und leitest die Eigentümerversammlungen. Du hast aber ein ganzes Team um die herum: Ein operatives Team, das für dich Tickets beantwortet, Aufträge auslöst, Architekten, die Begehungen begleiten können und ein Buchhaltungsteam. Als WEG Verwalter kannst du dich auch für den Aufbau von Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden engagieren, bietest einen außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice und trägst somit direkt zum Wachstum und zur Entwicklung des Unternehmens bei. Somit arbeitest du bei uns strategischer und weniger operativ als du es ggf. von anderen Verwaltungen gewohnt bist.

Hast du Lust, die Zukunft der Hausverwaltung mitzuentwickeln?

Deine Aufgaben

Du möchtest unser Wachstum in Berlin vorantreiben und dabei Eigentümer/-innen mit unserem Produkt begeistern?

Dann nimm die Herausforderung an, als WEG Verwalter/in für Ralph Verantwortung zu übernehmen:

  • Du leitest für WEG-Objekte den Kontakt zu den Beiräten und übernimmst gern in Eigentümerversammlungen Verantwortung

  • Du koordinierst deine Customer-Success Teams in Hinblick auf die Priorisierung der Anfragen und teilst deine Erfahrungen

  • Du gewinnst potentielle Kunden für Ralph in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Sales Director und den Gründern und verdienst dafür zusätzliche, super attraktive Prämien

  • Du bringst deine Erfahrung mit ein, um Ralphs WEG-Prozess zu optimieren, indem du als Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund*innen und dem Produkt- und Techteam agierst

  • Du planst und moderierst unsere hybriden und digitalen Eigentümerversammlungen

  • Du koordinierst unser Team des Instandhaltungsmanagements, und hilfst bei der Handwerker-Koordination und der Auftragserteilung

  • Du beweist deinKommunikationsgeschick bei der Korrespondenz mit Beiräten, Eigentümern und Dienstleistern

Was wir dir bieten

  • Verschiedene Vertragsoptionen: Egal ob Teil- oder Vollzeit oder Arbeit auf Stundenbasis, wir suchen die besten Talente. Kontaktiere uns und frage uns nach flexiblen Möglichkeiten.

  • Flexibilität: Kein Bock auf 9 to 5? Wir auch nicht. Wir sind "Remote-first" und erwarten nicht, dass das Team ins Office kommt. Egal ob du aus Berlin oder z.B. aus Barcelona arbeitest, du kannst dir deine Arbeit um deine Termine in Berlin herum frei gestalten.

  • Sicherheit: Wir bieten dir auf Wunsch ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis, damit deine Zukunft planbar und gesichert ist.

  • Entwicklung: Du kannst über Ralph deine Zertifizierung zum/r Verwalter/in erhalten. Deiner Entwicklung sind keine Grenzen gesetzt – hier lernst du spannende neue Dinge und bleibst immer up-to-date. Darüber hinaus bieten wir interessierten Mitarbeitenden die Weiterbildung zum Klimaverwalter an.

  • Teamwork: Vor Ort erwartet dich ein dynamisches und aufgeschlossenes Team, welches eine gute Einarbeitung gewährleistet und dir bei allen Fragen zur Seite steht

  • Verkehrsanbindung: Ein zentral gelegener Standort mit direkter Anbindung an den ÖPNV – bei uns kannst du das Auto gerne stehen lassen.

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Neben einer betrieblichen Altersversorgung, zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung und Unternehmensaktien bieten wir dir Fitnessangebote, Ferienwohnungen u.v.m.

Requirements

Was du mitbringst

  • Leidenschaft für deine Aufgabe als WEG-Verwalter/in

  • Viel Erfahrung im Bereich der WEG-Verwaltung

  • Begeisterung für Innovation und Interesse Prozesse komplett neu zu denken

  • Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium oder kaufmännische Ausbildung (Immobilienkaufmann (m/w/d) und/oder eine Weiterbildung zum Immobilienfachwirt, Betriebswirt für Immobilien (m/w/d) o.Ä.)

  • Kundenorientierung und Freude im Umgang mit unseren Eigentümern/innen und Geschäftspartnern

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein, denn deine Aufgaben sind selbstorganisiert, bedeutend und entscheidend für unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg

  • Gestaltungsfreude, gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden machst du die Immobilien fit für die Zukunft

What we're looking for:

jobs.title: REMOTE Sales Manager
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USOur client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies. For more than 20 years, the company has worked with business owners to improve growth, profitability, leadership, systems, and ultimately create businesses that can thrive without depending entirely on the owner.

They are seeking an experienced, hands-on Sales Leader to lead, rebuild, and scale our sales organization.

This is not a role for someone who has only managed sales teams from a distance. They are looking for a true player-coach: someone who has personally been a successful high-ticket salesperson, knows how to coach and develop salespeople, has built outbound-generated pipeline, and has successfully improved an underperforming sales organization.

Why Join US

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, not simply maintain an existing sales organization.

You'll inherit a company with an established brand, proven coaching programs, existing sales infrastructure, a substantial prospect database, and a history of strong sales performance—but you'll also have the autonomy to rebuild and improve the sales engine.

The right person will have significant influence over how the sales organization evolves and meaningful upside as the company grows.

If you're a proven sales leader who still understands what it takes to personally win business—and you enjoy building teams, fixing problems, and creating predictable revenue—we'd like to talk.

Compensation: $60,000–$100,000 base/guaranteed compensation + uncapped performance compensation
Expected Year-One Earnings:Approximately $150,000–$200,000 based on performance

The Opportunity

The sales organization currently includes:

  • A team of outbound setters responsible for proactively generating qualified sales appointments.

  • An Enrollment Director responsible for conducting consultative sales conversations and enrolling business owners into coaching programs.

  • An Account Management function responsible for client relationships, retention, referrals, and expansion opportunities.

The foundation is already in place, including CRM, dialing technology, sales scripts, an existing database, and a functioning outbound process.

The next Sales Leader will own improving, scaling, and managing the system.

Initially, your biggest priorities will be scaling the outbound setter team and improving closing performance. Over time, you will also develop additional revenue opportunities through referrals, past-client reactivation, previous qualified prospects, events, and other proactive sales strategies.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale the Sales Team

Manage, coach, train, and develop the company's sales organization, including outbound setters and Enrollment Directors.

Recruit and onboard additional sales talent as the organization grows.

Establish clear expectations, activity standards, KPIs, accountability, and performance management.

Make difficult personnel decisions when necessary and continuously upgrade the strength of the sales organization.

Build a Predictable Outbound Sales Engine

Scale the existing outbound setter organization to consistently generate qualified sales conversations.

Create a sales organization that can generate its own pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound marketing.

Continuously improve prospecting strategies, scripts, lead management, follow-up, reactivation, and referral generation.

Work closely with leadership and marketing to maximize the company's house database, outbound lists, inbound opportunities, events, referrals, and other lead sources.

Coach High-Ticket Sales

Review sales conversations and identify opportunities to improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, emotional engagement, and closing.

Coach Enrollment Directors through recorded calls, role-playing, scripting, and ongoing feedback.

Initially serve as a backup closer when necessary.

The long-term goal is not for the Sales Leader to compete with the sales team for deals, but this person must be capable of stepping into a sales conversation, successfully closing business, and demonstrating what great selling looks like.

Drive Sales Performance

Analyze activity, appointments, conversion rates, enrollments, pipeline, and revenue.

Use data to identify performance gaps and translate those insights into specific coaching, process, staffing, and sales strategies.

Build a disciplined sales culture focused on accountability and measurable results.

Initial Success Measures

Within approximately the first 2–4 months, we expect the Sales Leader to:

  • Evaluate the existing sales organization.

  • Scale and strengthen the outbound setter team.

  • Build toward approximately 6–8 productive part-time setters.

  • Generate at least 20–30 held qualified sales appointments per month.

  • Evaluate current closing performance and determine the appropriate coaching or personnel strategy.

  • Begin moving qualified close rates toward a minimum 25% target.

After stabilizing the core sales organization, the Sales Leader will expand into referrals, client reactivation, previous qualified opportunities, events, and other self-generated revenue strategies.

What We're Looking For

1. Experience With a Comparable Sales Model

You have meaningful experience with a sales process where appointments are generated and then handed to a closer for a consultative sales conversation.

Ideally, you have sold high-ticket services or programs directly to small and midsized business owners through phone or Zoom conversations.

2. You Have Personally Been a Successful Salesperson

You didn't begin your career managing salespeople—you learned how to sell.

You can discuss your personal sales results, close rates, average deal sizes, quotas, and performance.

You understand how to conduct discovery, uncover business and emotional pain, handle objections, and confidently ask for the business.

3. You Know How to Generate Business Without Depending on Marketing

You have led teams that generated meaningful pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold and warm outreach, database reactivation, referrals, or similar proactive strategies.

You appreciate inbound leads, but don't depend on them to succeed.

4. You've Successfully Rebuilt a Sales Team

You have at least five years of relevant sales leadership experience, ideally 10+.

More importantly, you've inherited an underperforming sales team or sales function and materially improved it.

You can clearly explain:

  • What performance looked like when you arrived.

  • What wasn't working.

  • What you changed.

  • Who you hired, coached, or replaced.

  • How you changed process or accountability.

  • The measurable results that followed.

5. You're a High-Accountability Leader
You're self-directed, organized, and comfortable operating with autonomy.

You communicate clearly, do what you say you're going to do, and take ownership when something isn't working.

You're comfortable making difficult decisions and don't need someone else continually motivating or managing you.

ISO 13485 Qualifications:

  • Has gained experience in the entire process of auditing medical device quality management systems, including review of documentation and risk management of applicable medical devices, parts or services, implementation audit and audit reporting.

IATF 16949 Qualifications include current 3rd party credentials:

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner und Berater für unsere deutschen und europäischen Kunden im Energiesektor bei allen Fragen rund um die Marktkommunikation im SAP Utilities-Umfeld und übernimmst als Teil- oder Gesamtprojektleiter die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung ihrer Anforderungen.

  • Dabei wirst du Anforderungskonzepte erstellen, Lösungen entwerfen, deren Umsetzung leiten und Kundenworkshops/Schulungen organisieren.

Requirements

  • Du hast dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung in einem kaufmännischen oder technischen Umfeld erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

  • Durch deine Tätigkeit im Energiesektor bist du mit den Prozessen der Energieversorger und den Prozessen der Marktkommunikation wie GPKE/ GeLi, WIM, MPES vertraut.

  • In den letzten 3-4 Jahren hast du bereits Erfahrung und Fachwissen in der Konfiguration, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP IS-U Systemen mit Fokus auf Marktkommunikation sowie deren Add-On Komponenten IDEX-DE, IDXGC/IDXGL (Common Layer) gesammelt.

Ein Umfeld, das jederzeit offen für Veränderungen und Optimierungen ist. Ein „das war schon immer so“ gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast die Chance, dein Wissen einzubringen, Prozesse zu gestalten, vorhandene Themen zu standardisieren oder Abläufe zu optimieren. Sei Impulsgeber und bringe uns mit deiner Expertise noch weiter nach vorne!

jobs.excerpt: Are you detailed-focus and do you enjoy creating high-quality contracts?
jobs.description:
Are you detailed-focus and do you enjoy creating high-quality contracts?

Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?

About our Team

Our Academic & Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research - turning insights into outcomes.

About the Role

As a Contract Manager, Sales, you will support Elsevier's sales contracting activity by preparing, reviewing and negotiating sales contracts, amendments, renewals, order forms, terms and conditions and related legal documents. Support to our Sales will be part of the support. You will be part of a One Team approach, working in close collaboration with Sales, Legal, Account Support and Finance to enable compliant commercial outcomes, strong customer experience and operational efficiency.

This role suits someone who is building and demonstrating a strong contracting profile: technically accurate, commercially aware, responsive and confident using Elsevier templates, policies, toolkits and approval routes. You will be expected to identify deviations from approved positions early, assess contractual risks thoughtfully, and bring practical recommendations rather than only escalating questions.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing, drafting and negotiating sales contracts and related documents, including order forms, amendments, renewals and customer terms, in line with Elsevier templates, fallback positions, policies, and approval requirements.
  • Supporting Legal and Sales by identifying non-standard terms, missing protections, approval requirements and other contracting risks clearly and early.
  • Applying sound judgment to routine and moderately complex contracting issues, balancing risk with commercial needs and proposing practical ways forward.
  • Managing contract matters proactively from intake through execution, including tracking status, blockers, approvals and next steps.
  • Working closely with Sales, Legal, Account Support, Finance and other internal SMEs to develop, review and finalize contract requirements.
  • Communicating clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders, including providing realistic ETAs, concise advice and customer-friendly explanations.
  • Preparing clean, accurate and internally consistent contract documents that reflect agreed services, commercial terms and approved legal positions.
  • Using contract management systems, internal resources and approved AI or productivity tools responsibly to enhance efficiency, drafting quality and stakeholder experience.
  • Identifying recurring issues, process bottlenecks and opportunities to improve templates, toolkits, standardization and smarter ways of working.
  • undefined

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in law or equivalent with 3-5 years of Contract Management, commercial contracting or legal operations experience, preferably in sales contracting, SaaS, licensing, subscription or information services experience.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish; Fluency in Portuguese is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to review agreements systematically against templates, policies and fallback positions.
  • Sound legal and commercial judgment, with the ability to assess issues, make recommendations and escalate with context and proposed solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate contracting issues into clear, action-oriented advice for Sales and other stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership, prioritization and organizational skills in a fast-paced sales environment.
  • Experience with contract lifecycle management tools such as Conga, Luminance or similar platforms is a plus.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, flexible working arrangements, study assistance and access to learning and development resources, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

  • Private Medical, Dental and Vision Plan, coverage for employee and eligible dependents

  • Savings Fund with company matching contributions

  • Comprehensive life insurance policy

  • Grocery voucher

  • Minor medical expenses discount card for minor medical expenses and outpatient services

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. The ICT Engineer II will receive general instructions on routine work, detailed instructions on new projects, tasks or assignments.  May work independently, consistently exercising discretion and independent judgment on individual work, or may work under immediate supervision.  May serve as lead on routine projects, tasks or assignments of limited scope.

The ICT Engineer II will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Assist in Production of Low Voltage System (ICT, Security, A/V) Engineering Deliverables (75%)

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

  • Skilled at using AutoCAD, Revit Computer Aided Design tools

  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)

  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines

  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

Travel / Relocation Requirements

jobs.description:
Processo de seleção desenvolvido pela matteria

Localização e modo de trabalho

Residência fixa em uma das capitais da Amazônia Legal brasileira - Remoto

Quem somos

A missão da The Nature Conservancy (TNC) é proteger as terras e as águas das quais toda a vida depende. Como uma organização baseada na ciência, criamos soluções inovadoras e práticas para os desafios mais difíceis do mundo, para que possamos criar um mundo no qual as pessoas e a natureza prosperem. Estamos enraizados em nossa Missão e guiados por nossos Valores, que incluem o Compromisso com a Diversidade e o Respeito às Pessoas, Comunidades e Culturas. Seja desenvolvimento de carreira, horários flexíveis ou uma missão gratificante, há muitas razões para amar a vida na TNC. Quer ter uma visão melhor da TNC? Confira nossa conta no instagram e o Relatório Anual 2024, além da #tncbrasil no LinkedIn.

Nosso objetivo é cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo para que todos os nossos colegas em todo o mundo sintam um sentimento de pertencimento e que suas contribuições únicas para nossa missão sejam valorizadas. Sabemos que só alcançaremos nossa Missão contratando e engajando uma força de trabalho diversificada que reflita as comunidades em que trabalhamos. Além dos requisitos em nossas postagens, reconhecemos que as pessoas vêm com talento e experiências fora do trabalho. A diversidade de experiências e habilidades combinadas com paixão são a chave para a inovação e uma cultura de inclusão! Por favor, inscreva-se - adoraríamos ouvir de você. Para citar o que inúmeros membros da equipe da TNC dizem: “você se juntará por causa da nossa missão e ficará por nossas pessoas”.

Nosso impacto

  • 71 milhões de hectares: impacto positivo almejado até 2030, com foco em conservação e aprimoramento da gestão.

  • 187 mil km de rios: extensão para a qual a TNC Brasil busca promover soluções e políticas públicas de conservação até 2030.

  • 369 milhões de toneladas de CO₂: volume de emissões que a organização pretende capturar ou contribuir para reduzir até 2030.

  • 3,8 milhões de pessoas: público que a TNC Brasil pretende apoiar, com atenção especial a povos tradicionais e comunidades indígenas, ampliando sua participação em espaços decisórios e sua liderança na gestão dos territórios.

Na Amazônia, exemplos recentes ajudam a dimensionar essa atuação: um projeto de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais na Terra do Meio envolve 14 territórios coletivos, 3 mil pessoas e 10 milhões de hectares sob proteção de uso sustentável.

Propósito do cargo

Liderar a estratégia da TNC na Amazônia Brasileira a partir de uma visão sistêmica do território, conciliando conservação e desenvolvimento socioeconômico. O desafio será conectar diferentes agendas, atores e investimentos para transformar estratégias em resultados concretos e escaláveis, capazes de manter a floresta em pé, promover uma produção responsável e gerar valor para as pessoas e comunidades da Amazônia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e implementar a estratégia e a Teoria da Mudança da TNC para a Amazônia Brasileira, traduzindo a visão institucional em prioridades, iniciativas e resultados mensuráveis.

  • Liderar um portfólio amplo e diverso, conectando agendas de produção agropecuária sustentável, proteção e valorização da floresta em pé, povos indígenas e comunidades tradicionais, clima, mecanismos financeiros e políticas públicas.

  • Assegurar capacidade de implementação e entrega, transformando estratégias em resultados concretos, monitorando avanços e adaptando planos diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Promover uma visão de desenvolvimento socioeconômico da Amazônia, articulando conservação e produção responsável e identificando alavancas econômicas capazes de valorizar a floresta em pé.

  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar iniciativas bem-sucedidas, superando a lógica de projetos-piloto e promovendo soluções com potencial de transformação sistêmica e atuação em larga escala.

  • Construir e fortalecer relações estratégicas com governos estaduais e federal, setor privado, instituições financeiras, produtores, academia, organizações da sociedade civil, financiadores, povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

  • Influenciar políticas públicas, estruturas de governança e processos de tomada de decisão relevantes para o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.

  • Liderar e apoiar a captação de recursos no Brasil e internacionalmente, mantendo um pipeline consistente de oportunidades e relacionamento estratégico com financiadores.

  • Supervisionar a gestão financeira e orçamentária de um portfólio de grande porte, assegurando uso eficiente dos recursos, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade institucional.

  • Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, fortalecendo estruturas, responsabilidades, autonomia, accountability e capacidades técnicas e gerenciais.

  • Estimular integração e sinergia entre diferentes frentes de atuação, evitando silos e promovendo circulação de contexto e informação para qualificar a tomada de decisão.

  • Manter e fortalecer a agenda de diversidade, equidade e inclusão dentro da unidade, incorporando-a à liderança e à gestão da equipe.

  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns, negociações e espaços estratégicos nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos e competências para trabalhar conosco

Educação

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada desejável.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência profissional em posições relacionadas a desenvolvimento socioeconômico, gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, conservação ou áreas correlatas, com trajetória relevante em contextos complexos e de grande escala.

  • Experiência robusta na definição e implementação de estratégias, com responsabilidade por portfólios complexos, priorização de iniciativas, gestão de riscos e entrega de resultados mensuráveis.

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento de talentos, estruturação de equipes e gestão de desempenho.

  • Trajetória de articulação multissetorial, estabelecendo relações e conduzindo negociações complexas com governos, setor privado, organizações da sociedade civil, comunidades, financiadores e outros atores estratégicos.

  • Experiência em relações governamentais e políticas públicas, incluindo capacidade de influenciar agendas, processos decisórios e condições institucionais necessárias para alcançar resultados em escala.

  • Experiência na gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte, combinando visão estratégica com capacidade de acompanhamento da execução.

  • Experiência em captação de recursos e relacionamento com financiadores, contribuindo para a construção e manutenção de um pipeline de financiamento no Brasil e/ou internacionalmente.

  • Será especialmente valorizada uma trajetória que demonstre conhecimento e compreensão do contexto amazônico, incluindo suas dinâmicas socioeconômicas, produtivas, ambientais, políticas e territoriais.

  • Será um diferencial experiência com mecanismos financeiros, finanças estruturadas, setor privado ou desenvolvimento econômico, especialmente quando aplicada a desafios socioambientais e/ou territoriais.

    Conhecimento e habilidades

  • Visão sistêmica da Amazônia: capacidade de compreender o território para além de uma única agenda temática, conectando desenvolvimento socioeconômico, conservação, produção agropecuária, floresta, clima, povos e comunidades tradicionais, políticas públicas e investimentos.

  • Pensamento estratégico e de escala: capacidade de identificar as principais alavancas de transformação de um sistema e desenvolver soluções que possam avançar de iniciativas pontuais para resultados de maior escala.

  • Gestão e implementação: capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar resultados e replanejar recursos e ações diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Articulação e negociação: habilidade para navegar entre interesses distintos, construir agendas comuns e mobilizar atores públicos, privados e sociais em torno de objetivos compartilhados.

  • Visão econômico-financeira: capacidade de compreender o papel de investimentos, mecanismos financeiros, setor privado e modelos econômicos na construção de soluções sustentáveis para a Amazônia.

  • Captação e mobilização de recursos: habilidade para desenvolver relações com financiadores, identificar oportunidades e contribuir estrategicamente para a sustentabilidade financeira do portfólio.

  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito, considerando as interações, apresentações e eventos internacionais inerentes à posição. Inglês fluente é desejável e conhecimentos de espanhol serão considerados um diferencial.

Competências

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico: conecta diferentes variáveis e agendas, compreende interdependências e mantém uma visão ampla do território sem perder a capacidade de priorização.

  • Orientação à implementação e resultados: transforma estratégia em ação, acompanha a execução e mantém foco consistente nas entregas e no impacto esperado.

  • Liderança adaptativa: lidera com segurança em contextos de incerteza e complexidade, sendo capaz de rever planos, redirecionar prioridades e mobilizar o time diante de mudanças.

  • Influência e construção de consensos: estabelece relações de confiança e consegue aproximar atores com interesses e perspectivas distintas.

  • Liderança de pessoas: desenvolve equipes fortes e tecnicamente qualificadas, compartilha contexto, promove autonomia e evita a formação de silos na tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração e integração: consegue navegar por um portfólio diverso sem precisar ser especialista em todas as temáticas, conectando conhecimentos, pessoas e iniciativas para gerar sinergias.

  • Proatividade e senso de protagonismo: antecipa necessidades, identifica oportunidades e mobiliza recursos e pessoas para fazer a estratégia avançar.

  • Compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão: incorpora essa agenda à forma de liderar, desenvolver equipes e construir uma cultura organizacional inclusiva.

Perfil de nossa equipe

A The Nature Conservancy é enraizada em nossa missão e guiada por nossos valores. Temos o compromisso de cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os colegas ao redor do mundo sintam um senso de pertencimento e tenham suas contribuições únicas valorizadas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma força de trabalho diversa que reflita as comunidades em que atuamos, reconhecendo que a diversidade de experiências e habilidades é fundamental para a inovação.

“Você vai se juntar a nós pela nossa missão — e vai ficar pelas nossas pessoas.”

Principais interesses para trabalhar conosco

O candidato ideal será motivado pela oportunidade de causar um impacto direto nos esforços globais de conservação.

Deve ter um forte interesse em sustentabilidade ambiental, proteção da biodiversidade e conservação de ecossistemas críticos no Brasil.

Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • A oportunidade de liderar uma estratégia de alta relevância para um dos biomas mais importantes para a biodiversidade e estabilidade climática global.

  • Atuação sobre desafios complexos que conectam desenvolvimento econômico, produção sustentável, conservação, clima, comunidades e políticas públicas.

  • Liderança de um portfólio diversificado e de uma equipe multidisciplinar em uma organização de alcance global.

  • Possibilidade de articular governos, setor privado, investidores, financiadores, comunidades e sociedade civil em torno de mudanças sistêmicas.

  • Espaço para construir soluções que ultrapassem projetos-piloto e alcancem escala e transformação de sistemas.

Detalhes relevantes antes de se candidatar a esta vaga

A posição exige residência fixa em uma capital da Amazônia Brasileira, em modelo home office. Também requer disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais e atuação eventual em locais remotos e condições climáticas ou de terreno desafiadoras.

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo.   • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

The CRM Product Specialist is a quota-carrying, new-business hunter responsible for driving net new logo acquisition across DP360's Commercial Truck, Marine, Equipment and Recreational vertical markets. This is a full-cycle sales role; from prospecting and pipeline generation through discovery, demonstration, negotiation and close — selling DP360's operational software suite including CRM and Conversational AI solutions to dealership groups and operators.

Working in concert with SDR support, channel and referral partnerships and self-sourced outbound activity, the Product Specialist owns revenue growth in their assigned territory. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role modeled after best-in-class SaaS acquisition motions seen at large enterprise SaaS companies — structured for reps who thrive in complex, consultative sales environments and are energized by building new customer relationships.

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute a balanced prospecting motion across self-sourced outbound, SDR qualified inbound, and channel/referral-sourced leads.

  • Build and maintain a minimum 3x pipeline coverage ratio against quota at all times.

  • Develop territory and account-level prospecting plans targeting Commercial (powersports, RV, marine, construction equipment) and Recreational verticals.

  • Leverage referral networks within the broader Trader Interactive ecosystem to identify cross-sell and co-sell opportunities.

  • Partner closely with SDR team to refine messaging, qualify inbound interest and convert MQLs to SQLs efficiently.

Sales Execution & Deal Management

  • Own the full sales cycle from initial discovery call through signed contract, typically 60-120 days depending on deal complexity.

  • Conduct compelling discovery sessions to understand dealership workflow, technology gaps and performance objectives.

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations of DP360 CRM and Conversational AI tools to dealership operators, GMs, and ownership groups.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with economic buyers, champions and end users within prospect accounts.

  • Develop and deliver ROI-based business cases and proposals aligned to each prospect's operational metrics and KPIs.

  • Manage deal progression in CRM with accurate forecasting, stage discipline and pipeline hygiene at all times.

Channel & Partner Collaboration

  • Develop and nurture relationships with referral partners, OEM contacts and adjacent Trader Interactive business units to drive inbound deal flow.

  • Coordinate with channel partners on joint pipeline reviews, co-selling motions and shared account strategies.

  • Act as a DP360 brand ambassador at industry events, dealer associations and trade shows within target verticals.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the CRM Performance Manager (Customer Success) to ensure smooth post-sale handoff and maximize early customer engagement.

  • Feed competitive intelligence, objection patterns and prospect feedback to Product, Marketing, Marketplace Sales and Leadership teams on a structured basis.

  • Support go-to-market initiatives including beta launches, product releases and vertical-specific marketing campaigns.

  • Partner with Marketing to refine ICP targeting, messaging and campaign effectiveness based on field insights.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent role.

  • Demonstrated track record of consistent quota attainment at or above 100%.

  • Experience selling operational or vertical SaaS solutions to SMB and mid-market customers ($15K–$75K ACV).

  • Strong command of consultative selling methodologies (Challenger or equivalent).

  • Proven ability to self-source pipeline through outbound prospecting in addition to working inbound and partner-referred leads.

  • Excellent discovery, presentation, and negotiation skills with comfort presenting to C-suite and ownership-level buyers.

  • Data-literate and CRM-disciplined — experience maintaining accurate pipeline in Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into automotive, powersports, RV, marine, or equipment dealership verticals.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, dealership management systems (DMS), or Conversational AI/messaging products.

  • Background selling within a SaaS portfolio (e.g., Coupa, Anaplan, DealerSocket, VinSolutions, vAuto).

  • Experience working in a channel-assisted or partner co-sell sales environment.

  • Comfort with product-led growth motions and shorter, transactional deal cycles alongside complex enterprise sales.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.
