Home Franchise Concepts is a subsidiary of JM Family Enterprises, a family-owned, professionally managed diversified automotive company.

A few of the Company’s many Accolades and Awards

  • Entrepreneur’s Franchise 500
  • Entrepreneur’s Franchise 500 Best in Category
  • Entrepreneur’s Top Low-Cost Franchise
  • Entrepreneur’s Top New & Emerging Franchises
  • Entrepreneur’s Top Home-based Franchises
  • Entrepreneur’s Top 100 Global Franchises

You can learn more about Home Franchise Concepts on our Careers page.

Position Summary

A Regional Operations Manager plays a key role in boosting sales, maximizing revenue, and profitability. This position serves as a strategic partner to leadership teams, providing data-driven insights, performance analysis, and actionable recommendations that help franchisees meet and exceed business objectives. Operational excellence is achieved by providing hands-on coaching, ensuring each franchisee operates in alignment with brand standards and compliance, overcomes business challenges, and achieves individualized growth and success within the franchise system.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and evaluate performance metrics including revenue growth, profit margins, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify profitability levels and implement strategies that drive top-line revenue and reduce costs.
  • Consult and work with owners, consistently, to better understand financial statements and develop yearly budgets that reflect the goals of their business.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of franchisees, fostering strong, trust-based relationships.
  • Assist Franchisees in the development and implementation of franchise system enhancements, including operational processes, communication channels, and best practices (i.e., sales, product MVP, marketing, etc.).
  • Analyze performance data from CRM tools and regular audits to identify areas for franchisee profitability and operational improvements.
  • Support franchisee onboarding, training, and the adoption of operational systems and tools.
  • Monitor alignment with brand standards, drive compliance, and encourage consistent execution across locations.
  • Adapt coaching strategies to meet the needs of franchisees at different stages of growth (follow the Tiered Growth Roadmap).
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and a culture of continuous improvement within the network.
  • Conduct regular site visits to assess operational performance and provide guidance on improving efficiency and productivity.
  • Develop content, attend, and facilitate convention, regional meetings, academy training, and strategic webinars.
  • Provide franchisees with access to workforce development resources, including optional tools, training materials, and best practices. Help facilitate connections to third-party staffing solutions and offer guidance on scalable strategies for talent acquisition and retention

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Understanding of business fundamentals (operations, marketing, sales, finance).
  • Deep proficiency in coaching, with a strong track record of improving sales performance.
  • Ability to analyze data to guide coaching focus and measure results.
  • In depth understanding of the financial aspects of business operations, including profit and loss management, market dynamics, competitive landscape and industry trends.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with their portfolio of franchisees, conduct joint territory planning and align on agreed upon growth objectives
  • Ability to leverage systems, analyze data, and adapt coaching to unique franchisee needs.
  • Empathy, patience, and high levels of emotional intelligence.
  • 35%-40% of travel for in-person meetings, training, and support as needed.
  • Exhibits integrity, honesty, the Company culture, brand culture and core values.
  • Experience in sales coaching, financial acumen and operational experience in franchising.
  • Ability to lead, influence, and foster effective relationships built on trust.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, Finance, or a related field is desired; equivalent experience will be considered. Certified Franchise Executive (CFE) or coaching certifications are a plus.
  • Minimum five (5) years of experience supporting, coaching, or managing franchise, multi-unit, or small business operations.
  • Franchise operations, franchise business coaching, or business consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Prior business ownership or franchise ownership is highly desirable.
  • Experience working with financial statements, business analytics, CRM platforms, and operational reporting.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role may be measured by:

  • Franchisee Goal Achievement Rate: Proportion of assigned franchisees achieving agreed-upon sales, profitability, and operational benchmarks.
  • Gross Sales Growth: Year-over-year or quarter-over-quarter revenue growth among assigned franchisees.
  • Training Completion Rate: Percentage of franchisees completing required onboarding and training modules.
  • Brand Standards Compliance: Audit scores or rate of compliance with operational protocols and brand expectations.
  • Franchisee Satisfaction Score: Feedback from regular surveys assessing coaching quality and trust (i.e., Annual Franchise Business Review Survey).
  • Frequency of Financial Reviews: Number of substantive financial coaching sessions held per franchisee.

Travel & Work Environment

  • Remote position with approximately 25–40% travel, depending on business needs.
  • Must reside near a major airport.
  • Ability to travel throughout assigned territories for coaching, operational support, regional meetings, and conventions.
  • Working hours may vary based on assigned territory.
  • Ability to work on a computer for extended periods and occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The compensation range for this position is $80,000 - 110,000 per year. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and alignment with the specific business needs of the assigned brand. While this posting reflects the full salary range for the position across our organization, individual offers will be made within the range based on the selected candidate's experience and the requirements of the role.

At Home Franchise Concepts, we offer a highly competitive benefits package designed to support you and your family. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), and supplemental life insurance. Associates are also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus and can participate in our 401(k) retirement plan, which includes matching contributions equal to 100% of the first three percent of eligible compensation contributed and 50% of the next two percent. In addition, we provide 10 paid holidays, 8 paid hours for associates to volunteer in their community, and open time off to support work-life balance. During the interview process, our Talent team will be happy to share more details about our benefits and career development opportunities.

ML & LLM Engineering, Search and Recommendation Engines

  • Collaborate and interface with Operations Engineers who deploy and run production infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • Experience with large-scale data processing systems, e.g., Spark.
  • Experience with statistical analysis, machine learning theory and natural language processing.

jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We're a group of go-getters who decided they didn't want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

And one of the best parts? We give you the freedom to work from whatever working location works best for you and your lifestyle - yes, this means you can be 100% remote if you want to be!

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You'll Do

The Senior Product Manager (AI) is responsible for defining, delivering, and iterating AI-powered products and capabilities throughout the product life cycle — connecting data, machine learning, and large language models to real customer/consumer problems and measurable business outcomes.

  • Own the vision, strategy, and market fit for AI-powered products and experiences within your domain (e.g., recommendations, pricing, search, workflow automation, conversational tools).

  • Build deep consumer and dealer understanding through interviews, discovery sessions, and usage analytics to identify where AI can add real value (and where it should not be used).

  • Serve as internal and external subject matter expert on your AI products, including their capabilities, limitations, and responsible-use guidelines, measurement and monitoring.

  • Own the end-to-end product plan for AI capabilities, from discovery and problem framing through launch, adoption, and continuous optimization.

  • Drive innovative, AI-enabled solutions that align to strategic business goals and are grounded in realistic data, model, and UX constraints.

  • Gather business and data requirements from a variety of sources (consumers, dealers, account owners, sales, support, data science) and translate them into clear product outcomes and increments.

  • Document and elaborate requirements, partnering with business and technology leadership to prioritize AI opportunities within the overall product roadmap.

  • Maintain and prioritize a large product backlog that includes discovery, experimentation, and delivery work for AI features, as well as the data and tech debt required to keep them healthy.

  • Serve as subject matter expert in relevant product domains, assisting with customer UAT, defect triage, and mitigation efforts — with particular attention to AI-specific issues such as output quality, bias, hallucination, and safety.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define minimum viable products for AI features, balancing value, feasibility, risk, and responsible-use considerations.

  • Inspect, accept, or reject completed development work against defined acceptance criteria, UX standards, and key performance metrics for AI behaviors.

  • Communicate work in progress, results from experiments, and upcoming priorities to key internal and external stakeholders in a clear, non-hype way.

  • Collaborate across Data, Sales, Design, other Product teams, QA, and Engineering to produce prototypes and proof-of-concept experiences that validate AI opportunities quickly.

  • Collaborate with software development and data science to build robust, scalable AI solutions for existing and potential customers.

  • Develop a nuanced understanding of the target markets and user bases (including their workflows and risk tolerance) to guide decisions on AI product backlog and prioritization.

  • Contribute to business cases that justify AI investments, clearly articulating expected value, costs (including model and infrastructure costs), and key risks.

  • Conduct customer, market, and competitive analysis to identify industry trends, market gaps, and unmet customer needs, with a specific lens on how AI is changing user expectations.

  • Act as project manager lead in strategic AI initiatives for discovery and delivery, ensuring tight coordination across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in product management, business administration, engineering or a related field.

  • 4-6 years of relevant product management, product ownership, business analytics or beta analytics experience in a software product development environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant product management, product ownership, or closely related experience in a software product development environment, including 2+ years working on AI/ML-powered features or data products.

  • Experience in a role with strong requirements elicitation and stakeholder management across technical and non-technical groups.

  • Experience with customer support and bug tracking.

  • Experience and proficiency with modern product and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, yED, G Suite); familiarity with analytics or experimentation tools is a plus (Optimizely, Fullstory, Adobe, etc.).

  • Previous experience in marketplaces, advertising, e-commerce, SaaS, or other data-rich domains is a plus.

Bonus Points

Not specified in this posting.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Location and Work Mode

Mexico, Remote

Who we are

Asylum Access works alongside forcibly displaced people as they seek safety, dignity, and the opportunity to shape their own futures.

Through legal empowerment, policy advocacy, and collaboration to improve global systems, we support refugees as they assert their rights—to live in safety, move freely, work legally, and access education. Our work aims to contribute to sustainable, rights-based solutions that respect autonomy and honor refugees’ ability to make decisions about their own lives.

Our work is rooted in partnership. Asylum Access is a global team and a family of locally-led civil society organizations across Asia and Latin America. Our national organizations are primarily staffed and led by people from the communities where we work, and our relationships with clients and partners are grounded in mutual trust, respect, and accountability. Globally, we collaborate with institutions and allies to help strengthen systems and policies so they better uphold the rights of refugees. Through our work on rights and governance, we work to support lasting systemic change that helps shift power toward refugees and their communities.

Our impact

We envision a world where every forcibly displaced person has their dignity and rights respected, their voices lead change, and they have the safety, support, and opportunity to rebuild their lives.

Purpose of the Position

The Accounting and Audit Manager leads the org-wide Accounting Department to achieve its mission in maintaining the integrity of accounting data and production of high-quality financial reports. The Accounting and Audit Manager is responsible for the day-to-day accounting for the headquarters’ financial transactions; developing, implementing and ensuring compliance with financial policies and procedures consistent with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and maintaining and continuously improving the system of financial controls; including general accounting, investment accounting, subgranting, grantmaking, tax-exempt compliances, banking, payroll, and benefits. This staff member will work directly with headquarters (HQ), and closely with Asylum Access Mexico (AAMX), Asylum Access Thailand (AAT) and Asylum Access Malaysia (AAM) staff.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the general accounting function for HQ, ensuring accurate and timely financial records and reporting.

  • Supervise accounting activities across Malaysia, Thailand, and Mexico, ensuring consistency and compliance with organizational standards.

  • Develop and prepare accounting and financial reports to support internal monitoring and decision-making.

  • Lead the annual external audit process, coordinating requirements, documentation, and communication with external auditors.

  • Lead tax compliance across the organization, ensuring timely and accurate fulfillment of applicable tax obligations.

  • Plan and conduct internal audits to strengthen financial controls, identify risks, and support compliance across the organization.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. CPA certification or equivalent

  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

  • Excel proficiency a must

Experience

  • 5 years related accounting experience in private corporation/public charity settings

  • Experience using a computerized accounting system, specifically Microsoft Dynamics and solid knowledge of MS Office applications

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong time management and organizational skills. Able to prioritize work effectively and adapt to multiple demands

  • Ability to communicate effectively and concisely both verbally and in writing

Competencies

  • Strong initiative and ability to take ownership of projects, management multiple deadlines, and work effectively with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

  • Cultural competence and intelligence, ability to work in a diverse, multicultural workforce

    Comfortable working individually and in concert with positions across the various functions and levels of the organization and with external partners, recognizing and valuing the need to adapt and respect other cultures and languages

  • Approaches work with openness and humility, adapting thoughtfully to changing contexts while remaining grounded in shared values.

  • Prior experience working with refugee-led organizations or involvement in community-led initiatives is an asset

Our team profile

These values guide how we show up, stand alongside communities, and shape a more just world together - informing the way we work, make decisions, and build partnerships:

Respect & Empathy: We treat every person with dignity, listen deeply, and center the experiences of forcibly displaced communities in all we do.

Integrity: We act with honesty, transparency, and consistency - standing by our commitments and holding ourselves accountable to the communities we serve.

Lived & Community-Rooted Leadership: We believe meaningful change is led by those closest to the issues. We support leadership by people with lived and community-rooted experience of displacement and injustice, recognizing their knowledge, insight, and vision as essential to transforming systems.

Curiosity & Courage: We ask bold questions, embrace learning and adaptability, and push for change- even when it’s difficult or uncertain.

Collaboration & Partnership: We build relationships rooted in trust and shared purpose, knowing long-term progress comes from working together.

Justice: Justice drives us to address both the immediate challenges faced by forcibly displaced people and the deeper, long-standing problems that keep injustice in place. Together with forcibly displaced communities, we work to heal harm, restore dignity, and create lasting change.

Key interests for working with us

The following are the goals of the organization for 2026-2030:

  • Goal 2: Refugees are leading in decisions and solutions that affect their lives

  • Goal 3: Aligning how we work with what we stand for by investing in people and leadership, nurturing a culture of care and learning, staying grounded and responsive, building values and aligned systems, sustaining and diversifying our resources.

Global CEO / Managing Director / COO remote job opening eg Austin, New York, Los Angeles time zones for a <$3MM Revenue, small independent company, ready to grow after recent investment who renowned in relation to FMCG / CPG, health, wellness, fitness, supplements, apparel. With a team of fewer than 10, their annual revenue ambition strives to grow rapidly to over £10MM-$15MM within the next 2-5 years, from a mission focused approach to inspire positive change through their innovative products and services with millions of consumers worldwide.
Full time direct hire is the preference with equity and shares, LTIP, sweat equity etc however part-time / Fractional candidates will be considered at the same time with view to it becoming full time in the future.
Role Overview: We are seeking a dynamic and visionary Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or Chief Operating Office (COO) to lead our client through its next phase of growth. This role is uniquely positioned for someone with a strong background in operations or marketing, ideally suited for a proven CEO or Managing Director or Operations Director ready to take the next step. Over the first 3-12 months, this role will blend CEO and COO responsibilities, working closely with the Founder CEO, who will transition to a Chairman role, so that you can determine the ideal Leadership team and organisational design.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Leadership:Develop and implement strategic plans to scale the company ensuring alignment with the mission and vision.

  • Operational Excellence:Oversee daily operations, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness across all departments. Streamline processes and systems to support rapid growth.

  • Team Leadership:Inspire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Financial Management:Oversee financial performance, budgets, and forecasting. Ensure the company's financial health and stability while driving profitability.

  • Business Development:Identify and pursue new business opportunities, partnerships, and markets to expand the reach and impact.

  • Product Development:Collaborate with the product team to innovate and enhance the product offerings in mindfulness, wellness, health, supplements, personal growth, coaching, events, and consumer goods.

  • Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, partners, investors, and the board of directors.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience in a senior leadership role (CEO, COO, Executive Operations Director, or MD), preferably within the wellness, health, consumer goods / services - D2C/B2C Consumer Goods is a mandatory background.

  • Demonstrated success in scaling a business and driving significant revenue growth.

  • Strong operational and financial acumen with a strategic mindset.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Passion for mindfulness, wellness, and personal growth.

  • Degree and probably MBA

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Company Values and Behaviours:

  • Authenticity:We value genuine interactions and believe in staying true to our mission and values. The right candidate will embody and promote this authenticity in all aspects of their leadership.

  • Passion for Growth:A deep-seated passion for personal and professional growth is essential. Our team thrives on continuous learning and self-improvement.

  • Collaborative Spirit:We believe in the power of teamwork. The ideal candidate will foster a collaborative environment, encouraging open communication and mutual support.

  • Innovation:A forward-thinking mindset and a willingness to embrace change and innovation are crucial. The CEO should inspire creativity and drive new ideas.

  • Integrity:Honesty and ethical behaviour are non-negotiable. We seek a leader who demonstrates integrity in every decision and action.

  • Empathy:Understanding and compassion are key to building strong relationships within the team and with our customers. The right candidate will prioritise empathy in their leadership approach.

  • Resilience:The journey to rapid growth will come with challenges. We need a CEO who can navigate these obstacles with resilience and a positive attitude.


Jonathan Pearson at BluZinc is the Retained and Exclusive Consultant Headhunter for this job opening so please apply with your resume ASAP! During the assessment and selection process it will become more clear for all whether this is a COO or CEO type of role. If possible we would like the ideal hire to join within 4-6 weeks from now.

VyOS Networks is a leader in open networking for organizations that need secure, scalable, automated operations across bare metal, cloud and edge. More than 1,500 organizations run VyOS in production, from service providers and cloud providers to enterprises and public institutions. Our goal is to restore ownership of network infrastructure to our users through transparent, vendor-neutral networking. Your network, your rules.

Job description

The Business Development Representative generates new sales opportunities for VyOS through outbound prospecting. The job is to find the right companies and people in the assigned territory, reach them with personalised outreach, qualify their interest and book meetings for the sales team.

  • Build target account and contact lists in the assigned territory that match the VyOS ideal customer profile: network and infrastructure teams at service providers, cloud and hosting providers, MSPs and enterprises.

  • Qualify prospects against the ideal customer profile: company fit, use case, timing, and whether the contact is the decision maker or a technical influencer.
  • Book discovery meetings for the account executive or the CRO, confirm attendance, and join the first call to hand over context.
  • Follow up with prospects who showed interest but are not ready yet, and keep them warm until they are.
  • Turn signals passed on by marketing (website visitors, LinkedIn profile viewers, event contacts) into outbound sequences.
  • Keep HubSpot CRM accurate: every contact, touch, meeting and outcome logged the same day; sequences run in Apollo.

How success is measured

  • Qualified meetings booked and held per month.
  • Outbound activity volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting quality, as accepted by the account executive.

  • 1 to 3 years in an outbound SDR or BDR role in B2B technology, with a track record of hitting meeting targets.
  • Or a technical background looking to move into sales: an engineering degree or training in networking or systems administration, or hands-on experience as a network engineer, sysadmin or DevOps engineer. If you can talk to a network team in their own language and want to learn outbound sales, we will teach you the sales part.
  • Experience selling to network, infrastructure or IT teams, or into service providers, is a plus.
  • Familiarity with open-source software and Linux is a plus.

Skills

  • Comfortable with cold calling and with writing short, personalised outreach. Persistent, not put off by rejection.
  • Clear written and spoken communication in English.
  • Organised and disciplined with daily activity, follow-ups and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to research an account quickly and find the right contact.
  • Working knowledge of HubSpot and a sales engagement tool such as Apollo. LinkedIn Sales Navigator is a plus.
  • Enough networking understanding to hold a first conversation (routing, firewalls, VPN, cloud networking), or the drive to learn it fast.

About VyOS

VyOS is an enterprise-grade network operating system that combines routing, firewall, VPN and core network services in one system with one configuration. It runs on standard x86-64 hardware, on every major hypervisor and in every major public cloud, so one design runs anywhere. Network engineers manage VyOS through a single CLI with commit and rollback, or through the API and standard automation tools.

Our Mission

Powering a connected world, engineering for the future.

We believe that the future of networking lies in open collaboration, continuous innovation, and delivering solutions that keep the world connected, efficiently and securely.

  • Contentment: At VyOS Networks, we believe that work should inspire and fulfill. We create an environment where people are excited to collaborate, share ideas, and find joy in solving real-world problems. We aim to inspire others while finding inspiration in the work we do.

The Manager will provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, performance management, career development, and operational direction to the team while ensuring consistent execution of resource management processes and service delivery standards. The Services Operations Manager drives workforce planning, capacity management, utilization optimization, and staffing governance while balancing customer commitments, employee development, and business objectives. Exempt

jobs.description:
About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager

Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.

This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.

Key Responsibilities

Revenue Accounting & Technical Expertise

  • Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
  • Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
  • Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
  • Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
  • Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.

Revenue Close & Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
  • Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
  • Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
  • Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
  • Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.

Systems, Automation & AI

  • Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  • Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
  • Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
  • Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
  • Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
  • Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
  • Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
  • Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
  • Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.

Controls, Audit & Process Excellence

  • Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
  • Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
  • Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
  • Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • CPA or equivalent preferred.
  • Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
  • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606, including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
  • Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models, including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.

Business Development & Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $8/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions is a growing healthcare company that partners with medical practices to provide insurance-supported dietary and exercise counseling programs for patients.

Our model connects physicians and their patients with dietitians, virtual trainers, and operational support designed to improve patient engagement and continuity of care.

We are entering an important growth stage and are looking for a Business Development & Operations Lead who can help expand our physician partnerships while strengthening the operational systems and client experience supporting that growth.

This is not a traditional back-office Operations Manager position.

We are looking for someone who can operate as a trusted extension of the leadership team: part business developer, part client success leader, part operator, and part strategic problem solver.

What You Will Own

Physician Acquisition & Business Growth

A major priority for this role is helping Pillar Health Solutions grow its network of physician and medical-practice partners.

You will:

  • Develop and execute practical strategies for attracting new physician and clinic partnerships

  • Identify opportunities to reach physicians, practice owners, office managers, and other healthcare decision-makers

  • Support organic marketing and local-market growth initiatives

  • Help develop physician-facing messaging, success stories, testimonials, and other materials that strengthen Pillar's value proposition

  • Research new channels, tools, partnerships, and approaches for increasing qualified opportunities

You do not need to be a career marketer, but you should understand how businesses grow and be able to contribute thoughtful, executable ideas.

Discovery Calls & Client Conversion

You will help convert interested medical practices into active Pillar partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Conducting or facilitating discovery calls with prospective physician partners

  • Explaining Pillar's services and patient-support model confidently

  • Communicating fees, billing structure, workflow, and partnership expectations clearly

  • Understanding the prospective practice's needs and identifying how Pillar can support them

  • Following up on opportunities and moving qualified prospects toward partnership

  • Continuously improving the discovery and conversion process based on feedback and results

Success in this position requires someone who is comfortable speaking directly with physicians, business owners, and senior decision-makers.

Physician, Patient & Program Operations

Once partnerships are established, you will help ensure that the experience remains strong for physicians and patients.

You will:

  • Serve as a key operational contact for physician partners

  • Monitor feedback from physicians and patients and take appropriate action

  • Coordinate with dietitians, virtual trainers, administrative staff, and virtual assistants

  • Support thoughtful matching between patients, dietitians, and virtual trainers when appropriate

  • Monitor patient engagement and identify concerns before they become escalations

  • Address service issues, complaints, and operational breakdowns

  • Help establish appropriate check-ins across the patient, dietitian, trainer, and physician relationship

Because patient experience can directly affect program continuation and business performance, this role requires someone who notices problems early and acts on them.

Founder Partnership & Executive Communication

You will work closely with Pillar Health Solutions leadership and should be comfortable communicating directly with a founder.

Initially, this may include a short daily business update meeting.

You will be expected to:

  • Prepare and drive the agenda rather than waiting for leadership to determine what should be discussed

  • Provide concise updates on projects, priorities, wins, risks, and unresolved issues

  • Explain not only what happened, but why it happened

  • Present recommended next steps and anticipated outcomes

  • Bring thoughtful options instead of open-ended problems

  • Negotiate priorities, expectations, and timelines when necessary

  • Provide respectful pushback when an idea may not be practical or when another priority should come first

  • Maintain transparency even when progress is slower than expected

We are looking for someone who can disagree professionally, communicate difficult information tactfully, and remain levelheaded under pressure.

AI & Technology Integration

Pillar wants AI to become a practical part of how the business operates.

You will:

  • Identify opportunities where AI can improve existing workflows

  • Research tools independently when a business problem arises

  • Use AI for research, analysis, documentation, communication, marketing support, and process improvement

We are looking for practical AI literacy, not simply someone who has used ChatGPT occasionally.

Operational Excellence

Although growth is an immediate priority, you will also help strengthen Pillar's operational foundation.

This may include:

  • Monitoring business and client KPIs

  • Improving workflows as operational gaps become visible

  • Maintaining accurate client, physician, patient, billing, and reporting information

  • Supporting consistent naming conventions and documentation

  • Reviewing processes for accuracy and efficiency

  • Creating or improving SOPs when a documented process is genuinely needed

  • Supporting scheduling, invoicing, reporting, and administrative coordination

  • Helping the company prepare operationally as the number of physician partners and patients increases

As Pillar grows, the scope of the position may expand into greater leadership and team-management responsibilities.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of relevant experience across business operations, executive support, business development, customer success, healthcare operations, or a related field

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with senior leaders, founders, executives, physicians, or business owners

  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship-management skills

  • Ability to manage several responsibilities simultaneously in a startup or rapidly changing environment

  • Experience solving problems independently without waiting for detailed instructions

  • Strong written and verbal communication

  • Confidence facilitating meetings and business conversations

  • Ability to organize information and communicate progress clearly

  • Strong judgment when dealing with sensitive or difficult conversations

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar systems and processes independently

  • Practical experience using AI tools for business or productivity

  • High attention to detail, particularly where client information, billing, reporting, or financial accuracy is involved

Highly Preferred

  • Healthcare practice, healthcare startup, wellness, medical services, or physician-facing experience

  • Experience supporting a startup founder or small-business owner

  • Experience conducting discovery, sales, partnership, or client-conversion calls

  • Exposure to physician acquisition or healthcare business development

  • Experience with local or organic marketing

  • Customer Success Management experience

  • Chief of Staff or senior Executive Assistant experience

  • Experience introducing new technologies or AI-driven workflows into an organization

Position Specifications

Specification

Details

Position Title

Solution Architect (RHEL & Cloud Specialist)

Work Model / Location

Remote

Experience Level

Senior (Minimum 5+ Years in Architectural Roles)

Language Requirements

Portuguese and English

Primary Technology Stack

RHEL, Ansible, Python, AWS/Azure/GCP, K8s

1.3 Strategic Importance of the Role

The Solution Architect (RHEL & Cloud Specialist) occupies a pivotal role within our Technology Office, serving as the bridge between high-level business strategy and technical execution. As our infrastructure transitions toward a sophisticated hybrid-cloud model, the strategic governance of our Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)estate becomes paramount for maintaining security, compliance, and operational reliability. This role is not merely advisory; it is a hands-on leadership position tasked with architecting the automated scaffolds that support our entire digital product portfolio.

Executive Summary: We are seeking a proactive technical leader who refuses to accept "status quo" system inefficiencies. The ideal candidate will design and govern resilient solutions that utilize Ansible for massive-scale automation, ensuring our hybrid-cloud platforms are self-healing, secure, and performant. You will be expected to guide engineering teams through complex migrations while remaining deeply connected to the code and configurations that define our environment.

In the context of the 2026 technology landscape, where cloud costs and sovereign data requirements are increasingly complex, this Architect will ensure our RHEL foundation provides the necessary abstraction and stability to move workloads between on-premise virtualization and public cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with zero friction. The successful candidate will be a champion of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD, moving us closer to a fully autonomous data center vision.

2. Key Responsibilities & Strategic Objectives

The Solution Architect (RHEL & Cloud Specialist) is a high-impact role designed to steer the technical direction of the organizations infrastructure. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring that all technological solutions are not only fit for purpose today but are engineered to scale for the demands of 2026 and beyond. This involves a dual focus on high-level strategic vision and deep-dive technical implementation, particularly within the Red Hat ecosystem and hyperscale cloud environments.

2.1 Architectural Design & Strategy

Design and maintain comprehensive end-to-end solution architectures that integrate on-premise data centers with public cloud platforms, ensuring seamless workload portability and high availability.

Develop and document scalable, secure, and resilient architectural blueprints for hybrid-cloud deployments, utilizing RHEL as the primary operating system foundation.

Translate complex business requirements and organizational goals into detailed technical specifications and infrastructure designs.

Evaluate and select appropriate virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM) and cloud services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) that align with the organizations long-term cost-efficiency and performance targets.

Architect disaster recovery and business continuity solutions that ensure data integrity and minimal downtime across geographically dispersed sites.

Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure solution designs remain compliant with the broader organizational technology roadmap and security policies.

2.2 Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

Spearhead the transition to a fully automated infrastructure environment, reducing manual intervention and human error through robust Infrastructure as Code practices.

Architect enterprise-wide automation frameworks using Ansible for the consistent configuration, provisioning, and management of RHEL environments.

Define and enforce standards for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to manage multi-cloud resource lifecycles.

Oversee the development of automated compliance and security hardening playbooks to ensure all systems meet internal and regulatory standards upon deployment.

Design automated patching and update workflows that leverage Red Hat Satellite or Ansible Automation Platform to maintain fleet-wide system health.

Standardize CI/CD pipeline integration for infrastructure components, ensuring that environment changes are tested, version-controlled, and deployed via GitLab CI or Jenkins.

Strategic Objective: The "Zero-Touch" Environment

The Architect is tasked with reducing "Toil" by 40% within the first 18 months. This is achieved by abstracting underlying hardware and cloud complexities through a unified, Ansible-driven automation layer that empowers developers to self-service their infrastructure needs within governed guardrails.

2.3 Technical Governance & Leadership

Provide the technical leadership necessary to maintain architectural integrity and foster a culture of engineering excellence across DevOps and Infrastructure teams.

Establish and chair the Architectural Design Review board for infrastructure projects, ensuring all solutions adhere to established standards for performance and security.

Mentor and provide technical guidance to Senior DevOps Engineers, SREs, and System Administrators, fostering a deep understanding of RHEL internals and cloud-native patterns.

Drive the adoption of best practices in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift), ensuring teams build portable and secure microservices architectures.

Maintain a comprehensive Service Catalog and Architectural Decision Log (ADL) to document the "why" behind critical technology choices.

Lead vendor engagement and technology pilots (POCs) to assess emerging tools and their potential impact on the organizational tech stack.

2.4 Proactive System Optimization

Serve as a proactive agent for change by identifying and resolving structural weaknesses and performance bottlenecks before they impact the business.

Conduct regular architectural health checks and performance audits of the RHEL fleet and cloud environments to identify areas of waste or inefficiency.

Analyze system telemetry and monitoring data to identify recurring performance bottlenecks, designing architectural or automated remediations to eliminate them.

Proactively optimize cloud spend by designing architectures that leverage spot instances, auto-scaling, and right-sized resource allocation.

Identify architectural "technical debt" and create structured plans for modernization or decommissioning of legacy systems.

Collaborate with Security teams to proactively address emerging threat vectors by updating architectural patterns and hardening standards.

3. Core Technical Proficiencies

The candidate must demonstrate a high level of technical mastery across a diverse stack of infrastructure and automation technologies. As a Senior Solution Architect, the expectation is not only to understand these tools individually but to have the proven ability to integrate them into cohesive, high-performance architectures that serve complex enterprise needs in a 2026 technical landscape.

Technology Domain

Mandatory Technical Requirements

Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)

Expert Administration: Deep-level knowledge of RHEL 8 and 9, including advanced system internals, kernel parameter tuning, and troubleshooting complex OS-level performance issues. Security Hardening: Mastery of SELinux (policy development and troubleshooting), Firewalld, and implementing OpenSCAP for automated compliance auditing. Lifecycle Management: Expert implementation of Red Hat Satellite for managing content views, repositories, and automated provisioning workflows. Storage & Identity: Proficiency in LVM, Stratis, and integration with SSSD/Identity Management (IdM/FreeIPA) and Active Directory.

Automation & Scripting

Ansible Mastery: Advanced use of Ansible Core and Ansible Automation Platform (AAP). Ability to develop complex, idempotent roles, custom modules, and filter plugins. Python Proficiency: Strong ability to write Python (3.x) for custom tooling, API integrations, and data processing scripts. Advanced Shell Scripting: Mastery of Bash for system-level automation, health checks, and intricate diagnostic utilities. State Management: In-depth knowledge of Jinja2 templating and YAML for dynamic configuration management.

Cloud Platforms

Hyperscale Architecture: Deep architectural knowledge of either AWS (VPC, Transit Gateway, IAM, EC2), Azure (VNet, RBAC, VMSS), or GCP (VPC, Cloud IAM, Compute Engine).Hybrid Connectivity: Experience designing secure tunnels and dedicated connections (Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, or Cloud Interconnect) between on-premise RHEL environments and the cloud. Cloud Governance: Knowledge of CloudFormation or Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment of cloud-native resources.

Containerization & Virtualization

Kubernetes & OpenShift: Proven experience designing and securing production-grade Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift clusters, including ingress controllers, CNI, and CSI. Container Standards: Mastery of OCI-compliant runtimes including Docker, Podman, and Buildah. Virtualization: Strong architectural knowledge of VMware vSphere (7.x/8.x) and KVM/libvirt for hosting RHEL workloads in high-availability configurations.

CI/CD & DevOps Ecosystem

Pipeline Engineering: Expert knowledge of Jenkins (Pipeline as Code/Groovy) or GitLab CI/CD for automating the build, test, and deployment of infrastructure code. DevSecOps: In-depth understanding of integrating security scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, or Trivy) directly into deployment pipelines. Git Mastery: Advanced knowledge of Git workflows (GitFlow, Trunk-based development) and repository management.

Professional Certification Expectations: While the role prioritizes hands-on architectural experience, the following certifications are considered highly desirable: Red Hat Certified Architect (RHCA), Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), and AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional.

3.6 Supplementary Knowledge Areas

Beyond the core stack, the Solution Architect is expected to be conversant in the following areas to ensure holistic solution integrity:

Observability: Designing monitoring and logging strategies using the Prometheus/Grafana stack or ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).

Networking: Thorough understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing (F5, HAProxy, or cloud-native LBs), and modern SDN concepts.

Security Standards: Familiarity with ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, and data requirements as they relate to infrastructure architecture.

4. Desired Professional Attributes (Soft Skills)

At the Senior Solution Architect level, technical mastery is considered the baseline. Success in this role is fundamentally determined by an individual's professional character, cognitive agility, and ability to navigate complex human and organizational systems. We are seeking a candidate who transcends the "siloed expert" stereotype to become a true business partner and technical diplomat.

4.1 Strategic Thinking & Business Alignment

The Solution Architect must possess the cognitive capacity to operate simultaneously at the granular technical level and the macroscopic business level. This attribute ensures that technology serves the business, rather than becoming an end in itself.

Big-Picture Orientation: Ability to visualize the entire ecosystem and understand how a single RHEL configuration or cloud policy ripple-effects through the organization's long-term objectives.

Future-Proofing: Anticipating market shifts and technological evolutions (particularly in the 2026-2030 horizon) to ensure current designs do not become legacy debt within short cycles.

Value-Driven Decision Making: Evaluating architectural choices through the lens of Return on Investment (ROI), Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and operational efficiency.

4.2 Proactive Problem-Solving & Anti-Fragility

We require a "hunter" mindset—someone who does not wait for an outage to investigate a system. This role demands a commitment to building anti-fragile systems that improve through stress and automated self-healing.

Root Cause Obsession: A natural inclination to bypass "quick fixes" in favor of identifying and remediating systemic architectural weaknesses.

Predictive Analysis: Utilizing telemetry and system patterns to identify bottlenecks and potential points of failure before they manifest as critical incidents.

Resourcefulness: Demonstrating high levels of ingenuity when faced with unique integration challenges or legacy constraints.

The "Architect-as-Consultant" Competency

Successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to act as internal consultants, providing objective, data-backed guidance to product owners while maintaining the emotional intelligence to pivot strategies when business priorities shift abruptly.

4.3 Exceptional Communication & Stakeholder Influence

This role acts as a linguistic bridge between the data center and the boardroom. The ability to translate "kernel panic" into "business risk" is essential for securing project buy-in and funding.

Architectural Storytelling: Utilizing data visualization and clear narratives to articulate complex technical blueprints to non-technical executives.

Consensus Building: Navigating diverse opinions across engineering teams to reach a unified architectural decision without causing friction or resentment.

Active Listening: Genuinely understanding the pain points of developers and operations staff to ensure architectures address real-world usability.

4.4 Leadership, Mentorship & Technical Advocacy

Leadership in this role is not about title or hierarchy; it is about "leading by influence." The Solution Architect must be a standard-bearer for engineering excellence.

Knowledge Multiplier: A documented track record of uplifting the technical capabilities of others through mentorship, workshops, and high-quality documentation.

Culture Champion: Promoting a culture of DevSecOps, automation-first, and blameless post-mortems across the engineering organization.

Integrity: Having the professional courage to voice concerns over technical decisions that may compromise system integrity or long-term stability.

4.5 Architectural Pragmatism

While striving for technical perfection, the Architect must recognize when "good enough" is the correct business decision. Pragmatism is the key to delivering value in high-pressure environments.

Balancing Innovation and Stability: Knowing when to deploy a bleeding-edge technology and when to rely on a "boring but stable" RHEL foundation.

Technical Debt Management: Making conscious, documented decisions to accept technical debt in exchange for speed-to-market, while having a clear plan for its future retirement.

Adaptability: Remaining flexible in the face of shifting project requirements, changing cloud vendor landscapes, or evolving regulatory environments.

Attribute Summary

Expected Organizational Impact

Strategic Thinking

Reduction in technology redundancies and better cost-to-performance ratios.

Influence & Comm

Faster approval cycles for critical infrastructure upgrades and project funding.

Pragmatism

On-time delivery of projects that meet immediate business needs without future breakage.

Senior AI Test EngineerLocation: Remote About the RoleAlternative Path is looking for a Senior AI Test Engineer to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior AI Test Engineer

Location: Remote

About the Role

Alternative Path is looking for a Senior AI Test Engineer to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients. This is a senior, client-facing role: you'll own the test strategy for these systems end-to-end, working directly with the client's engineering team to validate accuracy, reliability, and safety before these agents reach financial industry end-users — where hallucinations or bad data retrieval carry real business risk.

This is not conventional QA. You'll be building evaluation frameworks and datasets, running systematic evals, and defining quality bars for non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems operating over complex financial data.

What You'll Do
  • Own the test and evaluation strategy for the client's AI agent systems — chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, and MCP-based tool-calling agents
  • Design and build eval suites covering accuracy, groundedness/faithfulness to source data, task completion, latency, and safety
  • Build and curate golden datasets reflecting real client use cases and financial-data edge cases (ambiguous queries, stale data, conflicting sources, numerical precision)
  • Use eval/observability tooling such as LangSmith (or equivalents — Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, Langfuse, PromptFoo) to trace, score, and monitor agent runs
  • Define and track RAG-specific metrics (retrieval precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation/source accuracy) — critical given the systems sit on top of financial datasets where correctness is non-negotiable
  • Evaluate MCP-based tool-calling behavior — correct tool selection, multi-step task execution, failure handling
  • Design regression testing so prompt, model, or data-pipeline changes don't silently degrade quality
  • Run structured red-teaming for hallucinations, prompt injection, and unsafe/incorrect financial outputs
  • Act as the primary quality point of contact with the client's engineering stakeholders — translating findings into clear, actionable risk assessments
  • Mentor/guide any junior QA resources staffed onto the engagement as it scales
  • Build automation to integrate evals into CI pipelines where feasible

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • 3+ years in software QA/testing, with hands-on senior-level experience evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems (not just traditional QA)
  • Direct experience with eval frameworks/tools — LangSmith strongly preferred; also acceptable: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFoo, Braintrust, Langfuse
  • Strong understanding of RAG architecture and how to independently evaluate retrieval quality vs. generation quality
  • Practical familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks
  • Strong Python skills for building test harnesses, scoring pipelines, and automation
  • Experience designing evaluation approaches for non-deterministic systems (probabilistic scoring, not binary pass/fail)
  • Comfortable working directly with client engineering teams — strong communication, able to explain quality risk to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Prior experience in a client services / consulting QA environment (this is a client-facing engagement, not an internal product team)

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience testing AI systems in fintech, capital markets, or data/analytics domains
  • Familiarity with financial data accuracy/compliance considerations (numerical precision, source traceability, audit trails)
  • Exposure to LLM red-teaming/safety evaluation practices
  • Experience with browser-automation agent testing (Playwright or similar)

Why This Role Matters

The client's end-users rely on these agents for financial research and decision-making — the cost of a hallucinated number or a wrong source is high. You'll be the senior technical authority ensuring these systems are trustworthy before they ship, working at the intersection of AI evaluation and financial-data correctness.

Opportunity

ThermalWorks has an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about sustainability and eager to be part of an innovative company that’s on a journey to transform the world’s infrastructure.

We are seeking a Platform Engineer (ServiceNow) to join ThermalWorks,working directly with the AI and Data Analytics group. This role owns the administration and development of ThermalWorks core business systems, with ServiceNow as the primary platform and NetSuite and Arena PLM as supporting systems. You will be in a fast-paced environment, building and maintaining the applications, workflows, and integrations that groups across ThermalWorks, such as operations, service, and engineering, rely on every day. The Platform Engineer needs to be agile, professional, trustworthy with confidential information, and comfortable in a rapidly changing environment. You will work closely with service, operations, engineering, supply chain, and finance teams to turn business needs into reliable, scalable system solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  1. ServiceNow Administration
  • Own day-to-day administration of the ServiceNow platform, including users, groups, roles, ACLs, forms, workflows, notifications, and the service catalog
  • Manage instance upgrades and family releases, including regression testing with the Automated Test Framework (ATF)
  • Maintain CMDB and platform data integrity and enforce configuration standards and governance
  • Coordinate with ServiceNow implementation partners on enhancements, upgrades, and escalations
  1. ServiceNow Development
  • Build scoped applications, workflows, and automations using Flow Designer, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and UI Policies
  • Extend ServiceNow modules (e.g., ITSM, Field Service, Customer Service) to fit ThermalWorks’ operational and service workflows
  • Manage development through update sets or source control, with sub-production testing and controlled promotion to production
  • Evaluate build-vs-buy options across custom development and ServiceNow Store applications
  1. Integrations & Supporting Systems (NetSuite, Arena)
  • Design and maintain integrations between ServiceNow, NetSuite, and Arena PLM using IntegrationHub, REST APIs, and middleware
  • Provide secondary administration and support for NetSuite and Arena, including users, roles, workflows, and saved searches
  • Develop light customizations in NetSuite (SuiteScript, SuiteFlow) and Arena (API scripts) where needed
  • Partner with the AI & Data Analytics team to connect business systems to the company data platform and maintain master data quality
  1. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Partnership
  • Partner with service, operations, engineering, supply chain, and finance teams to translate requirements into configuration or code
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex business system and integration issues
  • Maintain solution designs, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and user training materials
  • Support additional business systems and digital infrastructure initiatives as required by the business

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow administration and development experience
  • Experience supporting or integrating ERP and PLM systems (NetSuite and Arena preferred), ideally in a manufacturing or hardware product environment
  • Proven experience delivering system integrations and custom applications from requirements through production support
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders across operations, service, engineering, and finance

Specific Skills / Abilities

  • ServiceNow development in JavaScript/GlideScript, including Flow Designer and scoped applications
  • Experience with IntegrationHub, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, and MID Server
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow upgrades, ATF, update sets, and instance governance
  • Working knowledge of NetSuite (SuiteScript a plus) and Arena PLM or a comparable PLM system
  • SQL and reporting experience (ServiceNow Performance Analytics a plus)
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) preferred; Certified Application Developer (CAD) a plus

Working at Endeavour

Innovate at Speed: Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas actually matter.
Own Your Work: Enjoy the flexibility and autonomy to execute and do your best work.
Learn from the Best: Collaborate daily with top-tier, experienced industry experts.
Elevate Your Craft: Be part of a respectful, continuous-learning culture driven by excellence.
Make a Real Impact: Join a team of dedicated changemakers building solutions that benefit people and the planet.

About ThermalWorks

ThermalWorks transforms data center cooling with ultra-efficient, modular systems that support dynamic AI workloads in any climate, with zero water consumption. Its multi-function chillers unify dry, trim, and full mechanical cooling into a single adaptive platform engineered to maximize tokens per watt.

About Endeavour

Endeavour builds technology infrastructure for the benefit of all. As the AI revolution drives unprecedented demand for resources, Endeavour provides the integrated infrastructure required to support global innovation while restoring the local environments we serve.

Inspired by nature, we design infrastructure as a cohesive system where every element feeds another to create a cycle of regeneration. This vision is realized through the Endeavour Stack, a collection of next-generation technologies that solve critical challenges in data, energy, materials, and water. Together, our systems allow AI cloud providers to scale with speed and agility, bypassing the constraints of traditional infrastructure.

At Endeavour, we do things differently. As a purpose trust, we reinvest profits to solve global problems. We are a collection of changemakers driven by our connection to each other, our communities, and our planet. By bringing proven experts together to move fast and cut through complexity, we are building a new model for infrastructure that delivers lasting benefits to our customers and local communities.

We are currently seeking a Senior MEP / Datacenter Infrastructure Engineer to join our ANZ SA team. At NVIDIA, we are leading the AI computing revolution, delivering deep learning and high‑performance computing solutions that power many of the world’s largest and fastest data centers and supercomputers, especially through our Neo Cloud program. As a member of our team, you will play a vital role in planning, designing, and deploying AI/HPC data center infrastructure with a strong focus on power, cooling, and telemetry/control systems, as well as a strong background working with the Land/Power/Shell Data Center ecosystem from inception and design to deployment. If you have a strong passion for mission‑critical facilities, data center MEP design, and a successful history of engaging with customers and partners on complex infrastructure deployments, this is an excellent opportunity to make a substantial contribution.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead end‑to‑end planning and deployment of AI/HPC data centers, from concept and reference design through construction, commissioning, and go‑live, ensuring infrastructure aligns with NVIDIA reference architectures and operational requirements.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to understand NVIDIA’s guidance for data center infrastructure (DSX), including power distribution, liquid/air cooling, controls and monitoring, and network/cabling architecture, and translate this rapidly into robust, scalable customer designs.
  • Review and evaluate customer and partner design packages (architectural, electrical, mechanical, controls), ensuring consistency with NVIDIA reference architectures, industry standards, and regulatory requirements, and provide recommendations to improve performance, scalability, cost‑effectiveness, and sustainability.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive pre‑deployment audit plans to assess the readiness, reliability, and efficiency of data center infrastructure components prior to AI/HPC cluster deployment, identifying risks and mitigation actions early.
  • Oversee construction, integration, and bring‑up activities, working closely with contractors, OEMs, service providers, and customers to resolve infrastructure issues and ensure on‑time, high‑quality delivery.
  • Establish and drive quality assurance and commissioning processes for power systems, liquid/air cooling systems, rack/server power and cooling integration, telemetry, and control systems to validate functionality and performance against design specifications and benchmarks.
  • Act as the key liaison and domain expert for customers and partners on all data center infrastructure topics, facilitating productive technical discussions and ensuring clear alignment from planning through steady‑state operations.
  • Develop and sustain a strong ecosystem of design firms, contractors, integrators, and service providers to enable rapid, reliable deployment of NVIDIA solutions globally.
  • Mentor and guide Infra SA team members and partner engineering teams, sharing best practices in MEP design, data center operations, and deployment methodologies to ensure overall program success.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across infrastructure design and processes, identifying opportunities to increase reliability, resilience, efficiency, and automation in AI/HPC data centers.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; an advanced degree, equivalent experience, or relevant certifications is preferred.
  • 5+ years of overall experience in enterprise and/or hyperscale data centers with a focus on MEP design, construction, and deployment for high‑density AI/HPC or mission‑critical environments.
  • Proven experience in data center engineering, operations, or infrastructure management roles, with responsibility for large‑scale deployments and cross‑functional coordination.
  • Strong technical knowledge of data center systems, including power distribution (UPS, switchgear, PDUs, rack power), liquid/air cooling (chillers, CDU, CRAH/CRAC, direct‑to‑chip or immersion), rack/server mechanical and power integration, and structured cabling for high‑density deployments.
  • Demonstrated technical and project leadership in fluid, rapidly changing environments, with the ability to drive complex programs from design through commissioning and hand‑off.
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with a keen attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality and operational excellence.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage expertly with diverse stakeholders including customers, partners, contractors, and internal engineering teams, and to lead productive technical discussions.
  • Strong organization and time‑management capabilities, able to plan, schedule, and coordinate multiple infrastructure projects and tasks to meet or exceed agreed timelines.
  • Willingness to travel up to customer sites, partner facilities, and NVIDIA data center locations as required.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with data center operations processes, safety practices, and security measures in enterprise or hyperscale environments.
  • Solid understanding of the full data center infrastructure stack, from building shell and core through power, cooling, racks, cabling, and monitoring/controls for AI/HPC platforms.
  • Background working closely with server and rack manufacturers, integrators, and colocation providers on high‑density deployments.
  • Outstanding interpersonal skills, with a track record of building long‑term relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders and serving as a trusted technical advisor.
