jobs.excerpt: At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner.
jobs.description:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

We have an opening for a Principal Product Manager who will shape and grow Constant Contact's partner ecosystem through product innovation and strategy. This is not a Sales or Business Development role; you'll focus on identifying which partnerships create the greatest opportunities, prioritizing the integrations and experiences we build, and developing a product roadmap that connects our platform to new customers and drives meaningful business growth.

Your focus is Vertical Partnerships: tailoring our platform and partner experiences to the needs of specific industries, then repeating that success across several of them. Real Estate is one example. It’s a vertical where our value proposition is resonating today, and it shows the kind of work involved: identifying the right partners, shaping an experience that fits the industry’s workflows, and landing and expanding quickly. Our priorities will follow where the evidence is strongest, so the specific verticals will change as we learn. What stays constant is the goal of a repeatable model for entering, validating, and scaling vertical partnerships across several markets with strong market size and similar customer needs.

You’ll share company goals for user acquisition, revenue, and average selling price (ASP) with Strategic Partnerships (our business development team), and you’ll work across the company to deliver them. Expect daily collaboration with Design, Engineering, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Data teams, as well as external partners.

This is an individual contributor role with company-wide scope. You’ll succeed by building trust and alignment with teams that have their own priorities.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and launch of partner-driven experiences across multiple industry verticals
  • Build a reusable vertical model: define how we identify, validate, and enter a new vertical, and which components carry over from one to the next
  • Define and ship integrations, embedded experiences, co-built offers, templates, and marketplace listings with partners including platforms, industry associations, networks and franchises, agencies, resellers, ecommerce providers, and AI companies
  • Work with engineering on APIs, data flows, authentication, and integration quality, including reliability, security, and ongoing maintenance
  • Identify where AI can speed up partner and customer onboarding, content creation, and automation, and prioritize it with engineering and design
  • Run discovery with partners and customers, then turn it into a clear roadmap and prioritized backlog
  • Design and run pilots with defined success criteria, then make scale, change, or stop decisions based on the data
  • Align and drive cross-functional teams across Design, Engineering, Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Support, Customer Success, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Data, and Strategic Partnerships to deliver partner products. You’ll set direction and priorities through influence, shared goals, and clear communication. Together you’ll define packaging, pricing, rev-share and co-sell models, launch plans, partner enablement, and ongoing support for each partner product.
  • Set and track the metrics for each partner product, including partner-sourced accounts, activation, attach rate, retention, expansion, ASP, and revenue
  • Share what you learn, coach colleagues informally, and help raise the quality of partner-product practice

Who you are:

  • 8+ years in product management, ideally in B2B, SaaS, platform, marketplace, or partner-integration products. We care more about what you’ve shipped and learned than about years or titles.
  • Experience taking a product from an unclear problem through validation, MVP, and launch, ideally with an external partner or integration
  • Comfort discussing APIs, integrations, data models, and system design with engineers, and writing clear technical requirements
  • Vertical SaaS or industry-specific partnership experience (for example, Real Estate, financial services, or home services)
  • Experience with rev-share, co-sell, or embedded distribution models
  • Experience linking product work to business results such as acquisition, revenue, attach rate, or retention
  • Experience turning customer and market insight into product decisions, ideally for small business or vertical audiences
  • Track record of leading cross-functional work and driving results through influence
  • Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information and to define structure where little exists

How we work:

Constant Contact combines the strengths of an established company with the pace of a startup. We have 30 years of customer trust, a large base of small businesses, and the resources to back good ideas. On the B2B team, you’ll get the speed and freedom to use them.

  • Initiative is expected and rewarded. You’ll have room to identify opportunities, propose new approaches, and carry them through without waiting for a long approval chain.
  • Invention and reinvention are part of the job. You’ll build new products and also rethink how we approach partnerships, from process to packaging.
  • Small, fast cycles. We favor quick pilots, clear success criteria, and decisions based on results.
  • Scale behind you. You can use the company’s customers, data, brand, and cross-functional experts to make a new idea work faster than a startup could.

How we’ll measure success:

Within your first year:

  • Multiple vertical partner experiences launched, each with measurable growth in new accounts and revenue
  • A documented, repeatable playbook for entering a new vertical, tested across more than one market
  • Evidence-based decisions on which verticals to scale, adjust, or stop
  • A prioritized pipeline of next verticals, backed by market and customer evidence

We’re dedicated to improving the quality of our product from a customer standpoint and have a true desire to enable the success of businesses, non-profit organizations, and community groups.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

About You and This Role

Robust.AI is an early-stage startup founded by an unsurpassed team of veterans in
robotics, AI, and Supply Chain who are dedicated to making the promise of Physical AI a
reality. We are a collaborative group with a diverse set of perspectives, seeking talented
individuals who are passionate about developing robotic solutions that are valuable to
customers and delightful to use. Help us redefine the very foundation of robotics and
build robots that are smart, safe, and flexible: fully autonomous and truly collaborative.
As a Solutions Engineer at Robust.AI, you will join a small, fast-paced team responsible
for designing robotic solutions for warehouse and fulfillment operations. You will work
closely with Sales and directly with prospective and existing customers to understand
their operations, analyze data, develop system concepts, and demonstrate how
Robust.AI's AMR, Carter, can improve their business.

This role combines warehouse engineering, data analysis, simulation, and customer
engagement. You will help develop solutions throughout the sales cycle, from initial
discovery and site visits through system design, simulation, proposal development, and
technical validation.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving open-ended engineering problems, can
work across multiple customer projects, and is comfortable turning imperfect real-world
information into practical, data-driven solutions.

Main Responsibilities

    ● Analyze customer operational data to understand order profiles, SKU profiles
    throughput requirements, labor productivity, and other inputs required for design.

    ● Develop AMR solutions including workflows, facility layouts, cart configurations,
    labor requirements, productivity estimates, and descriptions of operation.

    ● Build and analyze discrete-event simulations to validate system performance,
    evaluate design alternatives, identify bottlenecks, and support fleet sizing.

    ● Develop and modify warehouse layouts using AutoCAD.

    ● Participate in customer discovery calls, technical discussions, site visits, and
    facility walkthroughs to understand current operations and validate solution

    assumptions.

    ● Identify missing /or inconsistent data, develop engineering assumptions, and
    clearly document the inputs and methods behind solution recommendations.

    ● Partner with Sales to develop proposals, presentations, ROI analyses, and other
    materials that communicate the operational/business value of Robust.AI solutions.

    ● Support customer demonstrations, technical reviews, and other engagements

    throughout the sales process.

    ● Collaborate with Product, Software, Deployment, and Engineering teams to
    evaluate technical requirements, product capabilities, implementation
    considerations, and potential solution risks.

    ● Develop and improve internal analytical tools, simulation models, and processes
    that make solution development faster, more consistent, and scalable.

    ● Manage multiple customer projects concurrently and prioritize work based on

    deadlines and business needs.

Minimum Requirements

    ● Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations
    Research, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field.
    ● Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, with the ability to work
    with large and imperfect real-world datasets.
    ● 1–4 years of experience in industrial engineering, supply chain, warehouse
    operations, automation, data science, or a related field.
    ● Experience analyzing data using tools such as Excel, Python, SQL, or Power BI.
    ● Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, assumptions, and analytical
    results to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    ● Understanding of warehouse or manufacturing operations, material flow,
    throughput, capacity, and labor productivity.
    ● Experience with AutoCAD or similar CAD software for facility layouts.
    ● Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and work effectively in a fast-
    paced environment.
    ● Willingness to travel up to 20–30% for customer site visits, proposal reviews,
    demonstrations, and post-deployment support.

Nice to Have

    ● Experience with warehouse automation, including AMRs, AGVs, goods-to-person
    systems, conveyor, sortation, or other material-handling technologies.

    ● Experience with discrete-event simulation software, preferably FlexSim.

    ● Strong Python skills for data processing, visualization, simulation, optimization, or

    engineering tool development.

    ● Familiarity with warehouse optimization techniques such as batch picking,
    zoning, order clustering, SKU slotting, and labor planning.

    ● Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS), warehouse control
    systems (WCS), and other logistics software.

    ● Experience developing automation concepts, productivity models, capacity

    models, or ROI analyses.

    ● Experience working directly with customers in a technical, consulting, pre-sales, or

    project environment.

    ● Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

What You'll Bring to the Table

    ● A genuine passion for robotics, automation, and warehouse logistics, with
    curiosity about how technology can improve real-world operations.

    ● A strong problem-solving mindset and comfort working on problems where the
    answer is not immediately obvious.

    ● Attention to detail and a willingness to question inputs, validate assumptions, and
    sanity-check analytical results.

    ● The ability to move between data, layouts, simulation models, and customer
    conversations to understand how an operation works as a complete system.

    ● Strong ownership of your work and the ability to clearly explain what you
    analyzed, what you assumed, what you found, and what you recommend.

    ● A collaborative mindset and enthusiasm for working across Sales, Engineering,
    Product, Software, and Deployment teams.

What We Offer


    ● $95,000–$130,000, experience dependent
    ● Full benefits (health, dental, vision, life)
    ● Stock options
    ● Flexible vacation and sick leave practices
    ● Remote work

About Enformion

Enformion is a dynamic powerhouse in data intelligence and AI-powered identity verification. We deliver next-generation fraud prevention, risk management, and seamless onboarding solutions that foster ironclad trust between digital marketplaces, merchants, and consumers. By leveraging our massive data repositories and advanced behavioral analysis, we provide continuous monitoring for emerging risk indicators.

In a digital world where security and trust are everything, Enformion is at the forefront of the industry—and we are growing fast.

Job Purpose

Enformion provides identity and contact data to enterprise clients through APIs, and supports a network of consumer-facing websites built on that data. Enformion is seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to keep these sites and APIs available, fast, and protected from abusive traffic. This role sits where reliability and security meet.

The SRE will work closely with software engineering, information security, and legal/compliance to build and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure. The role covers monitoring, resolving complex technical issues, and automating solutions to recurring problems, and it plays a central part in optimizing Enformion platforms and infrastructure.

Salary - $150K-$165K

Responsibilities

Reliability and monitoring

  • Monitor availability, latency, and error rates across Enformion APIs. Define service level objectives and alerting that catch problems before customers do.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production incidents. Run blameless post-incident reviews and track follow-up actions to completion.
  • Automate recurring operational work and remediation, reducing manual toil.
  • Plan capacity and tune performance across the CDN, application, and data tiers.

Traffic protection and abuse mitigation

  • Design solutions that automatically identify harmful or unwanted traffic, including scraping, malicious bots, credential stuffing, fake account creation, and API key abuse.
  • Configure and tune CDN, WAF, bot management, and rate-limiting controls to block abusive traffic without degrading the experience for legitimate users and clients.
  • Analyze traffic logs to understand how abusive actors behave, how they evade controls, and what they cost in infrastructure load and revenue.
  • Investigate new abuse patterns and trends, and work with the Data Abuse & Detection Engineer to turn findings into enforced edge and application controls.
  • Enforce acceptable-use and terms-of-service policies at the infrastructure level.

Infrastructure security

  • Manage infrastructure as code and apply security policy checks before changes reach production.
  • Apply least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, TLS management, and secrets handling across AWS environments.
  • Integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with the DevSecOps Lead, including dependency, container, and configuration scanning.
  • Detect and remediate configuration drift, and maintain centralized logging that supports both operations and security investigations.
  • Provide evidence from automated controls for audits and client security questionnaires.

Collaboration

  • Work with Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Legal/Compliance to update policies, close product loopholes, and protect site quality and data integrity.
  • Help marketing and product teams understand how traffic quality affects analytics, conversion metrics, and campaign reporting.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience with security attacks and mitigation methods, particularly bot, scraping, and application-layer threats.
  • Hands-on experience with CDN providers (Akamai, Cloudflare, Fastly) and their traffic management, WAF, and bot management features.
  • Experience with Elastic/OpenSearch or a comparable platform for log mining and analytics.
  • Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS, and how to manage traffic at each layer.
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and scripting (Python, Bash, or similar).
  • Experience operating production systems in a public cloud environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).
  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Container and orchestration experience, including container security basics.
  • Observability tooling (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience protecting high-traffic commercial APIs.
  • Familiarity with SLOs, error budgets, and incident management practices.
  • Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 control environments.

This is a remote position.

The employer develops a breakthrough high-performance onchain exchange that delivers institutional grade execution, whilst delivering superior speed, security and reliability guarantees to users. Their revolutionary decentralized exchange operates as the world's first trading-specific Based Rollup on Ethereum offering core competitive advantage : Unlike traditional Layer 2 solutions that rely on single sequencers, Based Rollup grants transaction sequencing rights directly to Ethereum validators, achieving true decentralization.

This design delivers significant benefits:
- Speed:
- Security: verifiable order execution and settlement, via zk-proofs, with executed trades settling on Ethereum. over 950,000 Ethereum validators securing every transaction. Transaction data ultimately settles on Ethereum mainnet, inheriting all L1 security guarantees.
- Reliability: no single point of failure, with the rollup design having multiple rotating L2 nodes (unlike generation-1 rollups)

Their custom trading engine is written in Rust, achieving deterministic execution. Their engine is cross-compiled into zero-knowledge circuits, allowing the network to generate validity proofs for each state transition, ensuring provably correct order execution.

They’re looking for a Senior Devops Engineer based anywhere in Europe (Remote), to join their team
